/zhes shes nas spong bar 'gyur te/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis slob springs las/ yul dang dug mtshungs dang po myong ba tsam na bde/ /yul dang dug mtshungs rnam smin rtsub la mi zad pa/ /yul dang dug mtshungs gti mug mun nag 'thib por byed/ /yul dang dug mtshungs shugs bzlogs dka' zhing g.yo ba yi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal spong ba'i rim pa dngos ni/ sdug bsngal la brtags pas skyo bar gyur te/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu gang yin dpyad pa na/ de las dang / de nyon mongs pa dang / de yul la brten nas skye bar shes te/ gzhi nges 'byung gi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa blangs te thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad pa nyid yin te/ mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam gtan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ lam rang gi ngo bo dang / de'i mngon par rtogs pa skye tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyu snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam bcu la slob pa'i thabs khyad par ba zhig yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ lung tha dad las mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung yang / gnas skabs bcur 'dus te/ dbu mtha' las/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan dang ni shes rab thabs/ /smon lam dang ni ye shes te/ /'di dag pha rol phyin bcur 'dod/ /ces dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ rigs dang chos la mos pa dang / /de bzhin du ni sems bskyed dang / /sbyin la sogs pa sgrub pa dang / /skyon med pa la 'jug pa dang / /sems can rnams yongs smin byed dang / /zhing ni rnam par sbyong ba dang / /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dang / /byang chub thob dang ston pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang dang po skal ba dang ldan pa'i rgyu rigs la gnas pa 'byung / des snying rjes kun nas bslangs te dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas chos la mos pa 'byung /

des byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa rang gi ngang gis 'byung zhing / des dngos gzhi'i nyams len pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam bcu la slob pa 'byung ste mos spyod kyi sa dang / des skyon med pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba sa dang po thob/ des sems can yongs su smin par byed pa ma dag sa bdun thob/ des zhing rnam par sbyong ba dang / mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba dang / srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor bas don yin pas dag pa sa gsum thob/ des byang chub mchog ste rtogs pa ye shes chos sku dang / mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa ste ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob nas 'khor ba ji srid par gzhan don mdzad pa ni 'bras bu ste/ de ltar na gnas skabs bcu po de dag mos pas spyod pa dang / ma dag sa bdun dang / dag pa sa gsum dang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa ste gnas skabs bzhir 'dus pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sa thob pa ni mos pa dang / /spyod pa dag la 'jug pa dang / /rtogs pa'i phyir dang sa rnams ni/ /grub pa'i sgo nas rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa lam des 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul ni/ ston pa 'di lta bu brtson 'grus rab kyis bskal pa grangs med gsum dang / 'phags pa byams pa lta bu brtson 'grus 'bring gis bskal pa grangs med sum cu rtsa drug dang / tha mas bsam gyis mi khyab pa na 'grub cing / rgyu la yun ring du gnas pas na rgyu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa gzhi mi spong ba gsang sngags kyi theg pa la/ gzhi mi spong ba'i tshul/ sngags kyi spyod pa rnam par gzhag pa/ rdo rje theg pa rnam par gzhag pa/ des 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus bstan pa'i zhar la 'bras bu'i theg pa rnam par gzhag pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gzhi zhes pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yin pa/ de mi spong ba'i tshul ni/ de gzhi'am yul nyid yin na ji ltar spang byar bya zhing /

gang zag kun dkris sam nyon mongs shas che ba rnams kyis spong bar mi nus te/ rdo rje gur las/ 'dod chags kyis bskyed 'jig rten pa/ /'dod chags nyid kyis rnam grol 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gsang ba 'dus pa las/ phyag chen ye shes 'dod pa yis/ /rtag tu 'dod yon lnga rnams bsten/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na thabs gang gi sgo nas gzhi mi spong ba yin zhe na/ 'di la bskyed rim gyi thabs la mkhas pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi thabs la mkhas pa gnyis/ dang po la lha so so'i thabs la mkhas pa dang / rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i thabs la mkhas pa gnyis/ dang po la thun mong ba pha rgyud kyi lha so so'i thabs la mkhas pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa ma rgyud kyi lha so so'i thabs la mkhas pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rgyal ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yin/ /rdo rje skye mched 'di dag ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /ces rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin yin pas/ 'dod yon ci tsam bsten pa thams cad de dag mchod pa'i bsam pas bsten na rnam par grol ba'i rgyur 'gyur bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ gzugs la gau rīr rtag tu bshad/ /sgra yi cha la tsau rī'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rang gi lhag pa'i lhar shes par byas te 'dod yon la lha la lha thim pa'i tshul gyis longs spyod pas rnam par grol bar gsungs te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pas bsten bya ste/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi thabs la mkhas pa la/ rang byin rlabs kyi thabs la mkhas pa dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs la mkhas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rang byung gi ye shes gcig gi ngo bor shes par byas te nyams su len pa yin la/

gnyis pa ni/ de thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gcig gi ngo bor shes par bya te nyams su blangs pas grol bar 'gyur te/ 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ thabs dang shes rab las byung ba'i/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pas sbyor ba yis/ /phung po khams dang skye mched gzugs/ /sngags las sbyor ba nges byas la/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na thabs med pa rnams yul gyis 'ching bar 'gyur zhing / gsang sngags kyi thabs dang ldan pa rnams yul gyis grol ba'i grogs byed pa yin la/ yul rnams ngo bo nyid kyis 'ching bar byed pa ma yin la/ de la phyin ci log tu zhen pa'i rtog pas 'ching bas na rtog pa de spangs pas grol bar 'gyur te/ rtsa rgyud las/ skye bo mi zad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dag pas dug med byas nas ni/ /brten bya 'di dag brten pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang dang po stobs chung ba'i dus na yul gyis gnod nus pas snang ba dgra bor 'char ba'i dus zhes bya/ bar du stobs mnyam pa na/ res phan/ res gnod pa 'byung ste snang ba khra bor 'char ba'i dus zhes bya/ de gnyis la mnyam gzhag ces pa'i ming 'dogs shing mthar gnyen po stobs che ba na yul rnams ye shes rtogs pa skye ba'i grogs su 'gyur bas snang ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'char ba'i dus sam dug lnga sman du 'gyur ba'i dus zhes bya/ de tsam na ting nge 'dzin ni rgyun ma chad par 'byung bas de la shin tu mnyam bzhag ces pa'i ming 'dogs pa yin te/ kha sbyor las/ dbang po gang dang gang lam nyid/ /de ni de yi ngo bor 'gyur/ /mnyam par ma gzhag rnal 'byor gyis/ /rtag tu shin tu rnal 'byor nyid/ /ces phyi ma la bltos te snga ma gcig mnyam par ma gzhag lta bur gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sngags kyi spyod pa rnam par gzhag pa ni/

ci'i phyir gsang sngags zhes bya zhe na/ man+t+ra zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na/ yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i don gyis na sngags zhes bya ste/ ma ni yid dang / tra yi skyob pa la 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ dbang po dang ni yul rnams kyi/ /rkyen las gang gang byung ba yi/ /yid de man zhes bya bar bshad/ /tra ni skyob par byed pa'i don/ /'jig rten spyod las rnam grol bar/ /gang bshad dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /rdo rje kun gyi bsrung bar ni/ /sngags kyi spyod pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rdo rje theg pa rnam par gzhag pa ni/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs nas dbang dang lam dang 'bras bu'i gnas skabs thams cad du longs spyod pas rdo rje theg pa zhes bya ste/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /rdo rje la dga' rtag par gnas/ /des na sangs rgyas rnams kyi thabs/ /rdo rje theg pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa 'bras bus 'grub pa'i dus ni/ gsang sngags kyi lam la brten nas gang zag dbang po yang rab kyis tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya/ 'bring gis bar dor/ tha mas skye ba bdun nam/ shin tu tha mas kyang skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du 'bras bu 'grub par gsungs te/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'di yi chos kyis bdag nyid che/ /sku gsum mi phyed las byung ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par rgyan/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ yang na lus 'di spangs ma thag /brtson pa mi ldan pas kyang 'grub/ /ces dang / gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gsang ba'i mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun nas ni/ /ma bsgom par yang dngos grub thob/

/ces dang / bzhi pa'i dbang du byas nas/ tshogs 'khor dam tshigs lnga pa las/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dag ni gang zag mchog la dgongs pa yin gyi/ so so skye bos 'grub bam zhe na/ shin tu 'grub ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ pha rol phyin pa'i 'byung bas ni/ /bskal pa grangs med mi thob pa/ /gal te rnal 'byor de brtson na/ /tshe 'di nyid la mya ngan 'da'/ /yang na mthong ba tsam gyis ni/ /skye ba bcu drug mya ngan 'da'/ /so so skye bo'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /'grub par 'gyur te gzhan du min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na 'bras bu tshegs med par thob pa'am/ 'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byed pa'am/ 'bras bu dang nye bas na 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya la/ 'dis 'dong bas na rgyu'i theg pa dang / 'dir 'dong bas na 'bras bu'i theg pa ste/ 'dis sangs rgyas kyi sar phyin par byed pas na rgyu'i theg pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sa 'dir phyin zin pas na 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya ste/ mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid dges/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na spyir theg pa la nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang rgyal gyi theg pa/ theg chen gyi theg pa dang gsum/ theg chen gyi theg pa la/ rgyu'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis su phye ba yin gyi/ theg pa gsum du ma 'dus pa'i theg pa bzhi pa dang / grub mtha' smra ba bzhir ma 'dus pa'i grub mtha' smra ba lnga pa ni med la/ gnas skabs theg pa gsum du nges kyang mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub ste/ 'jam dpal sgyu dra las/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /zhes dang / rdo rje snying 'grel las/ tshig snga ma gnyis mtshan brjod dang 'dra ba la/ nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dang 'dir/ /theg pa chen po gsum pa ste/ /sangs rgyas pa la bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa thub pa'i dgongs pa min/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las gsang sngags kyi theg pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul la/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos/ gsang sngags pa 'dod yon lam du byed pa gcig nyid kyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul dang / slob dpon dz+nyā na shrīs mtha' gcig gsal ba las/ khyad chos bcu gcig gis khyad par du 'phags par bshad pa sogs du ma zhig yod kyang / 'dir rtogs bya rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos dbyings/ thob bya rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ thob byed kyi thabs kun slong byang chub kyi sems don gcig na'ang thabs bzhi'i sgo nas pha rol tu phyin pa las gsang sngags khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang don gcig ces pa phar phyin theg pa ba dang / rdo rje theg pa ba gnyis car gyis chos dbyings rtogs byar byed cing / gnyis kas rtogs nus pa dang / thob bya'i 'bras bu'i mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la byed cing / de thob pa'i thabs la slob pa dang / lam gang nyams su len kyang byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs te nyams su len par don gcig pa'am khyad par med pa'i don yin te/ mdo sngags gnyis rtogs bya'i lta ba la khyad par med cing / thob bya mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub pa'i gnad kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la byed pa las 'os med la/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis pha rol tu phyin pa ba dang / rdo rje theg pa ba gnyis car gyi gzhi ma yin pa'i phyir/ thabs bzhi'i sgo nas khyad par 'phags tshul la bzhi las/ dang po rmongs ma rmongs kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags tshul ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la chos nyid dpe dang gtan tshigs la sogs pa'i sgo nas don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa tsam las/

mngon sum du mthong ba'i rtog med kyi ye shes skye ba med la/ rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la so so'i skye bo'i gnas skabs su'ang chos nyid dpe'i tshul gyis mngon sum du mthong ba zhes pa phar phyin pa'i rtogs tshul las gsal snang ches lhag pa zhig yod la/ de la mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes kyi ming 'dogs shing / des mtshon bya don gyi ye shes kyang myur tu 'dren nus pas na pha rol tu phyin pa ba la lta ba rtogs tshul la rmongs shing / rdo rje theg pa ba ma rmongs pa'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ mkhas pa snying rje cher ldan pa/ /dpyad de thabs kyi mchog len cing / /tha mal pa yi thabs smad nas/ /mi 'pho ba yi gnas thob po/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa thabs mang nyung gi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa ba la sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas ji snyed cig yod pa de snyed kyi steng du thun mong gi dngos grub/ grub chen brgyad/ longs spyod che ba/ shes rab che ba sogs dang / tshe ring ba sogs dang / thun mong ma yin pa phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa thabs rgyud mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig sogs zab cing rgya che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pas na/ pha rol tu phyin pa ba sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs nyung zhing rdo rje theg pa ba thabs mang ba'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ sems can kun don las sgrub phyir/ /blo chen la ni thams cad mkhyen/ /dbye ba rnam bzhir tshul gyi mchog /'gro ba'i bla mas gsungs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dka' tshegs che chung gi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags tshul ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa bas mgo dang rkang lag sbyin par gtong ba sogs dka' spyad drag pos lus sems gdung bar byas te 'bras bu mthar phyin par byed dgos la/

rdo rje theg pa bas spyod pa bde bas byang chub sgrub pa'i lam bde bas 'bras bu mthar phyin par byed pas na/ pha rol tu phyin pa ba sangs rgyas sgrub pa dka' tshegs che la/ rdo rje theg pa ba de chung ba'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ gang zhig gang du ji ltar 'dod/ /de nyid de la nges sbyor zhing / /'dod pa'i don ni thob mdzad pa'i/ /dam pa'i don ni thub pas gsungs/ /zhes dang / rtsa rgyud las/ skye bo mi zad pa yi las/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa ba ni rang bzhin gyis dbang po rtul bas/ dbang po rab kyis bskal pa grangs med gsum/ 'bring gis bskal pa grangs med bcu/ tha mas bskal pa grangs med sum cu rtsa drug na 'bras bu 'grub par gsungs la/ rdo rje theg pa bas ni rab kyis tshe 'di/ 'bring gis bar do/ tha mas skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad la 'bras bu 'grub par gsungs pas na dbang po rno rtul gyi sgo nas kyang rdo rje theg pa khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ pha rol phyin pa'i 'byung bas ni/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rtsod pa spong ba la/ don gcig pa la rtsod pa spong ba/ khyad par gyi dbye ba bzhi po mi rigs par thal ba'i rtsod pa spong ba/ gsung rab dang sde snod kyi dbye ba dang 'gal ba'i rtsod pa spong ba/ gsang sngags spyod pa'i dus ma yin par thal ba'i rtsod pa spong ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gsang sngags la zhe sdang ba'i blun po kha cig pha rol tu phyin pa ba dang rdo rje theg pa ba rtogs bya sogs don mi gcig ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa las 'bras bu sku dang / ye shes kyi dbye ba dang / sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbye ba dang / stong pa dang snying rje la sogs pa gsungs la/ rdo rje theg pa las bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim sogs gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/

gsang sngags la yang sku dang ye shes kyi dbye ba sogs gsungs pa'i phyir te/ 'jam dpal sgyu dra las/ pha rol phyin pa bcu yi tshul/ /mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste/ /sa bcu la ni gnas pa po/ /shes bcu rnam dag bdag nyid can/ zhes dang / rgyud las/ stong nyid snying rje tha dad med/ /gang du sems ni rnam bsgom pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun gyi yang bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ kha cig gsang sngags kyi theg pa de pha rol tu phyin pa las khyad chos bzhis khyad par du 'phags pa ma yin te/ khyad par gyi chos bzhi po de pha rol tu phyin pa la yang yod pa'i phyir/ ji ltar zhe na/ lam la ni rmongs ma rmongs kyi tha snyad med cing / gang zag la ni de gnyis ka la rmongs ma rmongs gnyis gnyis yod la/ thabs kyang phar phyin drug dang / bsdu dngos bzhi sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod cing / dka' ba med pa'ang pha rol tu phyin pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags bud med brgyad khri bzhi stong dang thabs gcig tu 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas rtse dga' zhing spyod do/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu yang tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya dang thabs gcig go /zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa' la la ni bu dang chung ma gdon mi za bar dgos so/ /zhes pa dang / dbang po rnon po yang mdo las/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ 'dod na zhag bdun gyis kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ khyad par bzhi po cha 'dra ba tsam pha rol tu phyin pa ba la yod kyang / thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos bzhi po de gsang sngags kho na la yod pas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ spyir dbang po rno rtul gyi khyad par/ nyan rang dbang rtul phar phyin pa dbang 'bring / gsang sngags pa dbang rnon du bshad kyang / skabs 'di'i rmongs pa de chos nyid dpe'i tshul gyis mngon sum du ma mthong ba la bshad pas/

phar phyin theg pa ba'i lugs la so so'i skye bo'i gnas skabs su de mthong ba med pas lta ba rtogs tshul la rmongs par bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir dang / phar phyin theg pa bas thabs lam de dag gsang sngags la yod pa'i steng du de las ches khyad par 'phags pa phar phyin theg pa ba la med pa'i thabs tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i phyir dang / chos 'phags ni gzungs thob pa'i 'phags pa yin la/ rtag tu ngu yang nam mkha' las sgra thos pa'i tshe tshogs lam pa/ dka' ba spyod pa na sbyor lam pa/ 'gro 'ong med pa thob pa na mthong lam pa yin pas lung de dag 'dod yon gyis 'phags pa 'ching mi nus shing / gzhan 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i ched tshul de bzhin mdzad pa'i don yin pa'i phyir dang / gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo yi don ni/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa sa brgyad pa yin pas/ de thob pa la bskal pa grangs med gnyis 'gor bas yun shin tu ring la/ gsang sngags kyi lugs la las dang po ba'i so so'i skye bos brtson 'grus drag zhan las/ tshe 'di'am/ bar do'am/ skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad du 'tshang rgya bas shin tu myur ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis la gang zag dbang po rno rtul gnyis gnyis yod pa dang / phar phyin theg pa ba la sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs mang po yod pa dang / de'i lugs kyi theg chen 'phags pa la 'dod yon spyod pa gnang yang / so so'i skye bo la ma gnang ba dang / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i byang sems 'dod na zhag bdun na 'tshang rgya nus pa de'i lugs la yod pa mi 'gog ste/ de dag nged kyang 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa de pha rol tu phyin pa las khyad par du 'phags pa ma yin te/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa de sde snod gsum du 'dus na/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang khyad par med la/ mi 'du na sde snod logs par 'jog dgos par 'gyur ro zhe na/

theg pa chen po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong ba la sde snod gsum dang / thun mong ma yin pa la rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces logs su bzhag kyang rung la/ sde snod gsum du bsdu na mdo sde'i sde snod yin te/ dpung bzang las/ gsang sngags mdo sde'i tshul du ngas bshad kyi/ /dpung bzang gus pa'i tshul gyis nga la nyon/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig mtshon byed dpe'i phyag chen gyi ye shes mthong lam du 'dod cing / des gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya bsgul ba sogs yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis dngos su ston mi nus pa ni lus rgyas bcings pa yin no zhe na/ de ltar na lceb rigs par 'gyur te/ shi ba na de dag ston nus pa'i phyir ro/ /rang srog bcad pa'i ltung ba 'ong ngo zhe na/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam bzod pa thob pa'ang ngan song du mi skye ba'i gdeng thob na theg chen gyi bden pa mthong ba la ltung bas ci lto ste/ las de nges par bya rigs so/ /gal te sngar thob kyang da lta nyams so zhe na/ mthong lam thob kyang nyams par 'gyur na/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags theg chen gyi sbyor lam nas thob par byams pas bshad pas bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /yang kha cig bskyed rim ni gzugs sku'i rgyu tsam yin gyi/ des grol bar mi nus la/ rtsa rlung thig le sogs mu stegs la'ang yod pas sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs ma yin la/ gsod pa dang dgug pa sogs sems can la 'tshe ba'i las yin pas mtho ris sam bde 'gro yang mi 'grub na/ byang chub lta ga la zhig ste thob par mi nus so zhe na/ bskyed rim la zhen na mchog mi 'grub par nged kyang 'dod la/ bskyed rim rdzogs rim dang zung 'jug tu bsgom shes na grol bar rgyud sde las bshad de/ bskyed rim la brten nas sa drug gi rtogs pa mngon du byed nus par bshad pa'i phyir/ rtsa rlung thig le sogs mu stegs la yod kyang thabs kyis ma zin pas 'ching byed du song ba yin la/

'dir rnam par mi rtog pa'i thabs kyis zin pas sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs su shin tu'ang 'gyur te/ bskyed rim rlung dang gtum mo sogs/ /rim pa gnyis las tha dad min/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis de dag rdzogs rim zab mo'i nyams len du bshad pa'i phyir/ gsod pa dang / dgug pa sogs gang zag mchog ma yin pas rang 'dod kyis byas na 'tshe bar 'gyur ba nged kyang 'dod la/ gang zag mchog gam mchog ma yin kyang / bstan pa gces par 'dzin pa'i blos bya ba ni rdo rje theg par ma zad/ pha rol tu phyin pa bas kyang sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs su 'dod de/ rgyud las/ sems can gnod pa'i bya ba ni/ /nam yang bya ba ma yin no/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed na/ /bzod pa bsgom par mi bya 'o/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ ji ltar grong khyer skye bo'i mi gtsang lud/ /de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos rnams bskyed la phan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig gsang sngags pa dbang po rno bas tshe 'di'am bar dor 'bras bu 'grub na ha cang myur ches pas 'bras bu dman par 'gyur te/ nyan thos kyi byang chub bsgrub pa la yang srid pa gsum dgos na 'bras bu mchog sangs rgyas sgrub pa la dka' ba sna tshogs kyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che yun ring po bsgrub dgos pa lta smos kyang ci dgos pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ 'di'i lan la slob dpon kha cig tshe gcig la 'grub par gsungs pa ni/ bla med kyi lam la brten nas tshe 'di nyid la sa dang po thob pa la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'jog pas/ phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub kyi ma mtha' sa dang po nas 'jog ces bshad la/ slob dpon dpal dbyangs kyi bzhed pa ni/ gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga yis/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin thob/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshe nyid kyis/

/sangs rgyas 'grub par bshad pa yin/ /zhes rig 'dzin gyi tshe bsgrubs nas lus de nyid kyis bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du byed pa la phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'jog pa yin zhes bzhed/ 'dir de gnyis ka bzhed pa yin te/ dpal kun tu kha sbyor dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthun par/ bcud len grub par gyur pa'i tshe 'grub bo zhes pa phyi ma dang mthun zhing / gsang 'dus las/ byang chub sems ni rgyal rgya mtsho/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe des thob/ /ces dang / slob dpon zla ba grags pas de'i 'grel par/ rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni nad med pa dang / bar chad med pa'o/ /zhes pa snga ma dang mthun pa'i phyir/ ji ltar mthun na/ bla med kyi lam la brten nas sa dang po thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des gsang sngags kyi thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par la brten nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che skad cig ma gcig la yang rdzogs par byas te sangs rgya nus shing / yun thung ngus tshogs gnyis rdzogs nus pas na rig 'dzin gyi 'chi med kyang 'grub ste/ kha sbyor las/ kha cig tu ni byang chub chen po'i sems/ /kha cig tu ni bdud las mchog tu rgyal/ /zhes dang / lus kyi sbyin pa byin nas ni/ /phyi nas spyod pa yang dag spyad/ /ces dang / rje sa chen gyis/ de bas na yun ring bas tshogs rdzogs pa ma yin te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzhin no/ /yun thung yang tshogs rdzogs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa skar rgyal tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod de skor ba bdun byas pas bskal pa dgu khri'i tshogs 'dum par bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig bya spyod gnyis rdo rje theg pa ma yin par 'gyur te/ de gnyis la khyad par 'phags chos bzhi po de med pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ bya spyod gnyis la khyad chos bzhi po de yod cing / de pha rol tu phyin pa ba la ltos na ches khyad par du 'phags la/

bla med la ltos na cung zad tsam gyis khyad par 'phags pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ kha cig na re/ gsang sngags zhes bya ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos yin mod/ de da lta spyod pa'i dus ma yin te/ slob dpon dang slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnyed dka' ba'i phyir dang / gsang sngags nas gsungs pa'i dam tshig bsrung na phan yon che yang / ma bsrung na nyes pa che ba'i phyir dang / dus snyigs pas gsang sngags spyod pa'i dus ma yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ slob dpon dang slob ma mtshan nyid mtha' dag dang ldan pa rnyed dka' yang mtshan nyid phal cher dang ldan pa rnyed sla ba'i phyir dang / gsang sngags kyi dam tshigs bsrung dka' bas gsang sngags spyod pa'i dus ma yin na/ dam pa'i chos mtha' dag nas gsungs pa'i bslab bya yang bsrung dka' bas dam pa'i chos kyang spong rigs par thal ba'i phyir dang / snyigs ma'i dus su chos gzhan pas gsang sngags 'grub sla bar bshad pa'i phyir te/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod pas/ gzhan yang phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /dus mthar dngos grub mi thob ste/ /chos 'di de ltar shes nas ni/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed yin/ /zhes dang / khrag 'thung mngon byung las/ he ru ka dpal bzung byas nas/ /snyigs ma'i dus su 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / jo bo rjes dbu ma'i bstan bcos rin po che'i za ma tog kha phye ba las/ tshogs gnyis myur tu bsdud pa dang / /sku gnyis myur du 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /gsang sngags theg pa spyad bya zhes/ /mar me mdzad dpal ye shes smra/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa gsang sngags kyi theg pa bye brag tu gtan la dbab pa la/ rgyud sde'i rab tu dbye ba dang / sngags kyi theg pa'i byung tshul rnam par bzhag pa gnyis las/ dang po la gsang sngags mtha' dag rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba/ bye brag tu bla med kyi rgyud sde'i dbye ba/ rgyud sde rnams kyi tshad bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la rje sa chen gyi rgyud sde spyi rnam ltar na phyi rol mu stegs byed la sogs pa'i spyod pa mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pas/

de dag rjes su gzung ba'i ched du rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa'i tshul/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la grub mtha' smra ba bzhi yod pas/ de dag dang lung sgo bstun nas rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa'i tshul/ 'dod pa khams pa'i sems can la 'dod chags spyod tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pas/ de dag rjes su gzung ba'i ched du rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa'i tshul/ gang zag dbang po rno rtul bzhi yod pa las/ de dag rjes su gzung ba'i ched du rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa'i tshul/ yan lag gi don dang 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa'i tshul/ rgyud sde lnga dang drug la sogs gsungs pa dang mi 'gal bar bstan pa'i sgo nas rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa'i tshul te/ 'jog tshul mi 'dra ba drug gsungs/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ rgyud sde bzhi yi dbye ba ni/ /mi rigs bzhi dang dus tshod bzhi/ /nyon mongs sgo nas bstan pa ste/ /'di ni rgyud dang mthun pa yin/ /zhes 'jog tshul gsum du gsungs kyang / 'dir rje btsun rtse mo'i spyi rnam ltar bshad na/ rgyud sde bzhi'i grangs nges pa/ go rim nges pa/ ming gi don/ rtsod pa spong ba dang bzhi las/ dang po la phyi rol mu stegs byed la log par rtog pa'i spyod pa mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pas/ de dag rjes su gzung ba'i ched du rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa'i tshul sogs gsum snga ma ltar las/ dang po la ji ltar bzhag pa'i tshul/ rgyud sde gang nas gsungs pa/ grub thob kyi slob dpon gang gi rjes su 'brang ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ spyir mu stegs byed la 'dod chags can dbang phyug gi rjes su 'brang ba 'dod chags chos smra ba dang / zhe sdang can khyab 'jug gi rjes su 'brang ba zhe sdang chos su smra ba dang / gti mug can tshangs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gti mug chos su smra ba dang / rkyen snyom pa skabs thob kyi gsum ka'i rjes su 'brangs pa dug gsum chos su smra ba dang bzhi yod pas/

de dag rjes su gzung ba'i ched du bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang bzhi gsungs pa yin zhing de yang bla med ni 'dod chags can lha chen po'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams bstan pa la kha drang ba la de dag dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa dgos pas/ de'i dbang du byas nas gsungs pa yin te/ gsang 'dus las/ phyag chen ye shes 'dod pa yis/ /rtag tu 'dod yon lnga rnams bsten/ /zhes dang / bu mo ut+pal mthing ga'i mdog /rnyed nas 'dod pas mchod par bya/ /zhes dang / bde mchog las/ sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhe sdang can khyab 'jug gi rjes su 'brangs pa 'tshe ba chos su smra ba rnams bstan pa la kha drang ba la de dag dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa dgos pas/ de'i dbang du byas nas spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs pa yin te/ khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa las/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ni/ /khro bo'i ming ni gshin rje'i gshed/ /de mthong nas ni khro bo gzhan/ /thams cad thams cad lag cha shor/ /zhes dang / e ma gsod pa 'di ni bzang / /gsod pa gsod pa ma yin te/ /ji srid gsod pa dag las grol/ /bsad pas byang chub thob par byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gti mug can tshangs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gtsang sbra chos su smra ba rnams bstan pa la kha drang ba'i ched du de dag dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa dgos pas/ de'i dbang du byas nas bya ba'i rgyud gsungs te/ legs grub las/ sha chang ke 'u btsong dang sgog rngog dang / /'bru mar til dang la phug su ra na/ /'byung po'i zas dang lha bshos gtor ma dang / /gu lang mchod byas gtor ma mi za 'o/ /nga yi mngags pa kha zas dkar gsum dang / /rtsa ba sdong bu 'bras bu'i tshod ma dang / /'bru mar tshig ma dar ba'i 'o skol dang / /thug pa rnams ni bza' btung yin par gsungs/

/zhes dang / dus su zos nas dus su khrus byas nas/ /'phreng ba mar me bdug pa bstod pa dri/ /sha chang med pa'i lha bshos phul nas ni/ /ku sha'i khri la 'dug la bzlas brjod brtsams/ /zhes dang / dpung bzang las/ bu gcig lus dag par ni bya ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa smyung ba mi gsungs te/ /bsam gtan bde ba 'grub par bya ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pas myung ba rjes su gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum ka'i rjes su 'brangs nas dug gsum ka chos su smra ba rnams bstan pa la kha drang ba'i ched du de dag dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa dgos pas/ de'i dbang du byas nas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs te/ de kho na nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi dum bu dang por 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i ched du lha thams cad chags pa'i nyams can/ dum bu gnyis par zhe sdang can rjes su gzung ba'i ched du lha thams can khro bo'i nyams can/ dum bu gsum par gti mug can rjes su gzung ba'i ched du lha thams cad zhi ba'i nyams can/ dum bu bzhi par ma nges pa'i rigs can rjes su bzung pa'i ched du lha thams cad sna tshogs pa'i nyams can du gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dbye tshul de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud la brten na khungs yod cing / gsum pa ni slob dpon rab 'byor bskyangs dang / kun dga' snying po dang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la sogs pa'ang dbye tshul de nyid bzhed par bar ma chad pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsung bgros las 'byung bas na glo bur gyi grub pa'i mtha' yang ma yin par grub pa yin no/ /'o na slob dpon de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kyi khungs gang dang 'brel ba yin zhe na/ gtam rgyud la lung khungs mi dgos pa mkhas pa spyi'i lugs yin zhing / gtam rgyud ces pa'i tshig las kyang shes nus pas/ mchu'i rnam 'gyur nyung na zhal mdzes pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la sngar ltar gsum las/

nang pa sangs rgyas pa la nyan thos tha ma gnas ma bu pa dang / 'bring nyi 'og bye brag tu smra ba gnyis ni/ mdo las/ dge slong dag khur yang yod do/ /zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas brjod du med pa'i bdag yod par 'dod la/ de dang lung sgo bstun nas rang nyid lhar bskyed pa med cing / mdun du ras bris la sogs pa dam tshig sems dpar bskyed nas/ de'i thugs kar sngags 'phreng bkod bzlas pa byed pa rje dpon lta bu la dngos grub len pa bya rgyud kyi bskyed chog gsungs pa yin te/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ bdag nyid lha'i snyems pa med pa dang / ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba med pa ni bya ba'i rgyud la zhugs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyan thos rab kha che bye brag tu smra ba dang / mdo sde pa gnyis ni/ mdo las/ las yod rnam par smin pa'ang yod/ /byed pa po ni mi dmigs so/ /zhes pa la brten nas gang zag gi bdag med kyang rdul phran dang / shes pa skad cig ma bden grub tu 'dod la/ de dang sgo bstun nas rang nyid dam tshig sems dpar bskyed/ mdun du ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas/ bdag la ma bstim par de'i thugs kar sngags 'phreng bkod de bzlas pas dngos grub sgrub pa grogs po phan tshun phan 'dogs pa lta bu spyod pa'i rgyud kyi bskyed chog gsungs te/ rab dbye las/ spyod pa'i rgyud du bris sku dang / /bdag nyid gnyis ka lhar bskyed nas/ /grogs po lta bu'i dngos grub len/ /zhes grub mtha' gzung 'dzin bden grub gnyis yod pa dang 'dra bar lha gnyis kyi bskyed chog gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa rang sangs rgyas pa dag gzung ba'i yul bden par med kyang / 'dzin byed kyi shes pa bden grub tu 'dod la/ de dang sgo bstun nas mnyam gzhag tu dam ye dbyer med du byas nas/ rjes thob tu ye shes pa gshegs pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bskyed chog gsungs te/

rab dbye las/ rnal 'byor rgyud du phyi rol la/ /dmigs kyi rkyen tsam byas nas ni/ /rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' la/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs te/ /ji srid phyag rgya ma bkrol ba/ /de yi bar du sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /phyag rgya bkrol nas sangs rgyas gshegs/ /de nas rang nyid tha mal 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ theg pa chen po dbu sems gnyis kun rdzob tu gzung 'dzin gnyis yod cing / don dam par gzung ba'i yul dang / de la bltos pa'i 'dzin byed kyi shes pa mi 'dod la/ de dang sgo bstun nas rang dam tshig par bskyed/ de la ye shes pa bcug ste dus nam yang dam ye mi 'bral ba bla med kyi bskyed chog gsungs te/ rdo rje gur gyi/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /ces sogs kyi 'grel par/ bya ba'i rgyud ces bya ba ni phyi rol brdung ma log pa'i lhar dmigs pa dang / gtsang sbra dang sdom pa la sogs pa lhur len pa'o/ /bya ba'i sbyor ba zhes pa ni/ bdag las phyi rol tu dmigs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ni/ rang gis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i ye shes dang bdag nyid ro gcig du dmigs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor bla ma zhes bya ba ni/ rang gi rig ma dang 'khyud pa las byung ba'i dga' ba mchog gi bde chen la spyod pa'o/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa zhes bya ba ni rang gi lha'i rdo rje dang pad+ma sbyor ba bde ba mchog la dmigs pa'o/ /zhes dang / rab dbye las/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du ni dag pa gsum gyi rang bzhin bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud la brten cing / gsum pa ni/ dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs dang / shān+ti pa la sogs pa bzhed pa yin no/ /mi nyag pradz+nyā dzo la'i spyi rnam dang / yi ge rnying pa 'ga' zhig las ni slob dpon tsi lu pas mdzad pa'i bka' ma lus pa la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa shes rab grub ces bya ba las kyang bshad ces 'byung ngo /

/gsum pa la sngar ltar gsum las/ dang po ni/ chags bral gyi gang zag 'dul ba'i phyir du phar phyin theg pa bstan cing / 'dod khams kyi chags can gyi gang zag 'dul ba'i ched du gsang sngags bstan pa yin la/ de dag la chags pa che 'bring gsum du yod pas de dag ma spangs par byang chub kyi lam yod par bstan pa'i phyir rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa yin te/ sam+bu ṭi las/ rgod dang lta ba lag bcangs dang / /gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang rnam pa bzhi/ /srin bu'i tshul gyi rgyud bzhir gnas/ /zhes chags pas chags pa 'joms pa shing gi srin bu dang / sdig pa'i phru gu dang 'dra bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang 'dod pa'i khams na/ mdzod las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang / dgod dang bltas pa'i 'khrig pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar 'dod chags rigs bzhi yod pa las/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa bltas pa tsam gyi chags pas tshim pa yod pas/ de'i gnyen por lha pho mo phan tshun bltas pa tsam gyis tshim pa'i dga' ba'i bde ba lam du byed pa bya ba'i rgyud gsungs te/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor lha rnams thams cad ni/ /dkar po'i ras la rtag gnas shing / /pho yang mo la lta ba dang / /mo yang pho la blta ba bri/ /zhes dang / cho ga zhib mo las/ bcom ldan khro gnyer can la bstod pa bya zhing / zhes dang / g.yas phyogs na lha mo sgrol ma 'dzems bag dang bcas shing lus btud par mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgya la mig gtod par bya'o/ /g.yon du pad+ma'i rigs mdzes ma 'dzem bag dang bcas pa gsang sngags kyi tshul dang rjes su mthun zhing don yod zhags pa la mig gtod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'phrul dga' ba bltas pa'i steng du dgod pa tsam gyi chags pas tshim pa yod pas/ de'i gnyen por lha pho mo phan tshun dgod pa tsam gyis tshim pa mchog dga'i bde ba lam du byed pa spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs te/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/

rnam par snang mdzad rgyal po che/ /yud tsam 'dzum pa'i bzhin du bri/ /de yi g.yas su lha mo ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan zhes bya ba ste/ /lha mo cung zad 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'dom gang pa/ /mtshungs med sku ni rab tu dwangs/ /de ni shākya thub pa'i yum/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang dpa' bo ni/ /pad+ma dkar po'i gdan la 'jug /dung dang kun+da zla ba 'dra/ /dbu la 'od dpag med bzhugs pa/ /bzhin ni bag tsam 'dzum par bri/ /de yi g.yas su lha mo ni/ /sgrol ma grags pa chen mo de/ /dge zhing 'jigs pa sel ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dga' ldan pa dang / 'thab bral ba blta dgod gnyis kyi steng du lag bcangs tsam gyi chags pas tshim pa yod pas/ de'i gnyen por lha pho mo phan tshun lag pa bcangs pa tsam gyis tshim pa'i khyad dga'am dga' bral gyi dga' ba lam du byed pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs te/ dpal mchog dang po las/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni lha rnams kun/ /dpung pa yid tsam bsdams par bzhag /ces dang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ lha mo rdo rje ca co sgrogs/ /dbus 'khyud rang gi lha mo de/ /de yi glo na mgo sbyar zhing / /'dzum bcas kun tu lta ba ste/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag la 'jus/ /zhes dang / yang dpal mchog dang po las/ de yi logs la rdo rje che/ /mda' ni gsor ba la brtson pa/ /bsnyems pa'i phyag gis yongs 'khyud pa'i/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan bsgrengs dang bcas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa man chad dbang po gnyis sbyor kyi chags pas tshim pa yod pas de'i gnyen por lha pho mo phan tshun snyoms 'jug tshim pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba lam du byed pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gsungs te/ kyai rdo rje las/ bho la kak+ko la sbyar pas/ /de yi bde ba shes par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dgod dang lta ba dag gi dang / /'khyud dang de bzhin gnyis gnyis kyi/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis/

/dgongs pa'i skad ni ma sbrags pa/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo mchog /spyan la sogs par bsgom par bya/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar bas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ bdag med lhan cig mnyam sbyor zhing / /dga' bas gnyis gnyis snyom 'jug pas/ /rba rlabs med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ bha gar liṅga bzhag nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis dang sam+bu ṭi la brten zhing / gsum pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa dang / slob dpon bha wa bha dra la sogs pa bzhed pa ste/ lugs 'di ni shin tu legs pa yin no/ /rje btsun rtse mo'i bzhed pa ni de tsam zhig yin la/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bzhed pas dbye tshul gsum las/ tha ma ni rtse mo'i bzhed pa phyi ma ltar yin/ dang po ni/ bram ze'i rigs/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la dga' ba dka' spyad kyis grol bar blta zhing / rigs gtso bor 'dzin pa la bzlas brjod dang sbyin sreg gis grol bar ston pa bya ba'i rgyud gsungs te/ dpung bzang las/ lus la sa yis dril phyis byas nas su/ /chu chen rnyog pa med par zhugs nas kyang / /ji tsam bar du 'dod pas khrus byas te/ /byung nas shar ram byang du kha bltas nas/ /chu yis rkang pa lag pa bkrus nas su/ /pus mo phyi rol tu ni bstan byas te/ /bar du mnyam gzhag tsog tsog pur 'dug nas/ /sgra med dbu ba med pa nye reg bya/ /zhes dang / de nas phyir yang bzlas la 'jug par bya/ /gtsang sbra la dga' zlos dga'i snying rje can/ /rtag tu len pa las ni log pa dang / /slong mo'i zas za lha yi zas la brtson/ /de yi lus la gsang sngags 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sos ka'i me chen mched pa'i me lce yis/ /ma sgrib bzhin du tshang tshing kun bsreg ltar/ /bzlas brjod me la tshul khrims rlung gis sbar/

/brtson 'grus chen po'i me lces sdig pa bsreg /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang rje rigs dka' thub dka' spyad drag po mi nus shing / smad pa'i las la mi 'jug pa rnams la phyi'i gtsang sbra la sogs pa gtso bor byed pa smad nas/ nang thabs dang shes rab kyi rnal 'byor gtso bo dang / phyi'i bya ba'ang spangs pa ma yin par bag tsam ston pa spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gcig pus gcig gam gcig gis gcig /yid kyi bzlas brjod bya ba 'am/ /yang na shu gu rnam gnyis pa/ /rnal 'byor mchog gis rtag par bya/ /sngags pa yan lag mnyam sbyar bar/ /bzlas brjod gzhan du mi bya 'o/ /phyi dang nang gi sbyor ba yis/ /yan lag bzhi pa ngas bshad pa/ /de yang 'jig rten pa yi ste/ /dmigs pa can ni bla med pa'o/ /zhes dang / yid kyi 'jig rten 'das zhes bya/ /slar bsdud la sogs rnam par spangs/ /lha dang gcig tu byed pa dang / /tha dad ma yin 'dzin pa yi/ /yid kyi rang bzhin dbyer med bya/ /gzhan du bya ba ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyal rigs dka' spyad rnams mi nus shing / 'dod yon lnga'i bde ba la spyod pa rnams rjes su gzung ba'i don du rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs te/ rgyal rigs la rgyal po dang / btsun mo dang / sras dang / gsol kha mo dang / g.yog mo dang / bran mo dang / g.yog dang / bran dang / pho nya rnams yod pa bzhin du/ dkyil 'khor la yang de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rgyal po'i tshul/ sems ma bzhi phyag rgya'i tshul sems dpa' bcu drug sras po'i tshul/ sgeg sogs bzhi btsun mo'i tshul/ me tog ma gsol kha mo/ bdug spos ma g.yog mo'i gtso mo/ mar me ma pho nya mo/ dri chab ma bran mo/ rdo rje lcags kyu g.yog po'i gtso bo/ rdo rje zhags pa gsol kha ba/ rdo rje lcags sgrog pho nya ba/ rdo rje 'bebs pa bran gyi tshul du gsungs pa'i phyir te/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa'i 'grel pa las/

dper na 'jig rten gyi rgyal po chen po la las kyi sgo 'dir smras pa thams cad dgos pa bzhin du/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po rnam par snang mdzad dang / phyag na rdo rje'i 'khor thams cad tshul de lta bur lta'o/ /zhes dang / de nyid 'dus par/ ji ltar rgyal po'i phyag rgya mchog /khrims ni 'da' dka' mi phyed bzhin/ /bdag nyid chen po'i gzugs brnyan gyis/ /mtshan ma phyag rgya zhes par grags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dmangs rigs gtsang sme med par thams cad za zhing / bya ba ngan pa thams cad byed pa/ rnam rtog shas chung pa rnams la rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgo nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa thams cad za zhing / smad pa'i las rnams kyang dgongs pa'i tshig gis ston pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gsungs te/ gsang 'dus las/ bshang gci zas su za ba ni/ /de dag sgrub pa'i snod du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / glang po'i sha dang rta'i sha /zas kyi phyir ni za bar bya/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ de nyid mnyam sbyor 'di yis ni/ /thams cad 'grub par byed pas na/ /ngan zos ngan spyod thams cad kyi/ /nyes pa dag tu yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dbye tshul 'di ni bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon a lang ka ka la shas mdzad par 'byung zhing / bde mchog gi rgyud phran zhig las kyang / bya ba bram ze'i gtsang dang bstun/ /spyod pa rje'u rigs de nas lhag /rnal 'byor rgyal po 'khor tshogs mang / /gzhi dam pa gdod nas grol ba ste/ /gzhan su la yang ma bstan par/ /mdzes ma khyod la bstan pa yin/ /zhes bshad pa'ang yod ces bu ston gsungs so/ /dbye tshul gnyis pa ni/ dus la rdzogs ldan dang / gsum ldan dang / gnyis ldan dang / rtsod ldan te bzhi yod pa'i dbang gis/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang bzhi rim pa bzhin du gsungs pa yin te/

slob dpon nag po pas gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba las/ dus ni rnam bzhi'i dbye ba las/ /rgyud ni rnam pa bzhir 'gyur te/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grangs dang go rim nges pa ni/ ci'i phyir rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges/ go rim ji lta bu zhe na/ gang zag dang / dbang dang / lam bzhir nges pas na rgyud sde bzhir nges pa ni/ dper na gzung bya yul drug yod pas 'dzin byed kyi shes pa drug tu nges pa lta bu yin la/ go rim ni snga ma snga ma dman zhing / phyi ma phyi ma mchog yin pas na dman mchog gi go rim yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ming don ni/ rgyud sde bzhi po de dag gi nges tshig ji lta bu zhe na/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang / nang ting nge 'dzin gnyis ka ston pas dang / nang ting nge 'dzin gyi bya ba kho na gtso por ston pas dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gong na med pa gtso bor ston pas na de dang de skad ces bya ste/ rim pa bzhin bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel pa las/ rgyud 'di ni phyi lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor ston pas bya ba'i rgyud do/ /zhes dang / rnam snang mngon byang gi bsdus don las/ rgyud 'di ni gtsang sbra la sogs pa la smad pa 'jig rten dang 'ga' bar spyod pas gnyis ka la spyod pa'i rgyud do/ /zhes dang / de kho na nyid snang bar byed pa'i bsdus don las/ rgyud 'di ni ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud do/ /zhes dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ gsang ba'i ye shes bla na med/ /snying po bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /zhes dang / gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /snying po bcom ldan bshad du gsol/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa rtsod pa spong ba ni/ rgyud sde bzhi kho nar grangs nges na/ thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba las/ phyi nang dbye ba shes pa yis/ /rgyud sde'i dbye ba'ang shes par 'gyur/ /zhes phyi'i rgyud dang nang gi rgyud gnyis su grangs nges par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ de ni bya spyod gnyis phyi'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gnyis nang gi rgyud du bzhag pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas/ /rgyud sde rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum du grangs nges par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na skyon med de/ ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pa rigs gcig pas rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du bsdus nas gsum du bstan pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ yang slob dpon klu sgrub kyis ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ 'dod chags las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems ston pa'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus su bha ga la bzhugs te/ 'jig rten dang 'gal ba'i spyod pa dang / mtha' drug gi spyod pa ston pa ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la bzhugs so/ /rig pa dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor la bkod de/ de las 'phrin las sgrub pa de kho na nyid bcu ston pa gnyis ka'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /las dang bya ba rgya chen po ston pa phyag rgya dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid ston pa sgrub par byed pa spyod pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /'jigs pa la dmigs te shin tu gtsang sbra dang / ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba med pa dang / bdag nyid lha'i bsnyen pa med pa dang / rmad du byung ba'i spyod yul gyi rgyu'i rtog pa rab tu spyod pa bya ba'i rgyud la bzhugs sogs/ sngags dang sbyin sreg dang / rkang mgyogs la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad spyod pas sgrub par byed pa rtog pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so/

/zhes pa la brten nas rgyud sde lngar bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ spyi'i bya ba gtso bor ston pa la dgongs nas rtog pa'i rgyud ces zur du phye ba tsam yin gyi/ ngo bo bya ba'i rgyud yin pas bzhir ma 'dus pa'i nyes pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kye rdo rje las/ dgod dang lta ba dag gi dang / /zhes rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa'i shugs la lnga pa ston pa don gyis thob pas na/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bzhi la thabs kyi rgyud dang / shes rab kyi rgyud gnyis te lngar nges par slob dpon bha dra sogs bzhed pa dang 'gal zhe na/ skyon med de/ phyi ma gnyis ka gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'dus pas bzhir nges pa'i phyir ro/ /yang bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba las/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas slob dpon ka ma la sogs mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud/ bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor gsang ba'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud de drug tu nges par bzhed pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud ces pa ni/ dngos grub phra mo gtso bor ston pa tsam la logs su byas pa yin gyi/ spyir bya ba'i rgyud yin la/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha' zhes rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud logs su smos pa ni dpal bde mchog gi che ba brjod pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ de yang bde mchog pa rnams lugs gzhan gyi sprul pa'i sku da lta mi yul na dngos su mi bzhugs par 'dod la/ bde mchog pa'i lugs kyi da lta yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi na dngos su bzhugs pas/ zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku rnams kyis rgyud byin gyis rlabs pa la brten nas/ rgyud gzhan pas dngos grub myur ba dang / rgyud gzhan rnams sngon longs skus gsungs par ma zad phyis sprul pa'i sku dang /

byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yang yang gsal bar byas pas rtogs sla ba yin la/ bde mchog ni longs skus thog mar gsungs pa kho na las/ gzhan gyis ma bcos pas brda' dang sgra skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab ste gsal bar ma byas par skad rigs gzhan dang 'gro ba gzhan gyi skad du gnas pa'am/ mi'i skad du gnas kyang brda rnying par gnas pa shas che bas/ bla ma'i man ngag ma brten par blo gros kyi rtsal gyis bshad du mi btub pas na rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa shān+ti pa lta bus kyang 'grel pa rtsom par ma nus zhes grags pa ltar rjod byed rtogs dka' bas logs su byas pa tsam yin gyi/ don la gsang ba'i ye shes bla na med pa brjod byar ston pas na bla med las gzhan ma yin no/ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde'i dbye ba la/ gsum du dbye ba/ gsum po de'i khyad par/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud bye brag tu gtan la dbab pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bla med kyi rgyud la rgya chen thabs mkhas kyi lam gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi rgyud dam pha rgyud/ zab mo shes rab kyi lam gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor chen po shes rab kyi rgyud dam ma rgyud/ de gnyis dbyer med du ston pa'am cha mnyam par ston pas gnyis med kyi rgyud dam thabs shes gnyis ka'i rgyud dang gsum du yod de/ rgya chen thabs mkhas gtsor ston pha rgyud de/ /zab mo shes rab gtsor ston ma rgyud yin/ /de de gnyis ka ston na gnyis med rgyud/ /yin phyir dges rdor gnyis med rgyud du grub/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ thabs shes dbyer med brjod byar ston pas na rnal 'byor/ rgyud thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pas na chen po/ de'i gong du rgyud gzhan med pas na bla na med pa ste/ sgra bshad de nyid rgyud gsum ka la 'jug ste/ gsang 'dus las/ e ma ho shin tu rnyed dka' ba/

/byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs 'di yin/ /rgyud kyi mchog gi mchog gyur pa/ /gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya'i rgyud/ /ces dang / rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ e ma'o mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud/ /rgyud rnams kun la dam pa ste/ /rtogs sla'ang rtogs par dka' ba dang / /rig na ma rig pa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa de gsum gyi khyad par la gleng gzhi yi ge'i khyad par/ bskyed rim lha'i khyad par/ rdzogs rim nyams len gyi khyad par/ rjes spyod rnam dag gi khyad par/ zhu ba po 'khor gyi khyad par dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i yi ge bzhi bcu nas dbu brtsams te gsungs pa'i rgyud la pha rgyud dang / gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /zhes sogs gleng gzhi'i yi ge bcu drug gis sna drangs te gsungs pa'i rgyud la ma rgyud dang de gnyis ka tshang ba'i rgyud la gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pas kyai rdo rje gnyis med kyi rgyud du grub pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las dang po/ gur las gnyis pa/ sam+bu ṭi las gnyis ka 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha yab kyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo byas shing / 'khor gyi lha pho mang ba pha rgyud/ yum gyis gtso byas shing 'khor gyi lha mo mang ba ma rgyud/ de gnyis cha mnyam pa gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni dam pa'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro lnga ni rab grub phyir/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud ces bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams ma rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro zhe na/ skyon med de/ 'jog byed gcig gnyis tsam tshang bas de dang der 'gyur ba ma yin gyi/ de dang der 'gyur ba la 'jog byed phal cher tshang dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ phra thig sogs rang byin rlabs kyi gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud dang /

dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sogs shes rab kyi lam gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud dang / de gnyis ka ston pa gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pa yin te/ gur las/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i thabs/ /rnal 'byor ma zhes mngon par brjod/ /gang phyir de nyid ston pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni rgyud ces bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ rags pa phung khams skye mched kyi rnam dag gtso bor ston pas pha rgyud dang / phra ba rtsa khams kyi rnam dag gtso bor ston pas ma rgyud/ de gnyis ka ston pas gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pa yin te/ gsang 'dus las/ mdor na phung po lnga rgyal ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yin/ /zhes dang / bde mchog las/ 'di dag gnas su mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtsa gzugs mdzes pas yang dag gnas/ /zhes dang / kye rdo rje las/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /zhes dang / rtsa ni gnyis gnyis rnal 'byor ma/ /re re'ang rnam pa rnams su brjod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ zhu ba po skyes pas gtso bor zhus pa pha rgyud/ bud med kyis gtso bor zhus pa ma rgyud/ de gnyis ka tshang ba gnyis med kyi rgyud/ dper na rtsa rgyud lta bu brtag pa dang po rdo rje snying pos zhus shing / brtag pa phyi ma bdag med mas zhus pa lta bu yin te/ gur las/ skyes bu rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni rgyud bshad do/ /btsun mo rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ gur las/ kyai rdo rje rnal 'byor rgyud/ /dang po rgyal ba rnams kyis bshad/ /phyi nas rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni/ /de nyid bud med bzung phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i don du bsams nas brtag pa dang po pha rgyud/ gnyis pa ma rgyud/ de gnyis bsdoms pas gnyis med kyi rgyud yin zhes 'dod pa ni rnam par 'khyams te/ de ltar na gsang 'dus dang /

bde mchog gnyis bsdoms pa gnyis med kyi rgyud du thal ba sogs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ gal te kyai rdo rje ma rgyud yin te/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyai rdo rje/ /zhes dang / gur las/ mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud ces bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gur las/ ma rgyud bcu bzhi bshad pa'i nang du'ang kyai rdo rje bgrangs pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ de dag ni kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gnyis med kyi rgyud yin pa'i gnad kyis zab mo shes rab kyi lam brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ des na thabs shes gnyis med kyi nang nas thabs kyi cha gtso bor ston pa pha rgyud/ de gnyis kyi nang nas shes rab kyi cha gtso bor ston pa ma rgyud/ de gnyis cha mnyam du ston pa gnyis med kyi rgyud du 'jog pa'i phyir na kyai rdo rje gnyis med kyi rgyud du grub pa yin te/ 'bum lnga'i lung rdo rje snying 'grel du drangs pa las/ thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa/ /kyai rdo rje phyogs gcig min/ /don gyi 'dus pa la sogs pa/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid do/ /zhes dang / rtsa rgyud las/ thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud/ /de ni nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ /zhes dang / gur las/ kye rdo rje rnal 'byor rgyud/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa gnyis su med pa'i rgyud bye brag tu gtan la dbab pa la/ rtsa bshad kyi khyad par/ bzhugs pa'i tshul/ mdo rgyas gzhung gi tshad rtsi ba dang bzhi las/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyud gang zhig sngon la byung ba bshad gzhir byed pa de rtsa rgyud kyi mtshan nyid/ de las dbye na rtsa rgyud rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa gnyis/ dang po ni 'bum lnga ste/ 'di la sh+lau ka 'bum phrag lnga/ brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis/ le'u stong phrag sum cu yod par bshad do/ /'o na kyai rdor rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag lnga pa yin la/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/

dpal dang ldan pa'i rigs chen rgyud/ /'bum bdun gyi ni mtshan zhes bya/ /de ni gtso bo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /sku brgyad bdag nyid rab kyi mchog /ces kyai rdor 'bum phrag bdun pa rtsa rgyud du bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ de ni gtso bo'i rtsa rgyud kyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'dir ni gur las 'bum phrag lnga yi rgya mtsho che/ /e ma rgyud ni rgyas pa bstan/ /zhes dang / stong phrag sum cu'i grangs kyis ni/ /'bum phrag lnga yi rgya mtsho che/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa bshad gnyis su phye ba'i rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag lnga kho nar nges pa'i phyir ro/ /rje btsun rtse mo ni/ rgyud rgyas pa'i brtag pa sum cu pa yan la sh+lau ka 'bum phrag lnga tshang bar bzhed la/ rje btsun chen po ni/ gur brtag gnyis kyang rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum lnga'i nang du bgrangs pas 'bum phrag lnga tshang gi de ma bgrangs na mi tshang bar bzhed pa yin te/ gur rgyan las/ rgyud rgyas pa 'bum lngar stong phrag brgyad brgyas ma tshang bar bzhugs la/ brtag pa gnyis pa sh+lau ka bdun brgya dang bdun cu rtsa bdun/ gur te gnyis bsnan pas sh+lau ka 'bum phrag lnga tshang ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa de nyid gang na bzhugs pa yin zhe na/ bu ston ni tsan+ḍa 'dar byed kyi gling na yod ces gsungs la/ slob dpon shān+ti pa ni deng sang mi snang bar byin kyis brlabs pa yin gsung ngo / /rgyud bsdus pa ni brtag pa gnyis pa ste/ 'di la brtag pa gnyis/ le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum yod do/ /'o na brtag pa gnyis pa ni rgyud logs pa zhig yin nam/ phyung ba'i rgyud yin zhe na/ bal po pham mthing pa sku mched ni rtsa rgyud bsdus pa la brtag pa bcu gnyis yod pa/ brtag pa dgu yod pa/ brtag pa gnyis yod pa dang gsum las/ 'di phyi ma de yin pas rgyud gzhan nas phyung bas phyung rgyud dang / rgyud gzhan gyi don bsdus pas bsdus rgyud lta bu ma yin par rang skya thub pa'i rgyud yin zhes bzhed pa ni 'thad pa ma yin te/

'di ni 'bum lnga'i brtag pa dang po sum cu'i brjod bya zab cing snying por gyur pa thams cad bsdus nas ston pas bsdus rgyud kyang yin la 'bum lnga'i brtag pa phyi ma gnyis zur du phyung bas phyung rgyud kyang yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsa rgyud las/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu ma'i brtag pa zhes bya ba brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis las phyung ba zhes dang / gur las/ mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /dag pa'i snying po yongs bsdus pa/ /rdo rje snying pos gsungs pa ste/ /'di ni rgyud kyi nges pa 'o/ /zhes dang / rdo rje snying 'grel las/ 'bum phrag lnga yi rgyud chen las/ /nyung ngu'i rgyud 'di legs phyung ba'ang / /brgya phrag bdun ni phyed bcas pa/ /rdo rje tshig mang bstan pa 'dir/ /zhes dang / dag ldan las/ 'gro ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang gis/ /mdo dang bya spyod rnal 'byor nyid dang ni/ /rnal 'byor mchog la dbye ba rnam gsum las/ /rab zab 'bum phrag lnga bdag kyai rdo rje/ /de yi snying po brtag pa gnyis kyi don/ /rdo rje'i tshig gyur bdun brgya lnga bcu pa/ /gang gi gsung dang bsdud par mdzad pa yi/ /zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ jo bo nā ro ta pa ni/ brtag pa gnyis pa 'di'i dbu na bzhugs pa'i 'di skad bdag gis thos pa sogs 'bum lnga'i gleng gzhi yin pas brtag pa gnyis pa 'di 'bum lnga'i brtag pa dang po gnyis zur du phyung ba yin zhing / rtsa rgyud rgyas pa la 'bum lnga yod pa ltar/ bsdus pa brtag pa gnyis pa la yang mi 'dra ba lnga yod ces bzhed pa ni 'thad pa ma yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ gong du brtag pa bcu gnyis par/ /rgyas par gsungs pa mdo ru bsdu/ /zhes dang / gong ma'i rgyud kyi chog rim las/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil gong ma bzhin/ /zhes pa dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rgyud gang zhig phyis byung ba 'chad byed du gyur pa de bshad rgyud kyi mtshan nyid/

bshad rgyud du 'gro tshul ni mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa dang / ma tshang ba kha skong ba dang / tshul mi 'dra ba dang don bsdus pa dang / cha mthun pas nges pa bskyed pa dang / tshig dang don rnam par phye bas na bshad pa'i rgyud do/ /dbye na rang gi rtsa rgyud kho na'i don gsal bar byed pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud dang / rang gi rtsa rgyud dang / rgyud sde gzhan gyi don thun mong du gsal bar byed pa thun mong gi bshad rgyud gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud lta bu yin te/ 'dis kyai rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud rgyas bsdus kho na'i don gsal bar byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sam+bu ṭi lta bu yin te/ 'dis rgyud sde du ma'i don gsal bar byed pa'i phyir/ de yang rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti ni 'di rgyud sde 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug gi bshad rgyud du bzhed la/ da lta dngos su phan 'dogs pa ni bcu bdun yod de/ pha rgyud kyi dbang du byas pa lnga/ ma rgyud kyi dbang du byas pa bcu/ yo ga'i dbang du byas pa rnams gsal bar byed pa'i phyir/ dang po lnga ni/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ rdo rje 'phreng ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ 'jigs byed rtog bdun/ gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag gi rgyud dang lnga'o/ /ma rgyud bcu ni/ rdo rje gur/ brtag gnyis/ phyag chen thig le/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ a bhi dha na/ he ru ka mngon 'byung / rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ rnam snang sgyu dra/ rdo rje gdan bzhi dang bcu'o/ /yo ga gnyis ni rdo rje rtse mo dang / de nyid 'dus pa'o/ /'o na kyai rdo rje'i rgyud la bzhi po de tsam du nges sam zhe na/ rtsa bshad gnyis su phye ba'i dbang du byas pa'i kyai rdo rje'i rgyud la bzhi po de tsam du nges la/ spyir ni ma nges te/ gtso bo'i rtsa rgyud dang / 'phros pa'i rgyud gnyis su phye ba'i tshe/ dang po ni/ kyai rdo rje 'bum phrag bdun pa yin la/

gnyis pa ni thig le skor lnga/ a ra li skor gsum rnams yin pas/ de dag rtsa bshad gnyis su phye ba'i rtsa bshad gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /thig le skor lnga ni/ ye shes thig le/ ye shes snying po/ phyag chen thig le/ gsang ba'i sgron me/ sgrub pa nges bstan te lnga yin la/ a ra li skor gsum ni/ rdo rje a ra li/ rigs kyi a ra li/ rnyog med a ra li dang gsum yin no/ /de dag kyai rdo rje'i rgyud yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud la bdun du phye nas thig le skor lnga po de 'phros rgyud gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rnyog med a ra lis kyai rdo rje'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar bstan/ rigs kyi a ra lis kyai rdo rje'i sku'i rnal 'byor gsal bar bstan pas na/ kyai rdo rje'i 'phros pa'i rgyud du grub la/ rdo rje a ra li ni de gnyis kyi shugs las kyai rdo rje'i 'phros rgyud yin par grub pa'i phyir ro/ /rje btsun kyi rgyud kyi dkar chag tu ni/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud phyag chen thig le/ rdo rje gur/ ye shes thig le/ de kho na nyid sgron ma/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid sgron ma/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag a ra li skor gsum/ mgon po mngon 'byung / thod pa brtag pa/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud/ de'i bsdus rgyud/ dbang gi don rgyud kyi dum bu/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud le'u bzhi ba rnams kyang yin par gsungs so/ /'dir kha cig kyai rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag bdun pa/ 'bring po 'bum phrag lnga pa/ bsdus pa mngon par brjod pa 'bum pa yin te/ ye shes thig le las/ ji ltar rgyud kyi rim pa bzhugs/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i zhes sogs sngar drangs pa'i tshigs bcad gcig gi mthar/ de ltag kyai rdo rje ni/ /'bum lnga yi ni mtshan zhes bya/ /zhes dang rdo rje snying 'grel las/

sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyai rdo rje nyung ngu'i rgyud 'di rgyu dang ches cher gsal ba gang / /sngon du 'bum phrag lnga po rnams kyis dang po'i rgyud tshogs su yang tshigs bcad brgya phrag gcig /stong gis bsgyur pa kyai rdo rjes mngon par brjod pa 'bum pa dang yang rgyud kyi rgyal po'i tshogs/ /gzhan du'ang mi rnams la ni rgyal bas bstan pa mdzad 'di 'grel pa rnams kyis don rtogs so/ /zhes dang / gur las/ 'bum lnga dag tu nges bsdus dang / /mtha' yas rgyud du rnam par phye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni mi 'thad de/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum phrag bdun pa ni/ kye rdo rje'i rtsa bshad gnyis su phye ba'i rtsa rgyud ma yin pa'i phyir dang / bshad rgyud gnyis de'i 'grel byed yin par ston pa'i lung tshad ldan med pa'i phyir dang / rtsa bshad gnyis su phye ba'i rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum lnga yin par gur las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na 'bum phrag bdun pa kye rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud ma yin nam zhe na/ spyir rtsa rgyud tsam ni yin te/ 'phros pa'i rgyud rnams kyi bshad gzhir gyur pa'i rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig rtsa rgyud bsdus pa 'di 'bum lnga'i brtag pa dang po gnyis yin te/ gur las/ rdo rje snying po mngon byang chub/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po nyid/ /sgyu ma'i brtag pa gnyis pa ste/ /rdo rje gar ni gsum pa 'o/ /zhes dang / gar gyi dbang phyug brtag pa ni/ /sum cur gcig gis ma tshang dang / /zhes rdo rje snying po mngon par byang chub pa'i brtag pa dang / sgyu ma'i brtag pa gnyis 'bum lnga'i brtag pa dang po gnyis yin par gsungs pa'i phyir/ brtag pa phyi ma gsum ni/ gur las/ brtag pa sum cu pa yang bshad/ /stong phrag sum cu'i grangs kyis ni/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis/ /zhes pas bstan te/ phyag chen thig le'i 'grel par/ sum cu pa ni phyag na rdo rje'i brtag pa/

so gcig pa ni mkha' 'gro brtag pa/ so gnyis pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'i brtag pa zhes bshad pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ gur gyi lung dang po ni/ 'bum lnga'i brtag pa dang po gnyis dang / brtag pa phyi ma gnyis mtshan mthun par yod pas/ de'i brtag pa dang po gnyis kyi dbang du byas gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gur gyi lung phyi ma dang / phyag thig gi 'grel pa yang / sgra rnams gang na'ang med ma yin/ zhes pa ltar/ de dang der ming btags kyang / des brtag pa phyi ma gnyis kyi mtshan rdo rje snying po mngon par byang chub pa'i brtag pa sogs ma yin par sgrub mi nus pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na phyag na rdo rje la rgyud tha dad nas mtshan sna tshogs gsungs pa ji ltar 'chad/ soms shig kha cig 'bum lnga la brtag pa sum cu las med par 'dod pa dang / kha cig rdo rje gur brtag pa so gnyis par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ kye rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bum lnga pa brtag pa chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis pa las nyung ngu'i rdzogs par byang chub pa dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i bdag nyid can gyi brtag pa gnyis pa le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi bdag nyid can phyed dang bcas pa'i bdun brgya pa'i gzhung gi tshad kyis bsdus pa'i rgyud rdo rje sems dpas yang dag par bstan te/ zhes pas dang po la gnod cing / gur las/ 'bum lnga rgyas pa'i rdo rje las/ /snying po 'di ni yongs btus pa'o/ /zhes 'bum lnga rdzogs par gsungs zin nas de las rdo rje gur btus par bshad pas phyi ma la gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bzhugs tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dang por 'bras rgyud/de nas thabs rgyud/ de nas rgyu rgyud bstan pa ni gdul bya'i gang zag 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed nas de thos pa'i ched du lam la gzhug pa'i rim pa yin te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ dang por rnam mkhyen bstan pa dang gnad 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /sam+bu ṭi las/

dang por rgyu rgyud/ de nas thabs rgyud/ de nas 'bras rgyud bstan pa ni/ mngon par rtogs pa gang zag gi rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa'am/ rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim dang / gur las go rim nges med du bstan pa ni rtog ke pa rang gar 'jug pa dgag pa'i phyir du dkrugs pa'i rim pa yin te/ rtsa bshad rnam gsum gang zag gzhug rim dang / /dkrugs dang skye ba'i rim par rim bzhin nas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa mdo rgyas ni/ rtsa rgyud gleng gzhis mdor bstan/ brtag pa dang pos rgyas par bshad/ brtag pa phyi mas shin tu rgyas par bshad pas na mdo rgyas gsum du gnas pa yin la/ gur ni le'u dang pos mdor bstan/ le'u lhag ma bcu bzhis rgyas par bshad pas mdo rgyas gnyis su gnas/ sam+bu ṭi ni/ gleng gzhis mdor bstan/ mtshan don gyis cung zad phye ste bshad/ brtag pa dang pos rgyas par bshad/ brtag pa lhag ma dgus shin tu rgyas par bshad/ rgyud phyi mas tshig don gyi cha so sor phye ste bshad pas na mdo rgyas de ltar gnas pa yin no/ /bzhi pa gzhung tshad ni/ rtsa rgyud la tshigs su bcad pa bdun brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs la/ gur la tshigs bcad stong phrag gcig dang nyer lnga sam+bu ṭi la tshigs bcad nyis stong brgyad brgya dang phyed dang bzhi yod de/ rtsa rgyud tshigs bcad bdun brgya lnga bcu ste/ /bshad rgyud rdo rje gur la stong nyer lnga/ /kha sbyor nyis stong brgyad brgya phyed bzhi yin/ /zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ tshigs bcad bgrang tshul ni gzhung tshigs bcad du yod pa rnams la rtsa ba gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa dang / drug pa rnams ni de dang de'i sh+lau ka gcig ste/ de yis bgrangs la/ gzhung tshig lhug tu gnas pa rnams tshig dgu dgu la dbang po rdo rje zhes bya la/ de bzhi la sh+lau ka gcig tu byas te bgrangs pa ni rgyud thams cad la 'dra'o/ /'o na bod na bzhugs pa'i rtsa rgyud bsdus pa 'di 'bum lnga'i brtag pa phyi ma gnyis yongs rdzogs yin nam zhe na/

rgyal po zla ba bzang po ni mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rgyud bzhin du 'dis kyang a gsum gyis mtshon pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum gyi don rdzogs par ston pas yongs rdzogs yin no zhes bzhed la/ rang lugs kyi bla ma rnams ni rdzas sbyor la brten pa'i las tshogs ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya la mkho ba'i yan lag tu ma gyur pa tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa bdun zur du phyung nas ma bsgyur bar/ rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i le'u bcu gnyis pa'i mjug tu rjes su yi rang ba'i mdo sbyar te bsgyur pa yin te/ yongs su rdzogs na tshigs bcad bdun brgya dang bdun cu rtsa bdun 'byung dgos pa las/ 'dir bdun brgya dang lnga bcu las mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes bzhed de/ dag ldan las/ gzhung brtag pa gnyis po 'di ni sh+lau ka bdun brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs la/ gzhung yongs su rdzogs na ni bdun brgya dang bdun cu rtsa bdun yin no/ /zhes gsung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rgyud rnams kyi tshad bstan pa ni/ 'o na de lta bu'i rgyud sde bzhi po re re la rgyud sde'i grangs du zhig yod ce na/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ rtog pa'i rgyud ni stong phrag bzhi'o/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyang stong phrag bzhi'o/ /spyod pa'i rgyud ni stong phrag brgyad do/ /gnyis ka'i rgyud ni stong phrag drug go /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la stong phrag bcu gnyis so/ /de ltar na stong phrag sum cu so bzhi'o/ /rgyas par na tshad med do/ /zhes rgyud sde lnga'i tshad gsungs shing / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi tshad ma gsungs la/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ rnal 'byor rgyud kun gyi ni grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni drug tu nges/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni bcu drug nges/ /de bzhin pha rol pa yi gzhung / /sa ya dang ni dung phyur lnga/ /theg chen las gzhan mdo sde rnams/ /dung phyur phrag brgyad gsungs pa yin/

/zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /grangs de dag kyang mdo sde 'am rgyud sde ming tha dad pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi tshigs bcad kyi grangs ni ma yin te/ don yod zhags pa'i mdo kho na la sh+lau ka stong phrag brgyad/ de nyid 'dus pa la stong phrag brgya/ kyai rdo rje la 'bum phrag lnga dang / 'bum phrag bdun dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la khri brgyad stong sogs re re la yang rab tu mang po yod par bshad pas na thams cad bsdoms tshad med pa zhig yod par nges pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong zhes pa yang nyan thos mos pa dman pa rnams theg chen la kha drang ba'i phyir du grangs kyi tshad byas pa yin gyi/ theg pa chen po'i lugs la bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod par shes par bya ste/ rab tu sgron gsal las/ gro ga rim pa gcig dang / shing ta la'i 'dab ma rnams spu phag bse'i mos bris pa'i tshad kyi yi ge rnams kyis gang bar byas te/ gang bar byas pa'i gro ga'i khur ji srid glang rgod kyis theg pa de ni chos kyi phung po gcig go /de lta bu'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ni nyan thos kyi sde snod kyi tshad do/ /theg pa chen po la dgu khri/ sngags kyi theg pa la stong phrag brgya yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sngags kyi theg pa'i byung tshul rnam par gzhag pa la/ gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa dang / theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dod tshul gtan la dbab pa gnyis las/ dang po la nyan thos dang / theg ches thun mong ba'i 'dod tshul ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sangs rgyas pa'i dus nam yin pa/ gnas gang yin pa/ tshul ji ltar 'tshang rgya ba/ sangs rgyas nas theg chen gyi chos 'khor bskor tshul/ mdzad pa mtha' yas pa'i tshul/ mi mjed 'jig rten kyi khams su sangs rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa'i dus sogs du ma zhig 'byung yang / mdor bsdu na dus ni bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol zhig tu sangs rgyas par cho ga ba shākya bshes gnyen ma gtogs theg chen pa thams cad mthun la/

gnas ni rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho 'khor byang sems dang bcas pa gang du bzhugs pa'i gzhi de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho zhes kyang bya/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing zhes kyang bya ba der sangs rgyas pa yin te/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ dpal ldan stug po bkod pa nyid du don dam thugs chud cing / /zhes sogs dang / grub chen kun dga' snying pos/ de nyid 'dus pa'i gleng gzhir/ bcom ldan 'das 'og min lha'i gnas na bzhugs te/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ 'og min gyi lha zhes bya ba ni thog ma'i lha zhes bya la/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sras kyi thu bo ste sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'o/ /de'i gnas ni thog mar sangs rgyas pa'i gnas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'og min de'i ngos 'dzin la kha cig gnas gtsang ma'i nang tshan gyi 'og min dang / kha cig de'i steng na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas zhes bya ba yod pas de la ngos 'dzin pa ni mi 'thad de/ de dag ni 'jig rten pa la brten pa'i mi rtag pa yin la/ stug po bkod pa ni nam yang rgyud mi chad pa'i rgyun gyi rtag pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ 'og min stug po nyams dga' ba/ /stug po'i zhing khams 'jig med pa/ /des na sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos/ /rdzogs par longs spyod tshul 'di 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na ji ltar zhe na/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams sogs du ma zhig nang du chud pa ni gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya la/ de 'dra du ma nang du chud pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho yin la/ de ni rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i phyag mthil na gnas par phal po che las gsungs te/ de'i le'u bcu gcig pa'i thog mar/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho ni de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gangs can mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyag mthil gyi snying po la rab tu gnas pa dang /

sangs rgyas kyi sku'i dbyibs ltar 'dug pa 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab ni kun tu bzang po lha'i lus kyi dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni yongs su 'dzin pa zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnas der ston pa ji ltar sangs rgyas pa'i tshul la/ phyi'i mngon byang ltar bgrod pa dang / nang gi mngon byang ltar bgrod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yo ga de nyid 'dus pa las gsungs pa ltar sems so sor rtogs pa las byang chub pa/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa las byang chub pa/ brtan pa'i rdo rje las byang chub pa/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin las byang chub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ji lta ba de ltar ro gcig pa las byang chub pa ste/ ye shes lnga mngon du byas nas sangs rgyas pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje gur las gsungs pa ltar nye rgyu'i spyod pa zhag bdun spyad pa'i mthar yul rnams kyi rlung dang / byang chub kyi sems dbu mar stobs su gyur te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya ba yin te de nyid 'dus pa las/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i zhing khams dang mnyam yang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i zhing khams de tsam zhig byang chub sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba bskal pa dpag tu med par tshogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa des zhing de tsam zhig sbyangs/ sems can de tsam zhig smin par mdzad nas/ bdag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya'o snyam nas/ dpal stug po bkod pa'i byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug nas mi g.yo ba'i bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag go /de nas zhing khams de thams cad nas de bzhin gshegs pa gang na bzhugs pa de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' de'i drung du gshegs te longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bstan nas byang chub sems dpa' de mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bslangs nas bka' stsal pa/

rigs kyi bu khyod ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya snyam pa'am zhes bka' stsal to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' langs te phyag byas nas bcom ldan 'das rnams bdag gis ma 'tshal to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de kho na nyid ji lta bu lags/ ji ltar sgrub par bgyi/ bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsung gcig tu bka' stsal pa/ rang gi sems la rtog cing zhog la/ rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i sngags ci dgar zlos shig ces bya ba la sogs pa'i lung phog cing / byang chub sems dpa' mnyam par gzhag pas/ mngon par byang chub lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyis sangs rgyas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku ni bdag legs par mthong lags so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar mngon byang lnga'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas pa des sku gsum grub ste/ mngon byang dang po dang tha mas chos sku/ gnyis pa dang gsum pas longs sku/ bzhi pas sprul sku grub pa'i phyir/ yang na dbang bzhi bskur bas sku bzhi thob par 'dod de/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ de nas sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /thugs ka nas ni byung nas ni/ /chos kyi dbang bskur bzhi po yis/ /de nas thub pa dbang bskur 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpas byas pa yi/ /byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ro/ /'bras bu byang chub sems ldan gang / /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang na dbang bzhi po nyid sangs rgyas rang snang gi sku bzhir bshad de/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur ba/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ru 'dod/ /rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ba/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru 'dod/ /rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur ba/ /de bzhin mtshan dang dpe byad do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che/

/mkha' mtshungs chos kyi snying po can/ /rdo rje las kyi dbang bskur ba/ /sprul pa yi ni sku ru 'dod/ /gsang ba bzhi yi dbang bskur ba/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob/ /de nas ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /thub ste rnam snang mdzad chen 'gyur/ /chos nyid kyang ni yang dag rtogs/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni rnam par snang mdzad dang / de'i thugs rgyud kyi chos kyi sku ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po yin te/ de nyid snang ba las/ rnam par snang mdzad dang rnam par snang mdzad chen po 'di gnyis kyi khyad par gang yin zhe na/ 'og min gyi gnas su mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i sku'i ngo bo gang yin pa de ni rnam par snang mdzad yin la/ de dang gnyis su med pa'i sems dang sems las byung ba ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na rnam par snang mdzad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung dang / rnam par snang mdzad chen po la rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung zhes bya zhing / sprul pa'i sku la de gnyis ka'i cha yod de/ gdul bya gzhan snang gi sprul sku de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung dang / sangs rgyas rang snang gi sprul sku rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar na rigs lnga/ longs sprul gnyis/ kye rdor/ bde mchog gsang 'dus sogs la sangs rgyas rang snang dang / gdul bya gzhan snang gnyis gnyis su dbye dgos shing / rang snang rnams gtso bor ye shes chos sku dang / gzhan snang rnams gang zag tu 'jog dgos pa yin te/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi gnas gyur pa sku bzhi dang / brten pa kun gzhi gnas gyur pa shin tu rnam par dag pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku yin par bshad cing / me long lta bu'i ye shes dang chos dbyings ye shes gnyis sangs rgyas rang snang gi chos sku dang /

mnyam pa nyid dang / so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes gnyis rang snang gi longs sku dang / bya ba grub pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas rang snang gi sprul skur bshad pa'i phyir/ 'o na sangs rgyas rang snang gi ngo bo nyid sku de ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid pa yin nam zhe na/ de la ngo bo nyid sku yin min gnyis su dbye dgos te/ ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid pa de yang de nyid yin mod/ kun gzhi 'dus byas yin pas/ de dri med du gnas gyur pa'i shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku de rtogs ye chos sku yin pa las 'os med pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas des chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul la nges don mi 'gyur ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / so so'i gnas su so so'i gdul bya la sprul pa mchog gis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnas 'og min stug po bkod par ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bdag nyid can des 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor tshogs nam mkha'i khams gang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor brjod kyis mi lang ba la dus rtag tu'am rgyun mi chad par chos zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i theg pa chen po gsungs pa yin no/ /gal te longs skus chos ston par rigs kyi/ chos sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa can ma yin pas/ chos ston par mi rigs so snyam na/ skabs 'di'i chos sku ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir na/ des bdag rkyen byas nas longs skus chos ston pa'am/ yang na de lta bu'i chos sku des gzugs sku'i rnam par bstan te chos ston pa la ston pa rdo rje 'chang zhes bya ste/ de nyid 'dus pa las/ e ma 'o bdag ni rang byung ba'i/ /kun tu bzang po sems dpar bstan/ /de ni bstan phyir lus min yang / /sems dpa'i lus su gyur pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/
