'o na bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis yod par 'gyur ro/ /zhe na/ de gnyis ngo bo dbyer med yin pa'i phyir ston pa gnyis su mi 'gyur zhes 'chad de/ zla gsang thig le las/ nga'ang 'dod dang gzugs mchog tu/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /ngas kyang chos kyi sku mchog tu/ /sangs rgyas thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'khor gyi sems dpa' la yang sprul pa dang / rang rgyud pa gnyis las/ sprul pa ni/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi sprul pa'i sku yin te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ e ma 'o rnam dag ye shes bdag /e ma 'o sangs rgyas nyer thob pa/ /e ma gar mkhan 'khor lo 'di/ /rang gi ye shes 'dri bar byed/ /ces dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir bu ston dang / mkhan chen gnas drug pa gnyis na re/ sngags kyi rgyud rnams longs sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can gyis gsungs pa yin te/ man ngag snye ma las/ chos kyi sku'i dbang gi gdul bya'i ngor bde mchog dang / gsang 'dus dang / kyai rdo rje la sogs pa'i gzugs kyi de lta de ltar sprul pa so sor snang ba'i phyir/ sprul pa'i sku yang ngo / /gang sprul pa'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skur pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul gsungs pa de ni 'dir yang de 'dra ba kho na ste/ sprul pa'i sprul pa bzhin yang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ skyon med de/ lung de'i don ni/ gsang 'dus sogs sprul pa mchog dang / shākya thub pa sogs sprul pa 'bring ngam tha ma zhes ston pa yin gyi/ longs sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can gyis rgyud mi gsung bar ston pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ snye ma'i so dgu par/ rig ma'i skyes bu ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste/ yang dag pa'i sbyor ba nyid kho nar gsal bar 'gyur pa'i bde ba chen po'i sku'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

rgyud der gsal bar gyur pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa yab dang zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rje re mda' ba na re/ bla med kyi rgyud rnams ni skyes bu chags can gyi don du shākya thub pa kho nas gsungs pa yin gyi/ longs skus gsungs pa ma yin te/ longs sku'i 'khor na gdul bya chags can med pa'i phyir zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud mtha' dag longs skus ma gsungs pa'i don yin na ni/ bya spyod kyi rgyud rnams 'og min du longs skus gsungs par rgyud nyid las bshad pa dang 'gal zhing / de nyid snang chen las/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis 'og min gyi gnas mngon par byang chub pa mngon du mdzad pa'i rjes thogs nyid la byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la sogs pa la thog mar gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes de nyid 'dus pa 'og min du longs skus gsungs par bshad pas kyang gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na de'i dum bu dang po 'dod chags can 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pa ma yin nam snyam na/ ma yin te/ de ni 'dod chags kyis 'dod chags dag pa'am spang ba'i phyir du gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de nyid snang chen las/ 'di ni 'dod chags kyis 'dod chags spang ba'i phyir gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ longs skus bla med kyi rgyud ma gsungs pa yang shin tu mi rigs te/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ mdor bstan pa ni sprul pa yin/ /rgyas bstan longs spyod rdzogs par brjod/ /slad rgyas bstan pa ma lus nyid/ /mya ngan 'das pas de bzhin bstan/ /zhes rtsa rgyud rgyas pa'i rgyas pa chos skus/ rgyas pa longs skus/ bsdus pa sprul skus gsungs par bshad pa dang dngos su 'gal zhing / slob dpon ka ma dhe nus brtag gnyis kyi 'grel par/ longs spyod rdzogs pa yi ni gsung la/ de yang gzugs kyi rtse mo 'og min du gnas pas/

zhes pa dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir/ skabs 'di'i gzugs kyi rtse mo ni gzugs can gyi mthar thug pa'i don yin gyi/ gnas gtsang gi 'og min la 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /gzhan du na longs skus chos gtan nas ma gsungs par 'gyur te/ mdzod las/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por gsungs pa gang zhig longs sku'i 'khor na nyon mongs can med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ ston pa mchog gi sprul skus 'khor grub pa'i sa la gnas pa yan chad la gnas ma nges pa sna tshogs su chos theg pa chen po dus rgyun mi chad par gsungs pa yin te/ gnas ri rab kyi rtse mor de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud gsungs shing / byang chub sems dpa'i lus seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud gsungs/ bcom ldan 'das rlung la bzhugs te mi g.yo ba'i rgyud gsungs/ dbang bskur khang par bzhugs te phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur pa'i rgyud gsungs/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha'i bdag po'i gnas na bzhugs te/ dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud gsungs/ gnas gtsang ma na bzhugs te/ gdan bzhi'i rgyud gsungs/ rdo rje btsun mo'i chos 'byung du bzhugs te gsang 'dus dang / kyai rdor sogs gsungs/ de bzhin du sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bkod pa mtha' yas pas/ gnas sna tshogs su mdo sde dang rgyud sde mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na sprul pa mchog gi sku dngos kyi gdul bya rnams grub pa'i sa la gnas pa yan chad kho nar nges sam zhe na/ ma nges te/ gtso bo grub pa'i sa la gnas pa yin mod/ so skye las dag pa 'ga' zhig gis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang blangs pas/ de ma thag grub pa'i sa thob pa yod par bshad pa'i phyir te/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal pa'i sprul bshad las/

khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad btsud pa las de ma thag grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang gnas gcig tu dus gcig nyid kyi tshe gdul bya mtha' yas pa la chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs te/ dgongs pa lung ston pa'i rgyud las/ rtog pa med cing 'khrug med pa/ /yid 'ongs rdo rje'i tshig gcig pu/ /gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis ni/ /bye brag mang por 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas des mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / grangs la dga' ba rjes su bzung ba'i ched du gur las mdzad pa brgyad/ phal po che sogs mdo mang po nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las mdzad pa bcu drug m+bu ṭi las mdzad pa sum cu rtsa gnyis gsungs shing / mdzad pa po ni ston pa dang / mdzad pa'i rgyud ni thugs rje chen po/ dus ni 'khor ba ji srid par/ gnas ni nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i gnas rnams su/ mdzad tshul ni sems can re re'i ched du'ang thabs tshul mtha' yas pa ste/ mdor na mdzad pa po'i thugs rje la skyo dub mi mnga' zhing / mdzad yul gyi sems can yang mu mtha' med pa'i phyir na 'khor ba ji srid par sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi chad pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas des slar yang mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams su 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa'i dus sogs bstan pa la sprul pa'i sku ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ 'khor ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ chos kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor ba'i tshul/ bka' bsdu ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ mi rnams las ji ltar 'phel ba'i tshul dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ dbus kyi gling chen po bzhi las/ lho 'dzam bu'i gling du bskal pa bzang po la ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu sangs rgyas zin kyang / slar yang ma ga dha rdo rje'i gdan du sangs rgya ba'i tshul bstan nas mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mdzad pa'i tshul ni thun mong du grags pa ltar yin pas zhib par ma bris so/

/gnyis pa 'khor la skal ba dang ldan pa'i 'khor dang / bka' bsdu ba po'i 'khor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshogs lam chen po nas sa chen po la zhugs pa'i bar skal ba mthun pa phyogs gcig tu skye ba bzung ba rnams yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams so/ /gsum pa la thun mong gi chos 'khor bskor tshul dang / thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la ji ltar bskor ba'i tshul dang / de la rtsod pa spong ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud mtha' dag shākya thub pa'i snga rol tu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul pa mchog gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor dang / grub pa'i sa la gnas pa'i 'khor rnams la gsungs zin kyang / slar shākya thub pas gsung tshul la bzlas te gsungs pa/ bzlas te ma gsungs pa/ de nyid kyi rnam 'phrul gzhan gyis gsungs pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas thun mong ba dang / lnga sde bzang po sogs 'khor thun mong ba smos pa'i rgyud rnams ni gsung gi bkod pas bzlas te gsungs pa yin la/ gnas thun mong ma yin pa/ dpal 'bras spungs kyi chod rten dang / 'khor thun mong ma yin pa rgyal po zla ba bzang po sogs smos pa ni/ sku'i bkod pas bzlas te gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nyid 'dus pa las bde mchog lta bu yin te/ de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud thog mar gsungs nas rdzogs ma thag mi'i nang du babs nas kyang zhes 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs par bshad cing / slob dpon skal ldan grags pas/ bde mchog gi 'grel pa las/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni thog ma med pa'i rgyud can yin te/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa las snga ba nyid du gnas so/ /dus kyi dbang gis bsreg pa'i bskal pa la sogs pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa nub pa na/

bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas slar yang gsungs pa yin no/ /dpal bde mchog ni de lta ma yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa na dpa' bo dang / dpa' mo la sogs pas nyams su blangs te gnas pa'i phyir ma nub ces bshad pa lta bu'o/ /'di nyid kyi rnam 'phrul gzhan gyis gsungs pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud so phal che ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de nyid kyi rnam 'phrul gzhan gyis bzlas te gsungs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur bstan nas gsang 'dus kyi rgyud gsungs/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur bstan nas gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud gsungs pa lta bu yin te/ gsang 'dus las/ de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sngon byung ba brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i bskal pa'ang 'das/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad 'das nas thub pa chen po 'od bsrung sangs rgyas pa'i bar gyis ma gsungs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba chen po'i gnas kyi don bshad pa/ de'i dus su sems can rnams skal ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud ni/ dang por longs sku/ bar du sprul pa mchog kyai rdo rje/ tha mar shākya thub pa nyid kyis 'dzam bu'i gling du bzlas te gsungs pa yin te/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i 'grel pa las/ de'i rjes su 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid du bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i don du dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud bstan pa chen po dang / chung ngu'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud dang bcas pa bstan par mdzad de/ zhes dang / slob dpon ka ma dhe nus/

'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis lo brgyad cur 'dzam bu'i gling du bzhugs pa de srid la rgyud rin po che 'di yang dang yang du ma gsungs kyi/ dus gcig na lan gcig gsungs pa kho na ste/ de bas na 'di'i dus ni dus gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud bzlas te gsungs tshul ni/ bcom ldan 'das grong khyer mnyan yod na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de nas nub phyogs su dpag tshad brgya na u rgyan kyi yul zhes bya ba yod la/ de na rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti zhes bya ba zhig yod pa des snga dro'i dus shig gi tshe/ dge slong gi gzugs du ma nam mkha' la 'gro ba mthong ste/ de dag ci yin ma shes par blon po rnams la dris pas/ de dag gis kyang ma shes par grong khyer ba la dris pas/ gcig na re/ 'di nas shar phyogs su dpag tshad sum brgya na mnyan yod ces bya bar rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i sras sangs rgyas nas bzhugs pa de'i 'khor yin no/ /zhes smras pas/ rgyal po rab tu dad de/ de'i phyogs su phyag 'tshal/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te 'dug pas mnyan yod na ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa mthong / der dad pa skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa thugs rje can rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs mnga' ba/ sang gi gdugs tshod la 'dir gshegs par gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sang gi gdugs tshod la bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa byon te/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas mchod nas gsol pa/ bdag cag srid pa'i sdug bsngal las thar bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes zhus so/ /bka' stsal pa/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung zhig dang thabs yod do/ /gsol pa/ bdag cag ni 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi gdung ba che bas/ 'di ma spangs pa nyid du thar ba'i thabs zhu'o/ /zhes gsol pa dang / de nyid kyi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo 'dod chags can de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs nas btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus su in+d+ra bhu ti la dbang bskur bas de dbang dus su grol zhing rdo rje theg pa'i chos gsungs te 'khor rnams kyang grol bar mdzad ces grags so/

/gnyis pa rtsod pa spong ba la dus dang / ston pa la rtsod pa spong ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mtshan brjod las dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis gsang sngags gsungs par bshad pa dang / gsang 'dus las/ mar me mdzad nas 'od srung gi bar gyis gsang sngags ma gsungs par bshad pa 'gal lo zhe na/ de'i lan la slob dpon zla ba grags pa ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis gsungs par bshad pa ni nges don yin la/ ma gsungs pa ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i che ba brjod pa tsam yin zhes bzhed la/ slob dpon ar+ya dā+e was spyod bsdus sgron ma las/ rdzogs ldan dang / sum ldan dang / gnyis ldan gyi dus na bstan bcos med cing rgyud yod par bshad pas gsang sngags kyi theg pa shākya thub pa'i snga rol tu yod par bzhed cing / 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis gsungs par bshad pa ni gdul bya mchog la dgongs la/ ma gsungs par bshad pa ni thun mong gi gdul bya la dgongs pa yin no/ /zhes bzhed do/ gnyis pa ni/ /shākya thub pa'i snga rol tu gsang sngags kyi lam yod na/ shākya seng ge mchog gis ni/ /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde/ /stobs chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /zhes shākya thub pa'i mtshan kho na 'byung ba ma yin nam zhe na 'byung mod/ de ni sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad da lta'i shākya thub pa dang tha dad med pa'am mtshon bla ba tsam gyi dbang du byas nas gsungs pas 'gal ba med do/ /des na gsang sngags kyi theg pa ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa nges don yin par shes dgos shing / gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ ma gsungs mi gsung gsung mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni rgyud de'i che ba brjod pa tsam yin no/ /bzhi pa bka' bsdu ba ji ltar byas pa'i tshul la zhar las byung ba nyan thos kyi bsdu ba/ theg pa chen po'i bsdu ba/ gsang sngags ji ltar bsdus pa'i tshul dang gsum las/

dang po gnyis ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa la gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa dang / rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba kha cig dpal sdom pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /lha gnas gsum du grags pa ste/ /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams na/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri bo la/ /thugs rje mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rjes snang bar byed/ /ming la skal ldan dam pa rnams/ /byang chub mchog tu 'grub 'gyur bas/ /de la rtag tu gus par byos/ zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas lo nyi shu lhag tsam na 'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs za hor gyi yul u rgyan zhes bya bar rgyal po dza'am in+d+ra bhu ti'i khang steng du glegs bam gyi char babs pa rgyal pos bltas pas shes te bsgrubs pas grub pa thob ces zer ro/ /kha cig ni rgyal pos ma shes par dge slong ku ku ri pa spyan drangs/ des gzhan ma shes rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u shes nas bsgrubs pas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mthong ste der rgyud thams cad shes nas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la bstan pas grol/ de las 'phel ba yin zer ro/ /gnyis ka mi 'thad de/ rigs pa glegs bam las blangs pa'i lam gyis grol na/ gsang sngags rang nyid len pa ni/ /'gro ba dmyal ba 'ba' zhig rgyu/ /zhes pa dang dngos su 'gal zhing / bla ma med par gsang sngags grub pa med par bshad pa dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir dang / rgyal po dza la lag na rdo rje nyid kyis gsang sngags ston par bshad pa dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams u rgyan gyi yul yin zhes pa 'jig rten gyi grags pa dang / yul gyi gnas tshul gnyis ka 'gal ba'i phyir/ 'o na rgyud de'i don ji ltar zhe na/

de'i don ni shar lho'i grong khyer pa ti kirti zhes bya bar rgyal po rab gsal zla ba la phyag na rdo rjes sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas lha gnas gsum du grags pa'i rgyud de nyid 'dus pa bstan ces pa'i don yin la/ dus ni ston pa mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad na zhes pa'i don yin no/ /gnyis pa ni 'o na gsang sngags kyi theg pa ji ltar bsdus she na/ dpal ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su gsang ba'i rgyud skal ba dang ldan pa'i sems can la sus bshad par byed bka' stsal pa/ phyag na rdo rje mgon pos bshad par byed do/ /zhes dang / gsang ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las/ gsang ba chen po'i rgyud shes pa dang / bshad pa ma 'ongs pa na sus byed/ bka' stsal pa/ byang phyogs u rgyan gyi yul dpal rdo rje chen po'i gnas su u rgyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti bya bas shes pa dang / bshad pa dang / sems can la gsal bar byed do/ /gsol pa/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti de sa du'i dbang phyug lags/ bka' stsal/ dpal ye shes thig le'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ gang zhig bstod pa/ phyag na rdo rje ye shes kyi sku sa bcu'i dbang phyug de nyid kyi sprul pa'i sku ste sa bcu'i dbang phyug go /zhes dang / phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po byin gyis brlabs nas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa rgyun mi chad par bya ba'i phyir dus kyi dbang gis skye ba yongs su bzung bar byin gyis brlabs te/ zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dbang bskur nas bstan pa gtad do/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams me tog gi snying po'i rgyan bkod pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi spyod pa bstan par smon lam btab nas gnod sbyin 'dul ba'i dbang nye bar bzung ste dbus kyi 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi mjed 'di'i lcang lo can du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po 'brog gnas kyi gnas su gnas te/

zhes dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba las/ de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'khor phun sum tshogs pa bshad par bya ste/ 'di lta ste/ 'jam dpal rgyal po zas gtsang ma zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ni lha mo sgyu 'phrul du gyur to/ /dpal lha mo ni grags 'dzin no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ni sgra gcan 'dzin no/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba ni shā ri'i bu'o/ /lha'i dbang po ni lhas sbyin no/ /kun tu bzang po ni gnas brtan kun dga' bor gyur to/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas u rgyan du bsdud pa po nang ltar na kun tu bzang po'am phyag na rdo rje/ phyi ltar na gnas brtan kun dga' bos/ dus bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su bsdu ba byas pa yin te/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti 'khor bcas grol bar mdzad nas rgyud mtha' dag phyag na rdo rje la gtad/ des rgyud mtha' dag bsdus nas rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti 'khor dang bcas pa la byin pas dngos grub thob/ 'di in+d+ra bhu ti chen po yin/ de nas ring zhig u rgyan gyi yul stongs mtsho chen po klus gang pa zhig tu gyur/ yang phyag na rdo rjes rgyud mtha' dag gser gyi glegs bam la baiḍūr+ya zhun mas yi ger bris te/ mtsho de na gnas pa'i klu rnams smin par byas te rgyud kyi glegs bam rnams gtad de nyams su blangs pas phal cher gyis grub pa thob/ ma thob pa rnams kyang mir gyur te mtsho 'gram du grong khyer byas te rdo rje theg pa nyams su blangs pas phal cher gyis grub pa thob cing / bud med phal cher mkha' 'gro mar gyur te/ dus deng sang gi bar du u rgyan mkha' 'gro ma'i gling zhes gtam du grags pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i dus su ye shes grub pa mdzad pa po'i in+d+ra bhu ti 'bring po zhes pa byon/ de'i rjes su de kho na nyid grub pa mdzad pa po'i in+d+ra bhu ti chung ngu zhes pa de byung /

'di gsum la in+d+ra bhu ti che 'bring chung gsum zhes grags shing / yul de'i rgyal po rnams kyang chos dang ldan pa sha stag yin no zhes grag go /kha cig yul der in+d+ra bhu ti'i ming yod pa'i rgyal po dgu byung zer ro/ /'on kyang yul de'i rgyal po rnams byung tshul gyi lo rgyus lhan cig skyes grub kyi 'grel pa na gsal bar bzhugs pas brtag par bya'o/ /des na blo dman pa rnams la ston pa po dang bsdud pa po tha dad du snang ba tsam yin gyi/ nges pa'i don du de gnyis gcig yin te/ dpal gsang ba grub pa las/ 'di dag bsdud par byed pa po/ /gzhan dag yod pa ma yin zhes/ /bdag nyid 'ba' zhig smra bar byed/ /rgyud mdzad pa ni thugs rdo rje/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa yul gzhan du ji ltar 'phel ba'i tshul ni/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud na rgyal po bi su bskal pa zhes bya ba nyan thos kyi theg pa la zhugs pa zhig gi rmi lam du khyod u rgyan gyi yul du song zhig skye ba 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes thos te gnyid sad pa na the tshom med par phyin nas/ u rgyan du bud med gcig dang phrad pa la rnyed bkur byas pas/ des rgyud byin gyis brlabs te/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang / de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud byin pa khyer 'ongs te lho phyogs su dar bar mdzad/ de bzhin du slob dpon ku ku ri pas mahā ma ya'i rgyud dang / la li ta badz+ra gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud spyan drangs pa sogs grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te yul dbus su dar bar byas/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud ni rngog gzhung ba'i rjes 'brangs kha cig klu sgrub glen par brdzus nas brkus so zhes pa ni shin tu mi rigs te sar gnas kyi sems dpa' la rdzu 'phrul med par brku dgos pa ga la srid cing / klu sgrub ngo mi shes pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mi srid pa dang /

rang gi lugs kun nor du song bas slob dpon dang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang / rang gi chos gsum char la skur pa btab par song ba'i phyir ro/ /des na ḍom bhi he ru ka dang / bir+wa pa spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus gnyis snang mod/ gnyis ka ltar yang 'gal ba med cing / bod kyi yul du ni lo tsā ba 'jig rten gyi mig tu gyur pa rnams kyis bsgyur te dar bar byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rgyud kyi mtshan don la/ brjod bya don gyi rgyud dang / rjod byed sgra'i rgyud gnyis las dang po ni/ rang gi sems gdod ma nas spros pa bral yang mtshan nyid gsal tsam sems can nas sangs rgyas kyi bar du rgyun ma chad cing rkyen dang phrad na 'bras bu bskyed du rung ba zhig go /de nyid thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dngos btags ma phye ba'i kye rdo rje yin la/ des rang bzhin gyi rnam par rtog pa zil gyis gnon cing / glo bur gyi rnam par rtog pa spong bar 'gyur bas na rgyal po zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de brjod byar ston pa'i rgyud kyi glegs bam lta bu yin te/ rje sa chen gyi man ngag don gsal las/ kye rdo rje rnal 'byor che'i/ /rgyud 'bum lnga don rab bsdus pa/ /stong pa snying rje gnyis su med/ /rgyud gsum ston par byed pa'i sgra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i brjod bya don gyi rgyud de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba med kyang / gnas skabs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum du yod de/ gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug dri med du gnas gyur pa na chos skur 'gyur rung zhig yin te/ kyai rdo rje las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs/

/de bsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de gzhi lam 'bras bu gnas skabs sna tshogs su 'gyur yang / sems kyi ngo bo la 'gyur ba med par rgyun ma chad pas na rgyun zhes bya ste/ gur las/ nam mkha' ji srid mi 'jig pa/ /nam mkha' ji srid de srid sems/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa thabs rgyud ni/ rgyu la gnas pa de 'bras bur 'byin par byed pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i smin grol gyi nyams len lta bu ste/ sam+bu ṭi las/ sems can ye shes spel ba'i phyir/ /thabs ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i smin grol gyi nyams len de yang gdams ngag gi rgyud pa bar ma chad pa las 'ongs shing / nyams myong ting nge 'dzin yang chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyis rgyun mi chad par nyams su len pa na rgyud ces bya ste/ sam+bu ṭi las/ bstan bcos tshad ma slob dpon dang / /lung gi rjes 'brangs de nyid rig /gsang don de nyid dngos po yang / /gcig nas gcig brgyud shes par bya/ /zhes dang / rtsa rgyud las/ chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab dang / /mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings ltar/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'bras rgyud ni/ rgyu la gnas pa 'bras bu'i ngo bor mngon du gyur pa'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu ste/ sam+bu ṭi las/ brgyad kyi rang 'dod rnal 'byor pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'bras bu'i don/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang chos kyi sku ni rang bzhin gyis 'gyur ba med pa dang / longs spyod rdzogs sku ni chos kyi longs spyod rgyun mi chad pa dang / sprul pa'i sku ni mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pas na rgyud ces bya ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rang bzhin dang ni rgyun mi chad/ /rgyun gyi de dag rtag pa nyid/ /ces dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ rtag par mdzad pa zhes bya ba dang / bcom ldan 'das ni 'og min las 'pho bar mi mdzad do/ /zhes dang /

mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gang gis srid pa ji srid pa/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyud so so'i mtshan don ni/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi sgo nas mtshan btags pa mang ste/ kyai rdo rje dang / gsang ba 'dus pa dang / yang dag par sbyor ba sogs 'bras rgyud kyi sgo nas ming btags shing thabs rgyud dang rgyu rgyud shugs la thob pa rgyud phal cher yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang de nyid 'dus pa lta bu 'bras rgyud dang / thabs rgyud gnyis ka'i sgo nas dang / legs grub lta bu thabs rgyud kho na'i sgo nas dang / dpung bzang lta bu zhu ba po'i sgo nas dang / 'bum lnga lta bu gzhung tshad kyi sgo nas btags pa sogs mtha' yas par shes par bya'o/ /kyai rdo rje'i rgyud kyi mtshan don ni 'bras dus kyi ye shes su gyur pa'i sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pa'i snying rje chen po ni kyai dang / der gyur pa'i dmigs med kyi shes rab ni rdo rje ste/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa ni 'dir dngos bstan gyi kyai rdo rje dang 'bras rgyud yin zhing / de'i shugs las bstan pa rgyu rgyud kyi kyai rdo rje nas sems can gyi rgyud kyi gsal stong zung 'jug dang / thabs rgyud kyi kyai rdo rje rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud kyi rim gnyis zung 'jug dang / gzhung kyai rdo rje ni ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs su snang ba'i kyai rdo rje'i gzhung lta bu yin la/ de ltar bzhi las/ dang po kyai rdo rje mtshan nyid pa dang / phyi ma gsum btags pa yin te/ rje btsun sku mched gnyis char gyis/ kyai rdo rje de gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni kyai rdo rje/ /bsgrub bya don dang ldan pa yi/ /gzhung lam dag la de sgra yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud ces pa'i yang dag par sbyor ba'ang 'bras bu'i rgyud yin zhing / gzhan gnyis shugs la bstan pa dang / 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa zhes pa'i 'phags pa ni spang bya sdig pa'i chos las ring du 'phags pa dang /

mkha' 'gro ma ni chos sku nam mkha' dang mnyam par 'gro zhing gzugs sku rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du khyab par nam mkha' la 'gro bas mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje ni dmigs med kyi shes rab/ gur ni dra ba'am 'brel pa ste phan tshun khyab pa'i ye shes sam thabs snying rje chen po'i cha yin la/ brtag pa ni rtog pas brtags pa ste/ de ltar na dngos bstan la 'bras rgyud dang / thabs rgyud gnyis ka yod cing / rgyu rgyud shugs la bstan pa yin te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ chos kun gzugs can ma yin yang / /gzugs can du ni 'di ru bstan/ /chos kun tshig gi spyod yul min/ /sgra ru yang ni 'di ru bstan/ /de bas ngo mtshar chos 'di la/ /rtog pas btags pa yin par brjod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar na rgyud re res kyang brjod bya don gyi rgyud gsum char brjod byar ston pa yin kyang / 'ga' zhig gis 'bras rgyud kho na dngos su bstan nas gzhan gnyis shugs la bstan pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis thabs rgyud dngos su bstan nas gzhan gnyis shugs la bstan pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis dang po gnyis dngos su bstan nas rgyu rgyud shugs la bstan pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis gsum char shugs la bstan pa sogs mtha' gcig tu ma nges la/ rgyud gsum po de dag la rgyal po zhes bya ste/ rgyu rgyud rang bzhin gyis rtog pas mi brdzi zhing / thabs rgyud kyi glo bur gyi rnam rtog spong bar byed/ 'bras rgyud glo bur gyi dri ma las grol ba'i phyir ro/ /bar 'dir gnyis pa rjod byed rgyu rgyud rgyas par bshad pa ma byung bas chad dam brtag /gsum pa rgyud 'chad thabs kyi man ngag la nyan pa pos rtogs sla zhing / gzung bde ba'i phyir gdams ngag drug gis bshad pa/ sems kyi rgyud rgyun chags gcig gtan la dbab pa'i phyir du rgyud gsum gyis bshad pa/ dbang lam du bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid can gsum gyis bshad pa/

'bras bu sku gsum lam du bya ba'i phyir gnas pa bzhis bshad pa/ spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs spong ba'i phyir dag pa gsum gyis bshad pa/ snod ma yin pa la gab cing gsang ba'i phyir gsang ba rnam pa bdun gyis bshad pa dang drug las/ dang po la spyi don du bshad pa/ sbas don du bshad pa/ mthar thug gi don du bshad pa ste/ bshad bya'i yan lag gsum dang / yig don gyi bshad pa/ yan lag gi don gyis bshad pa/ bsdus don man ngag gis bshad pa ste 'chad byed kyi yan lag gsum ste drug la gdams ngag ces bya ste/ dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ yi ge dang ni yan lag dang / /bsdus pa'i don dang spyi yi don/ /sbas dang de bzhin mthar thug par/ /rgyud rnams nges pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang spyi zhes bya ba ni thun mong ba ste/ de la phar phyin spyi dang / bskyed rim spyi gnyis/ dang po ni phar phyin drug byang phyogs so bdun/ sa bcu lam lnga la sogs pa lta bu ste/ de dag phar phyin theg pa dang / rdo rje theg pa ba gnyis char gyis shes par byas te thun mong du bslab par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni bum dbang gi lam yan lag dang bcas pa ste/ de dag mchog sgrub pa dang thun mong sgrub pa gnyis kas bslab par bya ba yin pa'i phyar te/ slob dpon zla grags kyis/ mdo sogs la ni rab zhugs pa'i/ /'gyod pa ldog par byed pa dang / /bskyed pa'i rim dang ldan pa dag /spyi yi don ni yin par bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sbas don la rang byin rlabs kyi sbas don dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i sbas don gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsang dbang gi lam yan lag dang bcas pa ste/ de dag bum dbang tsam thob pa man chad la sbas pa ste ma grags pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbang gsum pa'i lam dang bcas pa dang dbang bzhi pa'i lam yan lag dang bcas pa'ang phal cher 'dir 'dus te/ de dag gsang dbang tsam thob pa man chad la sbas pa ste ma grags pa'i phyir/

de gnyis la byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas ming btags na kun rdzob byang sems dang / don dam byang sems zhes bya zhing / thabs kyi sgo nas ming btags na rang byin rlabs kyi thabs dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs zhes bya la/ ye shes kyi sgo nas ming btags na rang byung gi ye shes dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes bya ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs dang ni/ /rang byin rlabs pa'i rim pas kyang / /kun rdzob don dam tshul can gyis/ /byang chub sems ni rab tu bskyed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ mdor na gsang ba chos kyi 'khor lo gsum la blo rtse gtad de bshad pa'i slob lam mtha' dag sbas don yin la/ dkyil 'khor gsum ni rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bha gar gsungs po nyid/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems nyid de/ /dkyil 'khor gsum ni brtag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang phyi ma la gnyis su dbye dgos so/ /gsum pa mthar thug la spyi'i mthar thug dang sbas pa'i mthar thug gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdo sngags thun mong ba'i 'bras bur bshad pa'i sa bcu gcig pa'i ye shes te/ de nyid mthar thug gi 'bras bu ma yin kyang de la nye bas der btags pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni sngags lam gyis thob pa'i sa bcu gsum pa'i ye shes lta bu ste/ de sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan zhing rang snang gi shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa sogs snga ma las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'bras dus kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na bcu gcig pa mthar thug gi 'bras bur mi rigs so snyam na/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sa dgu 'das nas ye shes ni/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu la nye bas der btags par bshad zin to/ /bzhi pa 'chad byed yan lag gi don ni/ brjod bya rtogs sla ba rnams gzhung gi dngos bstan la ji ltar yod pa'i ming tshig gi rjes su 'brangs nas 'chad/

brjod bya rtogs dka' ba rnams tshig gi 'byed sdud dang / rnam dbye byed tshig sogs kyi sgo nas so sor phye ste seng ge'i lta stangs kyis khyad par gyi gzhi blangs/ sbal pa'i 'phar bas skabs don so sor phye/ rus sbal gyi 'gros kyis tshig don ma lus par bshad/ stag mo'i mchongs stabs kyis brgal lan gyi mtha' bcad pa'i sgo nas 'chad pa zhig yin no/ /lnga pa yig don gyis bshad pa ni/ na dang ga ha dang po dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ na'i sgra las drangs te na ni na ra te mi/ ga ni gam̐ bi ste ba la zhes pa lta bu sgra drangs te bshad pa dang / gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ston pa'i yi ge hūm̐ lta bu yi ge kha phral te bshad pa dang / e wam̐ ma ya bzhi 'khor lo bzhir dngos su bshad du med kyang yi ge dbyibs mthun gyi sgo nas 'chad pa lta bu zhig yin no/ /drug pa bsdus don man ngag gi bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten la grags pa'i sgra yang ma yin/ bstan bcos la grags pa'i sgra yang ma yin pas/ yan lag gi don gyis bshad pas rtogs mi nus shing / yi ge kha phral ba dang / dbyibs mthun sogs kyi sgo nas bshad du med pas yig don gyis bshad pas kyang rtogs mi nus pa/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis brda'i sgo nas ston par mdzad pa ste/ dper na chang lta bu la 'jig rten na chang zhes grags/ bstan bcos las myos byed ces grags/ 'dir ma da na zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi brda'i sgo nas ston par mdzad pa zhig ste/ 'dir/ ma da na chang ba la sha/ /zhes pa lta bu bla ma'i man ngag kho nas 'chad dgos pa dang / dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /zhes pa lta bu la dkar mo ni gau rī ste dbang phyug chen po'i chung ma'o/ /de la brda'i sgo nas rnam par snang mdzad mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa yin la/ ri dwags mtshan ma ni zla ba ste de'i brdas bstan pa byang sems dkar pos gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa zhes pa lta bu bla ma'i man ngag la ma ltos par 'chad byed gzhan gnyis lta bus rtogs mi nus pa zhig yin te/

slob dpon zla ba grags pas/ ko ṭa k+ṣa la sogs pa'i sgra/ /'jig rten bstan bcos la med cing / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i brdar gyur pas/ /'di ni ji bzhin med par brjod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ bshad bya de gsum rim pa bzhin 'chad byed yan lag gi don gyis 'chad pa la sgra ji bzhin pa dang / nges pa'i don dang / dgongs pa can ma yin pa'i bshad pa zhes zer/ bshad bya de gsum gyi rim pa bzhin du 'chad byed yig don dang / bsdus don man ngag gang yang rung ba'i sgo nas 'chad pa la sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa dang / drang ba'i don dang / dgongs pa can gyi bshad pa zhes grags pa yin no/ /gdams ngag drug la nang gses kyis phye na bshad bya spyi don gcig sbas don gnyis/ mthar thug gi don gnyis dang lnga la 'chad byed gsum gsum sbyar bas gdams ngag bco lnga'o/ /yang na spyi don la gnyis su phye na bco brgyad 'byung ste/ mdor na bshad bya'i dbye ba lnga 'am drug /'chad byed gsum gyis phye ba'i 'chad tshul gyis/ /man ngag bco lnga bco brgyad gang 'dod byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ tshul bzhi'i sgo nas bshad pa zhes pa ni/ yig don gyi sgo nas thad sor bshad pa dang / spyi don gyis bshad pa dang / sbas don gyis bshad pa/ mthar thug gi don gyis bshad pa dang bzhi yin par ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las bshad cing / bshad thabs kyi man ngag thams cad kyang bzhi po der 'dus pa yin no/ /yang bshad bya spyi sbas mthar thug gsum so sor ston pa'i rgyud tshig de dang de 'chad byed yan lag gi don sogs skabs su gang babs de dang des 'chad pa khre'ur 'chad pa dang / nges par dngos po thams cad kyi/ /dag pa de bzhin nyid du brjod/ /ces pa lta bu rdo rje'i tshig gcig nyid rgyud gsum la sbyar nas 'chad pa dang / bdag nyid can gsum dang / gnas pa bzhi dang / dag pa gsum la sbyar nas 'chad pa lta bu la ldan par 'chad pa zhes zer zhing /

rgyud don yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur 'chad pa ni bshad bya spyi don gcig sbas don gnyis/ mthar thug gi don gcig ste bzhi rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang / yab kyi rtsa sngags lta bu rdo rje'i tshig gcig nyid kyis 'chad pa la bzhi bshad ces ngo mtshar du byed cing / bshad tshul 'di ni 'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong bi ru pa'i man ngag gi bshad srol thun mong ma yin pa las 'byung ba yin te/ spyi rnam las/ spyi dang rang byin rlabs dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i sbas pa gnyis/ mthar thug pa ste bzhi po la bzhi bshad ces ming 'dogs so/ /zhes dang / tshul 'di yi bshad pa 'di ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen pos rgyud mtha' dag de lta bu yin par khongs su chud par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyud gsum gyis bshad pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa dang / de'i chos can phung khams skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i chos sum cu rtsa lnga/ lus ngag yid gsum dang bcas pa ni rgyu rgyud/ slob lam du gyur pa'i bla med kyi nyams len thabs rgyud/ de la brten nas thob pa'i sku lnga ye shes lnga sogs mthar thug gi yon tan rnams 'bras rgyud de/ rgyud gsum du rgyud kyi dbu zhabs kyi brjod bya thams cad bsdus nas gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i rim par sbyar te 'chad par byed cing / 'chad tshul ni/ rgyud gsum po gang rung re la gzhung tshig re sbyar nas 'chad pa la khre'ur 'chad pa dang / rgyud gsum ka gzhung tshig dang sbyar nas 'chad pa la ldan par bshad pa zhes pa ni 'og ma rnams la yang sbyar bar bya ba yin te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /zhes sogs sngar drangs pa ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sbyang gzhi lus/ sbyong byed bum dbang / grol lam bskyed rim/ 'bras bu sprul sku dang bzhi ni phyi dbyibs kyi bdag nyid/

sbyang gzhi ngag sbyong byed gsang dbang / grol lam rang byin rlabs/ 'bras bu longs sku dang bzhi ni nang sngags kyi bdag nyid/ sbyang gzhi yid/ sbyong byed sher dbang / grol lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo/ 'bras bu chos sku dang bzhi ni gsang ba chos kyi bdag nyid/ sbyang gzhi snying po ye shes rlung / sbyong byed dbang bzhi pa/ grol lam rdo rje rba rlabs/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku dang bzhi ni mthar thug chos kyi bdag nyid de rgyas par na bdag nyid can bzhi yin yang phyi ma gnyis gcig tu bsdus nas bdag nyid can gsum du rgyud kyi dbu zhabs kyi brjod bya thams cad bsdus nas 'chad cing / 'chad tshul ni snga ma ltar gnyis su gnas te/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ sngags dang dbyibs dang chos bdag nyid/ /sbyor ba rnam pa gsum gyis ni/ /srid pa'i nyes pas mi gos shing / /rgyud kyi don la 'jug par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ longs spyod rdzogs sku bde ba la longs spyod pas gong bur gnas pa/ chos sku dbyings rig dbyer med du ro gcig pas chur gnas pa/ sprul sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa can gtso che bas gzugs su gnas pa/ ngo bo nyid sku gzugs las 'das pas gzugs med du gnas pa/ de bzhin du bar do'i rnam shes ma'i mngal du zhugs te thig le'i gong bu'i rnam par gnas pa/ rnam shes de khu khrag gi bar du brgyal te mer mer po sogs chur gnas pa/ dbang po rdzogs te nya dang rus sbal sogs kyi gnas skabs gzugs su gnas pa/ shi ba'i gnas skabs gzugs las 'das pa'i gzugs med du gnas pa/ de bzhin du dbang dang lam gyi bzhi bzhir gnas pas/ rgyud kyi brjod bya thams cad gnas pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad cing / 'chad tshul snga ma ltar gnyis su gnas te/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ gong bu chu dang gzugs su bcas/ /de bzhin gzugs las 'das pa yi/ /gnas pa rnam pa bzhi ru ni/ /rgyud rnams nges pa kho na yin/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas skye med yin pa de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ sems can thams cad byad bzhin yan lag sogs kyi rnam par gnas pa lha so so'i dag pa/ chos thams cad rang gi sems snang yin pa rang rig pa'i dag pa ste rgyu rgyud kyi dag pa gsum dang / gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lta ba de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ bskyed rim lha so so'i dag pa/ rdzogs rim rang rig pa'i dag pa ste thabs rgyud kyi dag pa gsum/ ngo bo nyid sku de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ gzugs sku gnyis lha so so'i dag pa/ rtogs pa ye shes chos sku rang rig pa'i dag pa ste 'bras rgyud kyi dag pa gsum yin pas dag pa gsum gyi sgo nas rgyud kyi brjod bya mtha' dag 'chad cing / 'chad tshul snga ma ltar gnyis su gnas te/ rtsa rgyud las/ nges par dngos po thams cad kyi/ /dag pa de bzhin nyid du brjod/ /phyi nas re re'i dbye ba yi/ /lha rnams kyi ni brjod par bya/ /zhes dang / rang rig bdag nyid dag pa yi/ /dag pa gzhan kyis rnam grol min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ drug pa ni/ sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud phyi ma las/ gsang ba brgyad bshad kyang dang po dang brgyad pa gcig tu byas nas bdun yin la/ de gnyis bsdoms pa rgyu rgyud dang / de kho na nyid mdor bsdus pa smin byed kyi dbang / sa bon lnga bskyed rim dam pa'i dngos po sbas pa rtogs pa'i lta ba/ gsang ba'i pad+ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo/ lte ba'i dga' ba rang byin rlabs/ thams cad du 'gro ba bsdus pa lam kyi yan lag ste gsang ba rnam pa bdun gyi sgo nas rgyud mtha' dag 'chad par byed cing / bshad tshul ni snga ma ltar gnyis su gnas te/ sam+bu ṭi rgyud phyi ma las/ gsang ba ni mi gsal ba'o/ /gsang ba ni de kho na nyid mdor bstan pa'o/ /gsang ba ni sa bon lnga'o/ /gsang ba ni dam pa'i dngos po sbas pa'o/ /gsang ba ni gsang ba'i pad+ma'o/ /gsang ba ni lte ba'i dga' ba'o/

/gsang ba ni thams cad du 'gro ba bsdus pa'o/ /gsang ba ni bde ba mtha' yas pa ste rgyud kyi gzhung gi bshad pa'o/ /zhes dang / gsang ba'i sgra ni bdun pa ste/ brgyad pa ni brjod du med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bka' srol gzhan gyi 'chad tshul la slob dpon mi thub zla ba'i 'grel pa lugs kyi 'chad tshul ni/ khyad chos gsum ldan gyi rgyal po g.yul du 'jug pa'i dpe dang sbyar nas mngon par rtogs pa yan lag lnga'i sgo nas le'u thams cad kyi 'brel rtsi bar mi thub zla ba bzhed la/ de yang ji ltar na/ mi rabs du mar rgyal po rgyun ma chad pa'i rigs su skyes pa/ gu dig la sogs pa'i skyon med pa'i lus su grub pa/ rig byed nas 'byung ba'i cho gas rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba thob pa ste khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa des rgyal po gzhan kyi yul bdag gir bya ba'am/ gzhan srid kyi g.yul ngo las rgyal bar byed pa la rang gi yul gzhan gyis 'phrog pa dang bcom pa sogs kyi nyes pa 'gog pa bsrung ba'i mi 'jog pa srid kyi yan lag pha rol gyi yul du 'gro ba la ngal dub las dbugs 'byin pa rta dang glang po sogs bzhon pa'i yan lag bsngags par 'os pa'i blon po sogs dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi 'am lnga grogs kyi yan lag g.yul las rgyal ba'i thabs kyi blo gros yid bde gros kyi yan lag gza' skar la sogs pa bdag 'phel zhing gzhan 'grib pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad shes pa dus kyi yan lag ste lnga'i sgo nas gzhan gyi yul 'phrog nas der gtogs pa'i sa dang / grogs dang nor te g.yul gyi 'bras bu gsum la dbang thob pa ltar/ rdzogs rim bsgoms pas rigs su skyes pa/ bskyed rim bsgoms pas skyon med pa'i lus su grub pa/ drod thob pas chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba ste gsum mam/ yang na shes rab dang snying rje la sogs pas theg pa chen po'i rigs su skyes pa/

rdo rje'i lus skyon med grub pa dbang rdzogs pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba thob pa ste khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa des/ mi mthun phyogs sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa'i g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa la mngon par zhen pa'i dug gis nyams len gyi yul 'phrog pa dgag pa rdzogs rim dang / lta ba srid kyi yan lag tha mal gyi rnam rtog las dbugs 'byin pa bskyed rim bzhon pa'i yan lag rtogs pa ma skyes pa bskyed cing skyes pa bogs 'byin pa lhan cig spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams grogs kyi yan lag rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i cho ga bzhin du sngags bzla ba gros kyi yan lag rtsa rlung thig le thams cad dbu mar 'jug pa'i man ngag gi gnad shes pa dus kyi yan lag ste lnga'i sgo nas mi mthun pa'i phyogs rim gyis bcom ste/ sa nang gi yul/ grogs rtsa nor dga' ba dbang du gyur nas slob lam sa bcu gnyis rim gyis bgrod nas 'tshang rgya ba yi yin te/ 'grel pa kau mu ti las/ lhan cig pa dang sgrub thabs dang / /g.yul dang dus kyi cha dag dang / /srid las nyams pa bsrung ba ste/ /sngags kyi yan lag lnga ru 'dod/ /ces dang / sa dang grogs dang nor dag ste/ /g.yul gyi 'bras bu gsum po nyid/ /gang tshe 'dir ni 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de tshe g.yul du 'jug par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bshad tshul de dang slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras kyi ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas ming dang rgyu dang rgyud mdzad pa po dang tshad dang dgos pa ste lnga ni gleng bslangs pa dang / rgyud dang gleng gzhi dang nges pa'i tshig dang rgyu ste rigs pa bzhi dang mtha' drug dang / tshul bzhi dang / bshad tshul gnyis dang / slob ma brtag pa dang / bden pa gnyis te rgyan bdun gyi sgo nas 'chad pa dang / ye shes zhabs lugs pa rnams kyi bsnyen pa/

sgrub pa/ nye bar sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po/ de thams cad kyi thun mong gi yan lag ste bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'am lnga'i sgo nas rgyud sgrub thabs ltar 'chad pa dang / bde mchog nyung ngur/ lam gyi gsang ba/ 'bras bu'i gsang ba/ de thams cad rdzogs par byed pa'i yan lag ste gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad pa sogs kyang man ngag drug po 'dir 'dus shing / drug po de la bshad thabs kun gyi nang nas rgyal po zhes snyan par yang grags pa yin te/ bshad bya spyi dang sbas pa mthar thug gsum/ /'chad byed yan lag yi ge man ngag gi /gsal bar byed 'di gdams ngag rnam drug ces/ /bshad thabs kun gyi nang nas rgyal po yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na rgyud 'chad pa po rnams la tshogs bshad dang / slob bshad ces grags pas/ de gnyis kyi khyad par ji lta bu zhe na/ bshad bya spyi don la 'chad byed gsum gang rung sbyar te bshad pa la tshogs bshad dang / bshad bya sbas don dang mthar thug gnyis la 'chad byed gsum gang rung sbyar te bshad pa la slob bshad du 'jog ste/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas sgron gsal las/ ji bzhin sgra dang dgongs min dang / /drang ba'i don du gang gyur pa/ /yi ge'i don dang spyi yi don/ /tshogs pa la ni bshad par 'dod/ /ji bzhin sgra min nges don dang / /de bzhin dgongs te bshad pa nyid/ /sbas dang mthar thug pa rnams ni/ /slob ma la ni bshad par 'dod/ /ces dang / spyi rnam las/ 'o na bshad pa gnyis gang yin na/ spyi don gnyis su 'chad lugs kyi man ngag gsum gyis rgyud mtha' dag 'chad pa ni tshogs pa la bshad pa yin la/ slob ma slob dpon du gyur pa zab cing rgya che ba'i blo dang ldan pa la bshad pa mtha' dag byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir smras pa/ bsod nams ye shes mchog gi rtser son pa'i/ /legs bshad 'od zer 'bum gyi dra ba can/ /yongs 'dzin shar ri'i phrag pa la chibs nas/ /bdag blo 'dab brgya 'dzum pa'i dpal du shar/

/rin chen gser gyi phye ma phyi snod bres/ /lan brgyar gzhal ba'i rin gyis mi thob pa'i/ /snyan brgyud rin chen phung po thang mar brdal/ /bka' drin che 'o 'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i gzugs/ /drin lan zang zing nor gyis 'jal ba na/ /nga las nu yang skrag pas glo snying 'dar/ /srid mtha'i bar du khyod kyi 'phrin las kyi/ /bran du smon pa'i 'dun pa brtan por gyur/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /bzhi pa rgyud kyi lam rim mngon par rtog pa bshad pa la/ don gnyis te/ klad kyi don dang / gzhung gi don no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mchod par brjod pa/ rtsom par dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang gsung gi rin chen gter/ /dri med rgyud don 'byed par byed pa'i ngag /rtog ge'i dug chus ma sbags de nyid don/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i gsung rab rtag tu rgyal/ /spros bral thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /lhan cig skyes pa bde ba che/ /rdo rje 'chang gtso bla chen la/ /spyi bor thal sbyar btud byas nas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje lta bu'i rgyud kyi don/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i gsal byed 'di/ /man ngag bral ba'i skye bo la/ /brtse bas gsal bor bri bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag dang bral ba'i skye bo ni/ 'og nas/ kye ma kha ba can gyi khrod 'di na/ /phal cher longs spyod rgud gyur dad pa bral/ /mu stegs 'phel zhing chos ltar bcos pa mang / /chos byed phal cher tshe 'dir spro bar mthong / /'ga' zhig rtog ge'i dug chus blo rab 'khrul/ /la la bstan bcos thos pa'i chang gis myos/ /kha cig tshul khrims mchog 'dzin kun la gshe/ /phal cher gsung rab mchog 'di spangs su dogs/ /'ga' zhig smin byed dang bral zab don bsgom/ /kha cig lag len srol nyams tshig don 'chad/ /gzhan dag cho ga ma mthong brdzun gyis bslad/ /de dag rdo rje theg pa'i gzugs brnyan yin/

/pha rol phyin gzhung thos pas yid rgyas kyang / /rgyud kyi snang bas blo gros ma brlan pa'i/ /man ngag phra mo bzung nas 'dis chog ces/ /smra ba'i rmongs rnams don med ma gyur tam/ /lam la ma zhugs log par zhugs pa dang / /rdo rje theg spangs zhugs kyang gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /de dag spong phyir bdag gis brda' sprad kyang / /byol song 'jig rten mi go ji ltar bya/ /'dir ni rgyud don yon tan rin chen gter/ /skyon med grub pa'i bla ma'i gsung gis phye/ /tshig don sgron me 'di yis gsal byas kyi/ /yon tan rin chen ji ltar 'dod pas longs/ zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum ste/ rgyu'i rgyud sngon du 'gro ba rten gyi gang zag dang / de nyams su blangs pa'i thabs kyi rgyud dang / des nyams su blangs pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /de dag gi rnam par bshad pa zhib tu ni rje btsun rin po che dpal ldan grags pa'i zhabs kyi gsung rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa las rtogs par bya zhing / 'dir de dag gi brjod bya ma lus pa 'dus pa'i don bsdus kyi tshigs bcad dang / de nyid cung zad bkrol te bshad na 'di ltar yin te/ rgyud rigs spang bya rkyen la ltos pa bzhi/ /skyabs 'gro gso sbyongs gtan khrims sems bskyed bzhi/ /bye mdo rnal 'byor spyod dang dbu ma bzhi/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med bzhi/ /bzhi bzhi bcu drug rgyu dang rim 'jug lam/ /de rjes sngags lam thog ma smin byed dbang / /lam la rtogs pa'i lta ba bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ /spyod dang nye rgyu mchog gi mngon rtogs lnga/ /bzlas dang gtor ma sbyin sreg rab gnas dang / /las tshogs rab 'byams zhes bya yan lag lnga/ /gnyis ka'i thun mong dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /thabs rgyud mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig go /gnas skabs 'bras bu slob lam sa bcu gnyis/ /mthar thug gnas yongs gyur dang ye shes sku/

/mi gnas mya ngan 'das dang gnyis su med/ /mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad dang rnam lnga 'o/ /de ltar mngon rtogs bzhi bcu rtsa lnga las/ /gtan khrims bdun dang dbang gi mngon rtogs bdun/ /so sor phye bas lnga bcu bdun du 'gyur/ /de tshe bzhi dang bcu dang bzhi dang bzhi/ /de bzhin bdun dang lnga dang lnga dang gcig /bcu gnyis lnga ste lnga bcu rtsa bdun ni/ /bshad bya mngon par rtogs pa'i lus yin no/ /zhes rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi ljon shing mdzes rgyan du gsungs pa de nyid cung zad bkrol na rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum po de nyid la dbye na/ mngon par rtogs pa'i grangs lnga bcu rtsa bdun du 'byed pa 'di yin te/ rgyu'i rgyud la rgyu la ltos pa/ rigs la ltos pa/ spang bya la ltos pa/ rkyen la ltos pa bzhi/ thabs kyi rgyud la/ skal ba dman pa rim gyis 'jug pa dang / skal ldan cig car du 'jug pa gnyis/ dang po la gnyis kyi spyod pa rim pa can la skyabs su 'gro ba/ dus tshigs kyi gso sbyongs/ so sor thar pa'i gtan khrims bdun/ dus nam skye nges pa med pa'i sems bskyed de bcu/ lta ba rim pa can la/ thun mong gi theg pa la bslab pa bye brag tu smra ba dang / mdo sde pa dang / sems tsam pa dang / dbu ma pa'i lta ba la bslab pa ste bzhi/ thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa rgyud sde bzhi la rim kyis bslab pa bzhi'o/ /cig car ba la smin par byed pa dbang dang / grol bar byed pa lam gnyis las/ dbang la sngon du bsnyen pa/ sa'i cho ga sta gon gyi cho ga dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ bsgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang pa/ gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ste bdun/ lam gyi dngos gzhi la mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa lnga/ thun mongs gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa lnga/ gnyis ka la dgos pa'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa ste bcu gcig

'bras bu'i rgyud la gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu sa bcu gnyis/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu yan lag lnga ste lnga bcu rtsa bdun no/ /yang lam gyi dngos gzhi mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig po de nyid la/ mngon par rtogs pa bcu bzhir yang mdzad de/ de ltar dbye na lam gyi gtso bo rim pa yin la/ de re re la yang yan lag drug drug ste/ rdzogs rim kyi yan lag lta ba/ spyod pa/ nye rgyu/ gnyis ka la dgos pa'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa la gsum du phye ba'i/ brtan pa thob pa dang / brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig gnyis/ las tshogs la gnyis su phye ba'i nang gi las tshogs te drug bskyed rim gyi yan lag la/ bzlas pa/ gtor ma/ sbyin sreg rab gnas/ las dang po pa'i dam tshig phyi'i las tshogs te drug go /de ltar na bcu bzhi'o/ /de la bla ma mnga' ris pa la sogs pa rnams kyis smin byed kyi dbang yan chad rten gyi gang zag rgyu'i rgyud du bsdus pa ni thabs rgyud kyi dngos gzhi rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyi rim pa gnyis yin la/ de nyams su len pa la smin dgos shing / smin pa la'ang 'ga' zhig la lta spyod rim pa can la slob dgos pa la dgongs/ spyir dbang lta bu zhig gi steng du yang rgyud gsum ka rtsir rung bas/ rnam par gzhag pa de dag mi 'gal zhing / dbye bsdu la ma rmongs par bya'o/ /de dag gi rnam par gzhag pa zhib tu bzhugs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing gi dpe phal cher la thun mong gi lta ba rim can gyi skabs nas yi ge phreng gcig tsam chad pa la bar skabs su/ kun mkhyen rin po che la/ chos rje rdo rje rgyal mtshan pas de lta'i mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing rnams kyi nang na thun mong lta ba rim can gyi skabs na/ phreng chad yig phreng gcig tsam byung 'dug pa de ci ltar yin dris pa'i lan du/ kun mkhyen rin po ches de ltar phreng chad byung ba'i nges shes kho bo la yang skyes mod kyi/

tshig dngos su ma mthong ngo gsungs pa'i phreng chad de/ dus phyis sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa chos rje glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyis sgo rum kyi rje btsun rin po che'i phyag dpe phal che la gzigs rtog gnang nas/ sngon gyi ljon shing lcags smyug gis bris pa'i rtsom gdan rang yin nam snyam pa zhig gi nang nas phreng chad de legs par rnyed de thugs dges spro tshad med pa dang bcas dpe rnying yid ches can de nyid las phreng chad kyi thad de logs su phyag bris su mdzad pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi sdug bsngal gyi chos nyid shes pa ni chos shes pa'i bzod pa yin la/ de nyid yid la nges par 'dzin pa ni shes pa'o/ /de bzhin du khams gong ma gnyis kyi'ang de bzhin du shes pa ni rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang rjes su shes pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar bden pa bzhi la bcu drug tu phye bas bco lnga ni mthong lam bcu drug pa dngos ni de las gong du bskyed du med pas sgom lam mo/ /zhes pa 'di nyid yin zhing / ljon shing gi lam gyi bcu drug ni sgom lam byang chub kyi yan lag bdun po yin no/ /zhes dang / de la dang po kho nar 'dod pa ni spyod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi chos nyid mthong ba'i zag med kyi shes pa des mthong spang gi nyon mongs spong bas/ chos shes pa'i bzod pa de rnam par grol ba mngon du byas/ zhes pa'i bar du 'jug rgyu yin no/ /zhes 'byung ba yin pas rjes 'jug rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros dang ldan zhing gsung rab kyi don la rtse gcig tu yid 'jug pa'i skye ba mang por tshogs bsags pa'i skal ba bzang po can dag gis bar skabs su byung ba'i ljon shing phreng chad can rnams la legs bshad kyi cha 'di nyid 'jug par rigs te/ mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyi som nyi'i gnas su gyur pa'i yul la the tshom ma lus pa gsal ba'i sngon med pa'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston rmad du byung ba yin pas so/

/de lta bu'i mngon par rtogs pa gang zag gi rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa ston pa rje btsun mchog gi gsung rab rin po che ljon shing gi brjod don gyi snying po rags rim tsam zhig 'dir bshad par bya ste/ de yang / rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gar+bha ri pas/ rgyu rigs spang bya rkyen la ltos/ /gang zag rnam pa bzhir ni 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can yin pa ni rgyu la ltos pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang / /zhes pa nas/ rtag tu rang bzhin bde ba can/ /zhes pa dang / rgyud bla mar/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni lag pa'i srin lag gi rtsa bar rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i dbyibs kyi ri mo yod pa sogs rtags mtshan gyi sgo nas mi bskyod sogs dang / rnal 'byor pa kha dog nag po shas che na mi bskyod pa'i rigs dang / dkar po shas che na rnam snang gi rigs yin pa sogs ni kha dog gi sgo nas rigs la ltos pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ gang gis srin lag rtsa bar ni/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa zhe sdang shas che na mi bskyod pa'i rigs dang / 'dod chags shas che na 'od dpag med kyi rigs yin pa sogs ni spang bya la ltos pa yin te/ spang bya dug lnga gang shas che ba'i sgo nas rigs de dang der 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ mtshams med lnga po gang rung byed pa lta bu yang rkyen smin grol gyi lam dang phrad na rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba ni rkyen la ltos pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ bsam pas de rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi snying po can du bstan pa ni/ 'gro sems rang bzhin spros bral chos sku'i dngos/

/'khor 'das kun khyab de bzhin nyid dbyer med/ /rigs khams chos dbyings sbyang rung du yod phyir/ /'gro kun de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can/ /de lta na yang rang gi rgyu gang gis gang du 'khor ba ni rang bzhin la/ /kun tu rmongs pa'i lhan skyes ma rig pas/ /bsgribs pa'i dbang gis sems nyid 'od gsal las/ /nyes kun rtsa ba bdag tu snang ba byung / /rkyen gang gis ji srid du 'khor ba ni/ ngar 'dzin dbang gis chags sogs nyon mongs dang / /de las las gsog las las skye ba gsog /yan lag bcu gnyis dbang gis 'khor ba ru/ /rgyun chad med par 'gro ba drug tu 'khor/ /'on kyang sems sbyangs na grol ba'i tshul/ sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' ltar/ /myang 'das dbyings su gdod nas dag pa dang / /glo bur dri ma sprin ltar bral rung phyir/ /sems nyid thabs kyis sbyangs na grol bar 'gyur/ /rigs dang spang bya la ltos pa ni/ chos nyid dbye ba med kyang chos can gyis/ /dbye bas 'bras bu myur bul rtogs bya'i phyir/ /rigs dang spang byar ltos pa'i gang zag dang / /rkyen la ltos pa ni/ rkyen 'gas cung zad 'gyangs kyang grol 'gyur zhes/ /nges phyir rkyen la ltos pa'i gang zag bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa thabs rgyud la/ skal dman rim 'jug pa bkri ba'i lam rim dang / skal ldan cig car ba bkri ba'i lam rim gnyis las/ dang po la/ spyod pa rim pa can la bslabs pa dang / lta ba rim pa can la bslabs pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa la rim gyis bslabs pa gsum gyi sgo nas shes dgos te/ rtsa rgyud las/ skal dman sems can 'dul dka' ba/ /zhes pa nas/ the tshom med/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro/ gso sbyong / gtan khrims/ dus nam skye nges pa med pa'i sems bskyed bzhi la bslabs pa yin te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ spyod pa rim pa can la bslab pa mtshams sbyar ba ni/ de ltar rgyu la gnas kyang smin grol gyi/

/lam mchog don du gnyer ba'i blo med na/ /tshe 'di'i spyod yul mi rtag par bstan pas/ /skyo ba bskyed nas rim gyis 'jug pa'i thabs/ /skyabs 'gro'i rgyu ni 'jigs dang dad pa'i sgo nas yul ni skyabs kyi mchog /dkon mchog gsum la tshul ni/ snying nas skyabs song ste/ /phan yon ni/ de yi phan yon yid la nges pa'i blos/ /bslab bya ni/ spyi dang so so'i bslab bya kun la bslab/ /sgra don ni/ tshul des 'jigs pa kun las skyob nus pa'i/ /skyabs kyi gnas su 'gro phyir skyabs 'gror brjod/ /'di la 'di la rgyu 'bras skyabs kyi dbye ba ni ston lam grogs su 'dzin pa dang / /so so'i gnas 'dod tshul gyis skyabs 'gro ba'i/ /dbye bas rgyu dang 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro gnyis/ /thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs kyi dbye ba ni/ 'bras skyabs rgyu dang dus dang dgos ched bzhis/ /thun mong thun mong min pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /de ltar skyabs su song ba'i gang zag des/ gso sbyong la ming don ni/ /dge ba gso zhing sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs/ /bslab bya ni/ bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa cho gas legs blangs nas/ /dgos pa ni/ tshul bzhin bsrungs la phan yon ches mang ldan/ /gtan khrims la gang zag ni/ ji srid 'tsho bar tshul khrims bsrung nus pa'i/ /gling gsum skyes pa'i skyes pa bud med kyis/ /bsam pa ni/ 'tshe dang ngan song 'khor ba las thar phyir/ /rab dbye ni/ skyes dang bud med so so'i bslabs pa'i tshigs/ /gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /thob byed ni/ rang rang gzhung bzhin len dang gtong rgyu ni/ gtong ba'i rgyu/ /bsrung tshul ni/ bsrung tshul phyir bcos dang bcas nges par bya/ /dus nam skye nges pa med pa'i sems bskyed ni/ de lta'i skabs su gzhan phan byang chub sems/

/theg chen rigs kyi nus pas rnyed pa'am/ /gzhan du yongs 'dzin mchog gi bka' drin las/ /dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed blangs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bye brag tu smra ba la/ dman 'bring mchog gsum las/ mchog kha che ba'i lugs ni/ mngon pa mdzod la bslabs nas shes par bya dgos te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ lta ba rim pa can bye smra'i gzhung la bslab pa'i mtshams sbyar ni/ de ltar bslabs pas spyod pa dag gyur nas/ /de nas lta ba rnam par dag bya'i phyir/ /don dngos la shes bya'i gnas dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa'o/ thog mar bye smra'i gzhung lugs nges bya ste/ /dang po shes bya'i gnas rgyas par bya ba'i tshul ni/ shes bya'i gnas ni phung po skye mched khams/ /sum cu rtsa lnga de bsdu ba'i tshul ni/ chos gnyis kyis bsdus pa/ /de yang mdor bstan pa ni/ gzugs sems sems las byung ba dang / /mi ldan 'du byed 'dus ma byas te lnga/ /rgyas par bshad pa'i gzugs kyi gzhi ni/ gzugs kyi khams na gzugs rdzas nyung mtha' drug /lus dbang ldan la bdun dang gzhan ldan brgyad/ /'dod na dri ro yod phyir nyung mtha' brgyad/ /lus dbang dbang gzhan ldan na rdzas bcu ste/ /sgra dang ldan par skye na bcu gcig go /gtso bo sems ni/ sems ni rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug ste/ /de yang gzung 'dzin tha dad dus mnyam pa/ /rnam pas bar du ma bsgribs thug phrad 'dzin/ /'khor sems byung ni sems las byung ba sems kyi sa mang dang / /dge dang nyon mongs chung rnams bcu tshan re/ /nyon mongs cha drug mi dge'i sa pa gnyis/ /ma nges brgyad dang bcas pas bzhi bcu drug /brjed ngas rnam g.yeng dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /nyon mongs can rdzas yin phyir de gnyis dang / /gti mug med dang lta ba shes bzhin min/ /shes rab rdzas yin phye na lnga bcu gcig

/sems dang sems byung rnam med rdzas grub ste/ /bdag rkyen dbang po dang bcas shes pa yis/ /yul rnams rig pa gzhan rig kho nar 'dod/ /ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed ni/ mi ldan 'du byed thob dang ma thob dang / /skal mnyam 'du shes med dang snyoms 'jug gnyis/ /srog dang skye gnas rga ba mi rtag pa/ /ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs te bcu bzhi 'o/ /'dus ma byas rtag pa'i gzhi ni/ nam mkha' gzugs can go 'byed rdzas su yod/ /so sor brtags 'gog gnyen po shes rab kyis/ /spang bya zag bcas bcom pa'i bral rdzas te/ /brtags min 'gog pa rkyen rnams ma tshang bas/ /chos 'ga' skye la gegs byed 'gog gzhan rdzas/ /de bzhin dus gsum dag kyang rdzas su 'dod/ /gnyis pa zag bcas mdor bstan ni/ lam bden ma gtogs 'dus byas zag bcas te/ /zag rnams rgyas par 'gyur phyir sdug kun gnyis/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal bden pa snod dang bcud/ /rgyu kun byung bden pa ni/ de rgyu kun 'byung la las dang nyon mongs gnyis/ las dang po/ /las kyi kun 'byung ni/ sems pa dang des byas/ /sems pa yid kyi las yin bsam pa ni/ /des bskyed lus dang ngag gi las rnams te/ /nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung ni/ rtsa nyon nye nyon no/ /gsum pa zag med la bden pa'i dbye ba'i mtshan gzhi ni/ lam gyi dmigs pa sdug kun 'gog lam bzhi/ /shes bya spang bya reg bya bsten bya ste/ /mtshan nyid ni/ mi bdag sdug bsngal stong dang bdag med pa/ /rgyu dang kun 'byung rab tu skye ba rkyen/ /'gog pa zhi ba gya nom nges par 'byung / /lam dang rigs pa sgrub pa nges 'byin du/ /'phags pas nges phyir 'phags pa'i bden par brjod/ /bden pa gnyis su dbye ba ni/ bcom dang cha shas bsal bas der 'dzin gyi/ /blo mi 'jug pa bum chu sogs kun rdzob/ /bcom dang bsal spang de yi blo 'jug pa/

/phra rab rdul dang skad cig sogs don dam/ /bden pa'i mngon rtogs skye tshul la lam spyi'i sngon 'gro ni/ bden pa'i mngon rtogs thog mar tshul khrims bsrungs/ /de yis thos bsam sngon song zhi gnas bsgrub/ /de nas so so'i skye tshul la tshogs lam ni/ lhag mthong bskyed phyir lam lngar 'jug tshogs kyi lam du dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ /mtshan nyid gnyis su shes rab kyis brtags te/ /dran pas dmigs pa dag la gtod par byed/ /sbyor lam la bzhi las dang po drod ni/ de lta'i chos dran goms pas bden pa la/ /zhi lhag zung 'brel snang ba phra thob nas/ /'phags lam snga ltas dge rtsa drod thob de'i/ /dmigs rnam bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs ldan/ /de tshe yang dag spong ba brtson 'grus bsgom/ / gnyis pa rtse mo ni/ drod gsum rim bzhin bsgoms pas bden pa la/ /dmigs pa'i zung 'brel rim gyis 'phel ba las/ /dge rtsa g.yo ba'i rtse thob de'i dmigs rnam/ /snga ma dang mtshungs rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi bsgoms/ /gsum pa bzod pa ni/ rtse mo rnam gsum 'phel las bden pa yi/ /chos nyid cha shas mthong la mi skrag pa'i/ /bzod pa gsum skye de yi chung 'bring gi /rnam pa sngar dang mtshungs te chos dran gyi/ /dmigs pa'i bden pa dag la gtod phyir ro/ /chen po 'dod gtogs sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i/ /skad cig gcig yin dbang po lnga bsgom bya/ /bzhi pa chos mchog ni/ de nas rgyu gzhan med par rang stobs kyis/ /'phags lam 'dren byed chos kyi mchog skye ste/ /dmigs rnam bzod chen dang mtshungs stobs lnga sgom/ /mthong lam la gnyis kyi bden pa'i mngon rtogs skye tshul ni/ chos mchog mjug thogs de ma thag pa ru/ /'dod pa'i sdug bsngal la dmigs chos shes pa'i/ /bzod pa skye zhing de rjes de nyid la/ /dmigs pa'i brtul zhugs chos shes skye bar 'gyur/

/de rjes khams gong sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i/ /rjes bzod rjes shes rim pa bzhin du ste/ /bden pa lhag ma rnams la'ang snga ma ltar/ /dmigs pa'i bzod shes bcu gnyis rim bzhin skye/ /de'i mtha' dpyad pa ni/ de lta'i bzod pa brgyad ni mthong spang gi /thob pa gcod la bar chad med lam ste/ /shes brgyad spang bya dang bral thob pa dang / /lhan cig skyes phyir de las rnam grol lam/ /skad cig dang po bco lnga bden pa'i rigs/ /ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam zhes bya/ /phyi ma mthong zin gom byed sgom lam yin/ /de tshe 'phags lam yan lag brgyad sgom mo/ /sgom lam ni/ de nas sgom spang gnyen po sgom pa'i lam/ /gong 'og sa la zhi rags dmigs rnam can/ /'jig rten pa yi zag bcas sgom lam dang / /bden pa la dmigs de yi rnam pa can/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i zag med sgom pa'i lam/ /de tshe byang chub yan lag bdun sgom mo/ /mthar phyin pa'i lam ni/ de nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /sgom spang spangs pa las thob rnam grol lam/ /zad dang mi skye shes pa 'khor bcas ni/ /mi slob lam ste yan lag bcu ldan no/ /de rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag gi dbye ba dngos ni/ lam la 'jug pa'i gang zag rigs can gsum/ /dang po nyid nas rang rang lam 'jug dang / /de gsum gyi 'bras bu grub pa'i dus bstan pa ni/ nyan thos sngon song sangs rgyas gnyis kyang yod/ /nyan thos myur na tshe gsum dag gis 'grub/ /bse ru bskal brgya byang sems grangs med gsum/ /tshogs bsags srid pa tha mar gyur pa'i tshe/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la brten te/ /stan gcig nyid la nges 'byed cha mthun nas/ /brtsams te so so'i byang chub bar skye byed/ /nyan thos kyi gang zag bye brag tu bshad pa la nyan thos so skye ni/ nyan thos so skye dad dang chos rjes 'brangs/ /nyan thos 'phags pa ni/ 'phags pa skyes bu zung bzhi gang zag brgyad/

/yongs nyams 'chi bar sems dang rjes su bsrungs/ /gnas las mi bskyod rtogs pa'i skal ba can/ /mi g.yo'i chos can zhes bya dgra bcom drug /gang zag gi shes pa'i dbye ba la gsum du bsdu ba ni/ shes pa kun rdzob chos rjes bcur dbye ba ni/ gzhan sems shes/ /sdug kun 'gog lam zad dang mi skye shes/ /shes pa ldan tshul la so skye dang 'phags pa la ldan tshul ni/ so skye gcig gnyis mthong sgom bdun nam brgyad/ /mi g.yo'i chos can bcu ldan sangs rgyas la yon tan ldan tshul la thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan ldan tshul ni/ sangs rgyas rnams/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs dran nyer thugs rje can/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam cha shas gsum gsum dang / /rgyu 'bras phan 'dogs phun tshogs thun mong min/ /thun mong nyan mongs med dang smon gnas shes/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi mngon shes drug /mngon shes lnga dang bsam gzugs tshad med bzhi/ /rnam thar zil gnon brgyad brgyad zad par bcu/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par bstan pa la bzhi yod pa'i dang po ming don ni/ de dag thob byed snyom 'jug ting nge 'dzin/ /yan lag dang ldan zhi lhag zung 'brel yin/ /gnyis pa rdzas su dbye ba ni/ bsam gtan snyom 'jug ces bya der skyes dang / /yon tan rten du de la 'jug pa gnyis/ /dbye na bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi/ /gzugs med yon tan rnams kyi rten yin yang / /yon tan kun gyi rten gyur bsam gtan yin/ /gsum pa grub tshul ni/ de dag zag med lam gyi ye shes dang / /ldan dang mi ldan sgom pa po'i dbye bas/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba'i 'bras bur 'gyur/ /bzhi pa rigs can grol tshul ni/ 'di dag drod nas brtsams te mi g.yo ba'i/ /chos can bar la rim gyis khyad zhugs yod/ /de yis bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten te/ /yul dang 'dus byas mtshan nyid pho mo yi/ /mtshan ma dang bral bdag med stong pa nyid/

/lam yang mdor phyir smon pa med pa ste/ /ting 'dzin de thob mya ngan 'das zhes bya/ /myang 'das gsum ga rnam grol dus 'dra yang / /shes bya'i gnas la sbyangs pa'i khyad par dang / /rjes thob bsod nams tshogs kyi bye brag gis/ /rigs can gsum gyi 'bras bu so sor 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /mdo sde pa'i lugs ni/ mdzod rang 'grel dang / mngon pa kun las btus kyi mdo sde pa'i skabs la brten nas shes par bya dgos te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de nas mdo sde pa'i gzhung la bslab pa'i mtshams sbyar ni/ de ltar bye brag smra ba'i gzhung nges nas/ /mdo sde pa yi gzhung lugs rig par bya/ /don dngos la bye brag tu smra ba sun dbyung ba la gsum gyi mdo las bstan bcos tshad mar byed pa mi 'thad pa ni/ de la snga ma'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ /mdo las bstan bcos gtsor byed rigs min te/ /gsung ba po la gus pa lhod 'gyur zhing / /bstan bcos nyid kyang mdo la brten phyir ro/ /shes bya gzhi lnga char rdzas su yod par 'dod pa mi 'thad pa ni/ mngon grub rjes su dpag pas grub min pas/ /bstan med thogs med rnam rig min gzugs dang / /mi ldan 'du byed rdzas su yod ma yin/ /'das dang ma 'ongs 'gags dang ma skyes med/ /yod na da lta nyid du thal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'dus ma byas pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rkyen gyis ma bskyed phyir na rdzas su med/ /zhar byung shes pas yul 'dzin tshul mi 'thad par bstan pa ni/ phyi rol yul gyi rnam pa ma shar bar/ /dus mnyam thug phrad 'dzin pa'ang rigs min te/ /rnam pa med na sngo ser la sogs pa/ /rtogs tshul so sor dbye bar mi nus phyir/ /rang lugs brjod pa la gsum gyi mdo'i rab tu dbye ba ni/ de nas rang lugs mdo bzhin 'chad pa la/ /bshad bya gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis te/ /de dag brjod bya'i sgo nas bslab pa gsum/

/ston phyir sde snod gsum du 'dus par 'dod/ /mdo'i don gtan la dbab pa la'ang gsum gyi ji snyed yod pa gtan la dbab pa ni/ rnam rig min gzugs mi ldan 'du byed dang / /chos kyi khams dang chos kyi skye mched kyi/ /phyogs re ma gtogs phung khams skye mched gzhan/ /mtha' dag 'dir yang rdzas su yod par 'dod/ /ji lta ba'i don gtan la dbab pa ni/ ji ltar snang ba shes pa nyid yin yang / /snang ba'i rgyu ni phyi don yin par 'dod/ /gzung 'dzin dus mnyam min phyir rang 'dzin la/ /rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed lkog na mo/ /des na shes pas don dngos ma rig kyang / /rnam pa snang ba'i dbang gis rig par bzhag /de phyir dmigs yul phyi rol don yin yang / /myong ba'i yul ni shes pa nyid yin phyir/ /ngo bo rang rig yin yang phyi rol gyi/ /don dang 'dra bar skyes phyir don rig brjod/ /de dag gi khyad par gyi chos gzhan bstan pa ni/ sems dang sems byung rang gsal skad cig ma/ /mi ldan 'du byed gzugs sems sems byung gi /gnas skabs 'ga' la btags pa tsam du 'dod/ /de bzhin 'dus ma byas kyang btags pa tsam/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang dngos por med par 'dod/ /lam dang gang zag rnam dbye phal che ba/ /bye brag smra ba'i 'dod pa dang mthun yang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la sa bcu dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas la sku gsum la sogs 'dod/ /mdo'i tshig 'chad tshul ni/ de dag ston byed mdo sde 'chad tshul ni/ /nyan po gus pa bskyed phyir dgos don bshad/ /gzhung don rags pa rtogs phyir bsdus don bstan/ /bya byed las gsum sbyar la tshig don blangs/ /snga phyi'i 'brel pa rtogs phyir mtshams sbyar nas/ /rtogs dka'i gnas rnams brgal lan sgo nas bsnyad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ sems tsam pa'i lugs ni/ byams chos phyi ma gsum dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i theg bsdus sogs la bslabs nas shes par bya dgos te/

ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung la bslab pa'i mtshams sbyar ni/ de ltar mdo sde pa yi lugs shes nas/ /rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtshor 'jug bya ste/ /dang po don dngos la gsum gyi/ dang po theg chen bkar bsgrub pa ni/ mdo sde pa rnams rang lugs theg chen du/ /bsgrub phyir shes phyin la sogs theg chen gyi/ /mdo sde phal cher bka' ru mi 'dod kyang / /de yi nyes spong 'di ltar shes par bya/ /ma 'ongs 'jigs ltar sngar lung ma bstan zhing / /che chung theg pa ston pas lhan cig gsungs/ /rgyal las gzhan gyis zab rgyas 'di yul min/ /rnam 'phrul gzhan gyi gsung yang bka' ru grub/ /theg chen yod na 'di bas gzhan med cing / /med na mdo sde gzhan la'ang tshul de mtshungs/ /zab rgyas theg pa med na sangs rgyas med/ /theg chen nyon mongs gnyen por 'gyur mthong zhing / /sgra tshogs sgra yis gsungs pa rtogs dka' bas/ /theg pa chen po rgyal ba'i bkar grub po/ /gnyis pa nyan thos kyi 'dod pa dgag pa la'ang gsum gyi/ phyi rol gyi don yod pa mi 'thad pa ni/ drug gis cig char sbyar sogs rig pa yis/ /brtags na phyi rol rdul phran rnyed ma yin/ /rdul phran mi sbyor 'dus pa sbyor zhe na/ /sbyor rgyu'i rdul phran med phyir de 'dus cing / /gzugs sogs mngon sum dag dang 'gal zhe na/ /sems nyid 'khrul pa'i snang bar lung las gsungs/ /phyi rol gyi don yod par gsungs pa dgongs pa can du bstan pa ni/ 'ga' las phyi don yod par bshad ce na/ /'jig rten gzhug phyir dgongs pa can du ste/ /de yi dgongs gzhi phyi rol gzugs sogs su/ /snang ba'i rnam rig nyid kyi sa bon dang / /snang ba tsam la dgongs nas gzugs dang ni/ /mig gi skye mched sogs su thub pas gsungs/ /khyad par can gyi chos gzhan bstan pa ni/ mi ldan 'du byed btags pa tsam du mtshungs/

/'dus ma byas chos med pa kho na'ang min/ /kun gzhi nyon mongs can yid 'jug shes drug /kun 'gro yul nges lnga lnga dge bcu gcig /rtsa nyon nye nyon nyer drug gzhan 'gyur bzhi/ /de dag kun la rig rgyu'i gzung don gzhan/ /med phyir rang rig nyid yin gzhan rig med/ /de ltar nyan thos kyi 'dod pa bkag nas/ rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa la mdor bstan pa ni/ shes bya'i gnas kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa/ dang mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid gsum dang der 'jug pa dang / /de yi rgyu phar phyin drug dang / 'bras de 'irab tu dbye ba sa bcu dang / /bslab pa gsum dang de 'i 'bras bu spangs pa phun tshogs dang / /ye shes phun tshogs theg pa mchog gyur khyad par 'phags/ /rgyas bshad la sngar gyi bcu'i mtshan nyid gsum gcig tu byas te brgyad las/ shes bya'i gnas la bzhi yod pa'i/ kun gzhi yod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ shes bya'i gnas ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ /gang de med na lus len rnam smin myong / /snyoms 'jug las ldang de bzhin 'chi 'pho dang / /skye ba la sogs mi srid skyon yod phyir/ /theg chen mdo sde kun las yod par bstan/ /de'i mtshan nyid la gnas skabs gnyis su dbye ba'i bag chags bgo ba'i gzhir gyur pa rnam smin gyi cha ni/ de la rnam smin kun gzhi zhes bya ba/ /glo bur ma yin thog med dus can khams/ /sngon bsags las kyi bag chags la brten nas/ /kun nyon chos kun skye ba'i gzhir gyur pa/ /dbang shes yul bcas snang ba'i rgyu yin te/ /snga ma'i bag chags las byung 'bras bu'ang yin/ /de la dgos pa'i gnas skabs la brtags pa'i cha ni/ de la dgos pa'i kun nyon bag chags ni/ /sa bon kun gzhi zhes bya glo bur ba/ /nus pa tsam las shes rig tu med kyang / /chu dang chu zla lta bur dbye bar dka'/ /de'i rang bzhin ni/ de ni kun 'gro dang 'grogs btang snyoms pa/

/rkyen gyis 'gyur phyir ma bsgribs lung ma bstan/ /des ni reg dang yid byed sogs bsdus nas/ /'khor bar skad cig re re bzhin 'jug la/ /de'i ldog pa'i dus la gnyis kyi sa bon gyi cha ldog pa'i dus ni/ sa bon cha ni nyan rang dgra bcom dang / /byang chub sems dpa' sa brgyad thob nas ldog /rnam smin gyi cha ldog pa'i dus ni/ rnam smin kun gzhi nyan rang lhag med dang / /theg chen me long lta bu'i ye shes su/ /gnas gyur tshul gyis ldog ces mkhas rnams bzhed/ /de dbang phyug sogs dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ kun gzhi rten cing 'brel 'byung ma rtogs na/ /gcig rtag rang dbang can du 'khrul srid kyang / /du ma mi rtag gzhan dbang can nyid phyir/ /dbang phyug rgyur 'dod sogs dang mtshungs ma yin/ /shes bya'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa la mdor bstan pa ni/ mtshan nyid gzhan dbang kun brtags yongs grub gsum/ /rgyas bshad la mtshan nyid so sor bshad pa'i gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan gyi dbang ni kun gzhi las byung ba'i/ /yang dag min rtog khams gsum pa'i shes rig /bag chags stobs kyis phung khams skye mched sogs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par snang ba gang / /kun btags kyi mtshan nyid ni/ kun brtags don la med kyang rnam rig tsam/ /de la rtogs pas bdag dang chos la sogs/ /don dang tha snyad du mar sgro btags gang / /yongs grub gzhan dbang rnam rig tsam de nyid/ /don gyi rnam pa dag dang byis pa yis/ /btags pa'i bdag dang gzung 'dzin gyis stong gang / /grub mtha'i 'dod tshul tha dad pa la/ rnam rdzun pa'i 'dod tshul ni/ gal te phyi don med na rnam rig tsam/ /gzung dang 'dzin par snang ba ci zhe na/ /rnam brdzun pa rnams sna tshogs snang ba 'di/ /bag chags kyis snang rnam pa brdzun pa ste/ /med bzhin snang ba skra shad 'dzag snang bzhin/ /gnyis med shes pa rnam pa dang bral ba/

/rang rig ye shes dam pa'i spyod yul 'dod/ /de phyir sangs rgyas thob tshe rnam pa dang / /bral ba'i rang rig ye shes bden par bzhed/ /rnam bden pa'i 'dod tshul ni/ rnam bden pa rnams sems nyid der snang phyir/ /rnam par snang ba sems su bden pa ste/ /sangs rgyas thob tshe 'di dag gnas gyur nas/ /dag pa'i snang ba nyid du 'gyur zhes zer/ /'di la gzung 'dzin sgo nga phyed tshal dang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis med sna tshogs smra ba dang / /gzung 'dzin rnam pa grangs mnyam du 'dod dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /ye shes gcig gi ngo bor bden 'dod sogs/ /rnam bden pa nyid grub mtha' mang na yang / /gzung 'dzin rnam pa dus mnyam gcer phrad 'dzin/ /gnyis med ye shes don dam myang 'das dang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis snang 'khrul pa 'khor bar 'dod/ /phyi don mi 'dod pa'i tshul ni/ de rnams mdo sde'i lung dang dngos gcig nyid/ /du mar snang ba'i rigs pas phyi don 'gog /gzhan dbang gi ming dod ni/ bag chags sa bon las skyes skad cig las/ /mi sdod phyi ma skye de gzhan gyi dbang / /kun brtags kyi ming don ni/ de la ming dang rgyu mtshan la sogs pa/ /phyin ci log tu btags pas kun brtags pa/ /yongs grub kyi ming don ni/ rnam rig de las don gyi rnam pa sogs/ /gzhan du grub pa med cing de nyid du/ /yongs su grub phyir yongs grub ces byar brjod/ /gzhan dbang gi rab dbye ni/ ma dag dag pa'i gzhan dbang rnam pa gnyis/ /rim bzhin byis pa rnams kyi gnyis snang dang / /'phags pa'i rjes las thob pa'i gnyis snang ngo / /kun btags kyi rab dbye ni/ kun brtags ngo bo khyad par kun rtog gam/ /ming la ming dang don la don du rtogs/ /gnyis ka la brten gnyis kar rtogs pa 'o/ /yongs grub kyi rab dbye ni/ yongs grub 'gyur med phyin ci ma log gnyis/

/rang bzhin dri med thob pa dang po ste/ /dmigs pa'i rnam byang zhes pa phyi ma yin/ /der 'jug pa'i tshul la bzhi yod pa'i gang zag gang 'jug pa ni/ de don rtogs phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /rgyu gang gis 'jug pa ni/ mi zhum spangs pa zhi lhag gsum gyis 'jug /ji ltar 'jug pa la/ kun brtags la 'jug tshul ni/ thos pa'i sgo nas ming dang ngo bo dang / /khyad par btsal bas de dag ma dmigs par/ /don kun brjod pa tsam du legs rig nas/ /gzhan dbang la 'jug tshul ni/ rnam rig tsam du chos kun shes par byed/ /yongs grub la 'jug tshul ni/ rnam rig 'du shes ldog nas chos kyi dbyings/ /gnyis kyi mtshan nyid bral ba mngon du byed/ /gnas skabs gang du 'jug tshul ni/ byang sems 'jug pa'i gnas skabs lam lnga ste/ /mos spyod gnyis dang mthong sgom mthar phyin lam/ /de'i rgyu 'bras pha rol tu phyin pa drug la grangs nges pa ni/ de yi rgyu 'bras pha rol phyin pa drug /mi mthun phyogs kyi sgo nas grangs nges bzhag /go rim nges pa ni/ rgyu 'bras dman mchog rags dang phra ba'i rim/ /so so'i mtshan nyid ni/ chags dang gdung ba kun 'khrug le lo med/ /rtse gcig sems dang chos rab rnam 'byed blo/ /phar phyin bcus sa bcu bgrod tshul ni/ de dbye rab dga' la sogs sa bcu la/ /phyin drug thabs dang smon lam stobs ye shes/ /sa rnams thob tshul ni/ 'di dag mos spyod rtogs dang grub pas thob/ /dus ji srid gcig gi bgrod tshul ni/ myur na grangs med gsum gyis de mthar phyin/ /bslab pa gsum ni/ lam mthar phyin chad bslab gsum nyan thos las/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab spyod/ /de'i 'bras bu spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ thos pa'i bag chags goms las nyon mongs kun/ /rim gyis phri bas ma dag gzhan dbang gi
