/mtshan ma 'gags pas srid la mi gnas shing / /de bzhin shes bya'i sgrib pa yongs spangs pas/ /rnam byang shin tu rnam dag de kho na/ /dag pa'i gzhan dbang nyid du gnas gyur pa/ /ma 'gag phyir na zhi la yongs mi gnas/ /ye shes phun sum tshogs pa la/ sku gsum dang / yan lag lngar dbye ba'i/ dang po'i mdor bstan pa ni/ de yi ye shes phun tshogs sku gsum ste/ /rgyas par bshad pa la ngo bo nyid sku ni/ spros kun bral ba rang gi dbyings brnyes pa/ /chos rnams kun la dbang bsgyur ngo bo nyid/ /longs sku ni/ longs spyod rdzogs sku chos sku la brten te/ /zhing sbyong ba dang byang sems smin par mdzad/ /de bzhin sprul sku ni/ sprul pa'i sku yang chos sku la/ /brten te mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pas/ /nyan thos la sogs gtso cher smin mdzad nyid/ /don bsdu ni/ de lta'i sku gsum nyid kyi ngo bo'am/ /mtshan nyid kho na chos kyi sku zhes brjod/ /zhar byung 'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus ni/ gang de tshogs gnyis yongs su mthar phyin nas/ /sgom lam rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sgrib kun bcom ste mngon par byang chub 'gyur/ /yan lag lngar dbye ba'i gnas gyur ni/ de tshe kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur nas/ /chos skur gyur pas dbang 'byor lnga thob ste/ /gzugs gnas gyur cing dbyangs dang mtshan dpe sogs/ /de bzhin tshor bas zag pa med pa la/ /'du shes ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs bstan pa/ /'du byed sprul bsgyur 'khor dang chos bsdu ba/ /rnam shes ye shes bzhi la dbang 'byor thob/ /dkar po'i chos kyi gzhi ni/ phyin drug rdzogs pas dkar po'i chos kyi gzhi/ /tshe sems yo byad las dang skye ba dang / /mos pa smon lam rdzu 'phrul ye shes dang / /chos la dbang ba zhes bya rnam bcu thob/ / gnyis su med pa ni/ yod dang med dang 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/

/gcig min mang po min phyir gnyis su med/ /rtag pa ni/ rtag tu de bzhin nyid las 'gyur med phyir/ /thugs rjes smon lam zad par mi nus phyir/ /'gro don mdzad pa yongs su ma rdzogs phyir/ /rang bzhin rgyun mi 'chad dang rgyun gyis brtag /bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ shin tu rnam dag de bzhin nyid gang de/ /so so rang gis rig par bya ba dang / /srid na dpe med rtog ge'i yul min phyir/ /sangs rgyas yon tan gzhan gyis bsam mi khyab/ /ma 'dres pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gzhan bstan pa ni/ tshad med rnam par zil gnon la sogs pa/ /bsam yas yon tan yang dag brnyes pa ni/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes phun tshogs zhes bya ste/ /dri med gzhung bzang gzhan las shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dbu ma'i lugs ni/ 'phags pa yab sras sogs kyi gzhung la bslabs nas shes par bya dgos te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de nas dbu ma'i gzhung la bslab pa'i mtshams sbyor ni/ de ltar dngos smra'i them skas la brten nas/ /mtha' bral dbu ma'i khang bzang der 'jug bya/ /don dngos la snga ma'i log rtog dgag pa la gsum gyi/ rnam bden pa gzhan dbang don dam du 'dod pa dgag pa ni/ de la snga ma'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ /rang rig rang gsal shes pa skad cig ma/ /yod ces smra ba kun rdzob tu 'dod na/ /sgro btags tshul las rang gi mtshan nyid kyis/ /yod pa min phyir kun btags las ma 'das/ /dam pa'i don du yod na yod pa'i mthar/ /lhung phyir mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam min gyur/ /gal te khyed kyang med par 'dod pa'i phyir/ /med pa'i mthar lhung zhe na kho bo cag /kun rdzob ji ltar snang tsam don dam du/ /gang du'ang 'dod pa med pas skyon yod min/ /yongs grub spros bral gzhan dbang la yod na/ /de la yod par 'dzin pa zlog mi nus/ /skad cig tsam du bden par yod ce na/ /de la skye ba la sogs yod med brtag

/med na snga phyi'i bar du mi gnas 'gyur/ /yod na yod pa rgyu dang rkyen la ltos/ /gzhan du med pa nyid dam rtag par 'gyur/ /snga ma ltar na rtsa ba'i grub mtha' nyams/ /rtag pa yin na gnas gyur 'dod pa 'gal/ /kun rdzob tu 'gyur zhe na ri rwa la'ang / /gnas gyur yod par 'gyur zhes cis mi mtshungs/ /rang bzhin yod pa rgyu rkyen la ltos nas/ /gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ /de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /rkyen la rag las gang de stong pa nyid/ /gang gis stong nyid shes de bag yod yin/ /zhes gsungs phyir na yod pa 'thad ma yin/ /rang gi 'dod pa brjod pa la gsum yod pa'i/ bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan la lnga'i 'jig rten grags sde dang mthun pa ni/ rang lugs kun rdzob bden pa'i rnam gzhag la/ /'ga' zhig 'jig rten grags pa'i bden rdzun dang / /mthun par yang dag log pa'i kun rdzob 'dod/ /bye smra dang mtshungs pa ni/ gzhan dag kun rdzob shes bya'i gzhi lngar 'byed/ /sgyu ma pa ni/ 'ga' las dngos kun sgyu ma lta bur bstan/ /mdo sde spyod pa ni kha cig yul dang yul can rnam bcas 'dod/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa ni/ phal cher phyi nang chos kun rmi lam ltar/ /sems nyid bag chags 'khrul pa'i snang bar bzhed/ /don dam pa'i 'dod tshul ni/ de sogs kun rdzob 'dod tshul mang na yang / /dam pa'i don la mi mthun 'ga' med de/ /kun kyang rang rang lugs kyi kun rdzob kyi/ /bden par btags pa'i btags don rig pa yis/ /dpyad cing btsal bas ci yang ma rnyed pa/ /de la dam pa'i don gyi bden pa zhes/ /ming gis btags pa tsam du mthun phyir ro/ /skabs su bab pa'i chos bshad pa la gnyis kyi/ kun rdzob kyi ngos 'dzin ni/ mdor na so skye'i blo nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /ye shes bar gyi chos can sna tshogs su/ /snang ba gang yin de dag kun rdzob ste/

/rgyu dang rkyen gyis 'dus byas dngos nyid phyir/ /don dam gyi ngos 'dzin la bzhi yod pa'i/ don dngos ni/ de rnams rang bzhin don dam bden pa ste/ /skye ba la sogs kun dang bral phyir ro/ /de la gnas skabs la ltos te bden pa gcig tu bshad pa ni/ de ni gzhan la ltos te mi bslu bas/ /bden pa gcig pu zhes kyang skabs 'gar bshad/ /de nyid dngos dang dngos med gang yang ma yin par bstan pa ni/ de nyid dngos dang dngos med kyang min te/ /dngos dang dngos med la sogs mthar 'dzin pa/ /zad cing zhi ba mya ngan 'das zhes gsungs/ /des na spros pa bral ba/ myang 'das dbyings ni spros pa dang bral yang / /srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas zung du 'jug /nges don gyi 'dod tshul gzhan bstan pa ni/ 'ga' zhig phyi rol don du zhen pa dang / /stong par zhen pa bsal phyir sems tsam bstan/ /dngos 'dzin spyi dang sems su 'dzin pa yang / /bsal phyir dbu ma'i mdo rnams gsungs pa'i phyir/ /theg chen mdo sde kun gyi nges don la/ /'ga' yang khyad par med ces bshad pa'ang yod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ bya rgyud kyi lugs ni smin byed chu dang cod paṇa gyi dbang thob nas/ dpung bzang / legs grub/ gsang pa spyi rgyud/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i sogs la bslabs nas mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya dgos te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa la rim gyis bslab pa'i mtshams sbyor ni/ de ltar thun mong theg pa la bslabs nas/ /don dngos la thog mar bya rgyud la smin grol gnyis kyi dang po ni/ thun mong min pa'i dang po bya rgyud la/ /smin byed gtso bo chu dang cod paṇa dbang / /gnyis pa grol byed lam ni/ thob nas rigs sngags 'dul ba la bslabs te/ /yi dam spyan drangs bzlas brjod grogs bcas kyis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bsgrub pa 'o/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ spyod rgyud kyi lugs ni/ smin byed chu cod paṇa rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang thob nas rnam snang mngon byang sogs la bslabs te mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya dgos te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ /spyod rgyud la'ang smin grol gnyis las dang po ni/ spyod rgyud smin byed chu dang cod paṇa no/ /rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang thob nas/ /grol byed lam ni/ gtsang sbrar ldan pas rang nyid lhar bsgoms te/ /mdun du lha bskyed ye shes spyan drangs la/ /mchod dang bzlas pa la sogs bya ba dang / /dngos grub bsgrub dang dngos po'i gnas lugs dang / /de dang rjes 'brel bsam gtan bya ba dang / /gzhan don bsgrub pa'i thabs la bslab pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs ni/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i steng du phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i dbang yang blangs/ rdo rje rtse mo dang / de nyid 'dus pa sogs la bslabs te mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi las sogs bya dgos te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de nas rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lam rim la slob ma'i rigs can la sbyin par bya ba'i smin grol gnyis las dang po ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud du slob ma'i rigs can la/ /rig pa'i dbang tsam byin nas grol byed lam ni/ yi dam gyi/ /bzlas sgom tsam la rim gyis slob pa dang / /rdo rje slob dpon gyi rigs can la sbyin par bya ba'i smin grol gnyis las dang po ni/ rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi rigs yin na/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang yang rab bskur te/ /grol byed lam ni/ de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dam tshig dang / /lha dang dkyil 'khor la sogs de nyid bcu/ /slob ma gzhug sogs slob dpon las rnams dang / /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs sogs slob pa 'o/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi lugs ni/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob nas pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang ma rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor sogs la bslabs nas lam rim pa gnyis la bslab par bya dgos te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de nas bla med kyi lam rim pa la spyir bstan pa ni/ de nas rnal 'byor chen po bla med kyis/ /rgya chen thabs mkhas gtsor ston pha rgyud dang / /zab mo shes rab gtsor ston ma rgyud kyi/ /smin byed bum gsang shes rab ye shes dang / /bzhi pa'i dbang bskur dam tshig legs byin te/ /grol byed bskyed rdzogs 'khor dang bcas bstan nas/ /de kyai rdo rje'i lam rim bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ rjes thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /smin grol zab mo'i thabs tshul ston pa ni/ /skal dman sems can dbang po gdul dka' ba/ /rim gyis 'dul bar byed pa'i thabs mkhas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa cig car ba'i lugs ni/ skal ldan sems can 'dul sla ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags/ /zhes pa'i lan du/ gso sbyong sbyin sogs ma ltos par/ /dang por kyai rdo rje sbyin/ /zhes pa dngos su med kyang don gyis thob pa ltar/ lta spyod rim pa can sogs la ma ltos par/ dang po nyid nas smin byed kyi dbang bskur du rung ba yin la/ de la yang rgyud sde'i dbye bas rnal 'byor pa bzhi yod mod/ gtso bor gyur pa bla med kyi rnal 'byor bas bslab par bya ba'i lam la 'jog pa yin te ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ skal ldan cig car 'jug pa'i lam rim la smin grol gnyis kyi/ dang po la sngon du 'gro ba'i bya ba ni/ skal ldan mchog gi rigs can skyabs 'gro dang / /byang chub sems bskyed sdom pas bsdams pa 'am/ /ma bsdams na yang lam mchog snod rung phyir/ /rjes bzung cho gas gang de'i rgyud sbyangs la/ /dngos gzhi dbang gi mngon rtogs la bdun gyi/

dang po bsnyen pa ni/ mtshan dus grangs kyi bsnyen pa ci rigs pas/ /yi dam mnyes par byas pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /gnyis pa sa chog ni/ brtags bslangs sbyangs bzung bsrung ba'i sa phyogs su/ /gsum pa ston ni/ sa lha lha dang bum pa slob ma rnams/ /lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga rim bzhin bya/ /bzhi ba bri zhing rgyan dkram pa ni/ de rjes thig dang tshon gyis bri ba dang / /lha yi mtshan ma dgod dang rgyan bkram la/ /lnga pa bsgrub cing mchod pa ni/ bsgrubs shing mchod nas drug pa 'jug cing dbang skur ba la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ bdag nyid 'jug sogs bya/ /slob ma gzhug cing dbang skur ba ni/ de nas slob ma 'jug la phyi nang gnyis/ /thun mong dbang drug thun mong min pa bzhi/ /rjes gnang lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod bcas/ /dbang gi grangs gzhan bstan pa ni/ yang na bum dbang bcu gcig gsang dbang lnga/ /shes rab ye shes gnyis dang bzhi pa lnga/ /cig char rim can dbye bas so sor bskur/ /bdun pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ yon dbul dkyil 'khor mchod nas gshegs gsol dang / /rjes bsdu dga' ston bya ba smin byed dbang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar smin byed gyis rgyud sbyangs nas grol byed kyi lam la/ mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs lnga/ thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs lnga/ gnyis ka'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa gnyis te bcu gcig las/ dang po lta ba la/ lta ba dang por ston pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / rgyu mtshan can gyi lta ba dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis zin pa'i dge ba rnams sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gyur ba dang / /dge rtsa gzhan pas stobs che ba dang / log ltas 'phrog mi nus pa'i phyir te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/

gnyis pa grol byed lam la/ gtso bor mchog bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs lnga'i/ dang po lta ba la/ thog mar bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ gang de sngon du song nas chos kun gyi/ /gnas lugs spros bral rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /legs par zin pa'i sbyin sogs dge chos rnams/ /rgyal ba'i lam du 'gyur dang dge stobs 'phel/ /log ltas 'phrog pa spang phyir lta ba bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la ye shes de gnas lugs su ngo sprad pa/ de la gang zag gi bdag tu log par rtog pa dgag pa/ ye shes de'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa/ gtan la dbab pa'i gnas lugs de gsung rab kun las rtogs byar bstan pa/ gnas lugs de gsang sngags kyi thabs zab mos rtogs par bstan pa dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ dbang gi ye shes skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa de'i snang ngo na/ rnam dag ye shes gzugs can te sangs rgyas dang gzhi 'khor ba'i chos gnyis tha dad du dbyer med cing mnyam nyid du snang bas 'khor 'das rang bzhin med par mnyam nyid du mtshon nus te/ rtsa rgyud las/ rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang / /zhes sogs dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ dgos pa de ldan gyi lta ba ston tshul la lnga yod pa'i dbang gi ye shes bstan pas de kho na nyid ngo sprod pa la gsum gyi ye shes de yul la ltos nas 'khor 'das dbyer med du bstan pa ni/ lta ba zhes bya kun khyab de bzhin nyid/ /chos dang chos can dbyer med lhan cig skyes/ /legs par rtogs pa'i rtog med shes rab ste/ /gang de lung rigs la brten thos bsam dang / /tshig tu brjod pa tsam gyis rtogs min zhing / /dbang las byung ba'i nyams myong ye shes kyis/ /'khor 'das gnyis su med par mtshon nus phyir/ /dbang gi ye shes gang der ngo sprod bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ye shes de la rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas rang rig ye shes dang / gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes dang /

mkha' mnyam gyi ye shes sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ rang rig ye shes nyid du 'gyur/ /rang gzhan yang dag rig pa spangs/ /mkha' mnyam rdul bral stong pa nyid/ /ces dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ yul can la ltos nas rang rig dang spros bral zung 'jug tu bstan pa ni/ de nyid so so rang rig ye shes te/ /rig bya rig byed dang bral stong pa nyid/ /dngos dang dngos med gnyis min zung du 'jug /chos thams cad kyi khyab byed bdag nyid du bstan pa ni/ rang bzhin kun khyab mtshan nyid du mar snang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de nyid 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag nyid de/ 'khor 'das kun dang rang bzhin med par mnyam nyid du gnas pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid yi ge dam pa yin/ /de nyid kun gyi bdag nyid de/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa des dbang gi ye shes nyams su myong zhing bla mas de'i don bshad pa'i tshe rnal 'byor pa de'i rjes spyod kyi nyams la/ bdag gi myong ba 'di ni thams cad kyi myong ba po dang byed pa por 'dug go snyam du rtog na de nyid gang zag gi bdag tu log par rtog pa yin pas/ de dgag pa'i phyir kun rdzob tu sgyu ma lta bu dang / don dam du spros bral nam mkha' lta bur gtan la dbab dgos te/ rtsa rgyud las/ sgyu ma'i gzugs can nyid du 'dod/ /ces dang / ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /zhes sogs dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de la gang zag gi bdag tu log rtog dgag pa la dgag bya log rtog gi dbye ba ni/ de la log par goms pa'i blo can dag /rang rig ye shes grangs can shes rig dang / /yi ge dam pa rig byed pa yi sgra/ /'gro ba'i bdag nyid bye brag pa yi bdag /srog chags srog ces bya ba gcer bu pa/ /shing sogs bem po la yang bdag 'dod bzhin/ /mkha' mnyam rdul bral mngon dang phyi ma'i mtha'/

/med par 'dod pa rgyang 'phen ltar rtogs kyang / /de dgag pa'i tshul ni/ dngos kun rang bzhin legs rtogs ye shes de'i/ /rang bzhin spros bral mtshan nyid sgyu ma ltar/ /snang stong zung du 'jug phyir mtshungs ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ ye shes de'i rang bzhin bden pa gnyis las ma 'das shing / bden gnyis thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa las rgyas par 'byung ba ltar shes par bya dgos te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ yul can ye shes la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i phyir yul shes bya sogs spyi'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa la bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang mtha' bral gyi lta ba rgyas par bshad pa gnyis yod pa'i dang po la gsum gyi bdag med gnyis kyi mtshan nyid ni/ ye shes de la sgro skur spangs pa'i phyir/ /de yul bden gnyis nges bya go rim bzhin/ /yang dag don la sgrib byed kun rdzob ste/ /ma brtags rmongs pa'i blo la der bden pa/ /gang de bcos ma'i bden yin don la rdzun/ /dam pas don du gnyer bya don dam ste/ /brtags shing dpyad dang ma rmongs ngor bden pa/ /snga ma la ltos bcos min bden pa 'o/ /mtshan gzhi la mdor bstan ni/ chos can mtha' dag kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /gang de'i chos nyid don dam bden zhes bya/ /rgyas bshad la yul can blo'i dbye ba ni/ 'on kyang bden gnyis blo la ltos pa'i phyir/ /blo yi rnam dbye nges bya so skye'i blo/ /'khrul pa 'ba' zhig yin phyir kun rdzob pa/ /'phags gsum mnyam gzhag don dam rjes kun rdzob/ /sangs rgyas 'khrul pa zad phyir don dam blo/ /de la rnam grangs rnam grangs min pa dang / /mthun dang mi mthun bden gnyis 'byed pa'ang yod/ /blo de la ltos nas bden gnyis su bzhag pa la/ blo ngo gnyis la ltos te bden pa gnyis su dbye ba ni/ bden gnyis ngo bo'i sgo nas dbyer med pas/

/yang dag de nyid ma mthong 'jig rten pa'i/ /blo tsam bden pa gnyis kyi dbye gzhi ste/ /blo yis gnyis su gzung la ltos phyir ro/ /dbye ba'i don ni/ ma brtags ma dpyad blo ngor bden pa'i phyir/ /chos can 'khor ba kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /brtags shing dpyad pa'i blo ngor bden pa'i phyir/ /chos nyid myang 'das don dam bden pa 'o/ /rtsod pa spang ba la rnam grangs pa'i don dam blo'i yul du bstan pa ni/ gal te don dam blo las 'das she na/ /so skye'i blo yis legs brtags skye med sogs/ /don dam skye ba'i rgyu ste rnam grangs pa/ /rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam yul dang yul can dbyer med kyi tshul du rtogs par bstan pa ni/ 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes spros bral du/ /rang gis myong la don dam mthong ngo zhes/ /tha snyad dbang gis ming du brjod pa las/ /yul dang yul can tshul gyis rtogs pa min/ /yul dang yul can chos can dang chos nyid dbyer med du bstan pas grub don bsdu ba la/ ci ste don dam blo yi yul min na/ /myang 'das bden gcig gang gis rtogs she na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtogs med brnyes pa'i tshe/ /de la 'khor 'das gnyis snang nub pa'i phyir/ /bden pa gcig pur btags kyis chos can gyis/ /stong pa'i chos nyid logs su grub ma yin/ /de phyir bden gnyis ngo bo dbyer med la/ /sel ngor ldog tshul tha dad nyid du 'dod/ /grangs nges ni/ de ltar phyin ci log dang ma log blo/ /gnyis su nges phyir bden gnyis grangs nges mdzad/ /mtshan gzhi la mtshan nyid nges par bya ba'i tshad ma ni/ gang la rigs pas brtags na de 'jig kyang / /ma brtags ngor bden kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /dpyad blo gnod med ngor bden don dam gyi/ /bden pa'i mtshan gzhi nges byed tshad ma yin/ /mtha' bral gyi lta ba rgyas bshad la gsum gyi thams cad yod par bstan pa de kun rdzob bden par bstan pas dngos smrar mtshungs shing /

khyad par 'phags pa la phung khams skye mched bshad pas nyan thos sde pa dang mthun zhing / mu stegs byed las khyad par du 'phags pa bstan pa ni/ de la rtag chad sgro skur bsal ba dang / /gcig rtag rang dbang can gyi bdag 'gog phyir/ /phung skye khams gsum nyan thos la gsungs gang / /de nyid dgongs pa can du sngar bshad zin/ /yul snang la rang bzhin med pa dang snang ba sems su bstan pas sems tsam dang mtshungs shing nyan thos las khyad par 'phags par bstan pa'i yul snang la rang bzhin med par bstan pa ni/ de lta'i yul du snang ba ji snyed pa/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin dang bral phyir/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar bden ma yin/ /snang ba sems su bstan pa la bzhi yod pa'i sems kyi yon tan ni/ de ltar chos kun rang bzhin gyis dag na/ /snang grags chos rnams gang las byung zhe na/ /sems nyid 'od gsal gcig las yod min yang / /bag chags dbang gis du mar snang ba tsam/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid ni/ de phyir gsal rig 'khor 'das kun gyi rgyu/ /de la rang sems nyon mongs can gyi yid/ /yul du snang ba'i rnam rig 'jug shes so/ /de ltar snang yang gzung yul gzhan med phyir/ /de la ltos pa'i 'dzin pa yod min pa/ /gnyis kyis stong pa'i shes pa gsal rig tsam/ /sems kyi nus mthu ni/ de nyid thabs kyis 'gyur bas dgos 'dod kyi/ /'bras bu 'byung phyir rin chen sems zhes brjod/ /sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ de yi rang bzhin skye med nyid yin yang / /gnas skabs rkyen gyis 'gyur phyir gzhan gyi dbang / /thams cad med par bstan pa de shes rab kyi blo ngor bstan pas theg chen spyi dang mtshungs shing / khyad par 'phags pa la gnyis kyi yul ma grub pas yul can gyi shes pa'ang ma grub pas/ sems tsam las khyad par du 'phags pa bstan pa ni/ gzugs sogs rkyen la ltos phyir ngo bos med/

/de med yul can shes pa'ang rigs min la/ /yul dang yul can med phyir de gnyis kyis/ /stong pa'i shes pa gsal rig yod ma yin/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma yin yang / don dam par gnas lugs 'di'o zhes mi 'dod pas/ dbu ma ngo bo nyid med par smra ba las khyad par 'phags pa bstan pa ni/ kun rdzob chos kun rgyu rkyen gyis bskyed cing / /snang yang ngo bos stong phyir sgyu ma bzhin/ /chos can ngo bos med na de'i chos nyid/ /ji ltar zhe na bsam pa'i yul las 'das/ /gnyis med kyi blos mtha' bral du gtan la phab nas/ zung 'jug tu nyams su blang ba la gsum gyi/ stong pa sogs bzhi ka'ang mtha' yin pas spong dgos pas na gnas lugs mi 'dod pa la bzhi yod pa'i/ gnas lugs nges pa yod na gnod pa yod pa bstan pa ni/ gcig dang du ma bral phyir yod ma yin/ /skye la sogs pa mthong phyir med ma yin/ /gnyis ka'i skyon dang ldan phyir gnyis ka'ang min/ /phan tshun ltos phyir gnyis min yang ma yin/ /nges pa blo yul du mi rung ba ni/ de ltar gnas lugs nges pa yod min pas/ /nges pa blo yi yul du byar mi rung / /blo la ma ltos pa'i yul mi rung ba ni/ gal te stong nyid ces bya pad nyi la/ /ma ltos ngo bos grub pa yod ce na/ /shes pa yod pa'i yul de gang gis rtogs/ /gzhan du bsam mi khyab pa'i bdag cis dgos/ /mthar bzung na srid pa'i rtsa bar 'gyur ba ni/ de phyir 'dzin cing mngon par zhen pa kun/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po'i rgyu yin la/ /phung por 'dzin pa yod pa de srid du/ /de la dmigs nas ngar 'dzin sogs 'byung ngo / /de la rtsod pa spang ba ni/ de ltar gnas lugs gang du'ang ma grub par/ /shes nas cir yang khas mi len pas na/ /rang tshig 'gal dang tha mal pa mtshungs dang / /lung dang 'gal ba'i klan ka kun dang bral/ /yod med mthar 'dzin bzlog phyir stong nyid sogs/

/bshad pa yod kyang gdul bya gzhug phyir yin/ /mtha' bral gyi dbu ma zhes bya bar 'dzin na de yang mtha' yin par bstan pa ni/ dgag bya med na bkag pa yod min pas/ /yod pa med na med pa yod ma yin/ /de phyir gnyis dang gnyis min mi 'grub pas/ /mtha' bzhi bkag pa'i mtha' bral gang nas btsal/ /de ltar mtha' dang bral bas zung 'jug gi tshul du nyams su blang ba la zung 'jug gi rang bzhin ni/ de ltar 'dzin pa kun bral lta ba la/ /nges pa rnyed nas bsgoms pas nyams len tshe/ /yul can gsal ba snying rje chen po nyid/ /mtha' bral yul gyi rnam par legs shar ba'i/ /snang ba snang stong shes pa gsal stong dang / /ngo bo bde stong dbyer med zung du 'jug /de don dam du bsam du med pa ni/ de nyid dam pa'i don du bsam bya las/ /nges par 'das phyir bsam pa'i yul ma yin/ /kun rdzob tu sgom pa'i tshul ni/ 'on kyang kun rdzob tsam du rnam rtog gis/ /dpyad cing bsgoms pas rtog med skye 'gyur te/ /sems su dmigs pas phyi don ma dmigs shing / /de ma dmigs pas sems kyang ma dmigs la/ /de las gzung dang 'dzin pa ma dmigs pa'i/ /bdag med mtha' bral stong pa'i mtshan nyid skye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ gnas lugs de la rdo rje dang / rdo rje sems dpa' dang / dpal pa mchog dang po dang / 'jam dpal sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas bstan cing / de nyid shin tu rtogs dka' la/ rtogs na don che ba zhig yin te/ kun mkhyen gyi sdom gsum kha skong las/ zab mo'i rgyud du 'jam dpal dang / /zhes sogs dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de kho na nyid de mdo rgyud thams cad kyi rtogs byar bstan pa ni/ de nyid rtogs na shin tu don che bar/ /gzigs nas thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du/ /dngos dang brgyud pas rtogs bya'i dam pa zhes/ /mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas bsngags par mdzad/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa la/ gsang sngags kyi thabs zab mos rtogs tshul dngos ni/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /zhes sogs dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de kho na nyid de rtogs byed khyad par du 'phags pa gsang sngags kyi thabs kyis rtogs par bstan pa la thabs gzhan gyis mi rtogs shing / zab mos rtogs par bstan pa ni/ tshul de pha rol phyin pa'i thos bsam la/ /sogs pa'i thabs kyis rtogs min de las gzhan/ bla ma mnyes dang skyon med dbang dus dang / /thabs mkhas sbyor bas phyag rgya bsten pa dang / /bsod nams tshogs las rnyed 'gyur sngags kyi lta ba la khyad par du ye shes bstan pa la/ rang bzhin lhan skyes la sbyar te bshad pa ni/ gang de yi/ /ngo bo rang bzhin lhan skyes ye shes che/ /mtshan nyid bden 'dzin rtog pa yang dag spangs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ye shes de lta ba las khyad par du bstan pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /zhes dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de yi rten ni lus can thams cad kyi/ /phung khams skye mched la khyab kun bdag nyid/ /chos can lus la gnas kyang lus skyes min/ /zhu bde lhan skyes la sbyar te bshad pa ni/ yang na ngo bo zhu bde'i ye shes che/ /mtshan nyid glo bur rtogs pa thams cad spangs/ /de yi rten ni lus te dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /zhu bde mi rtogs ye shes lus kun bdag /lus la tshogs pa gcig pa'i 'brel pa yis/ /gnas kyang brgyud de skye yi dngos su min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir te/ 'og gzhung don gyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /ye shes de mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes su bstan pa ni/ so skye'i gnas skabs kyi dbang gi ye shes thams cad mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes yin te/ dper mtshon na/ byad bzhin lta bar 'dod pa la me long nang gi byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan mthong ba lta bu yin pa'i phyir te/

ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ gang de mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes te/ /rang rig ye shes rtog bral ma 'khrul ba/ /byad bzhin blta la me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /don gyi ye shes min yang don dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ye shes de skye ba'i rten rdo rje lus kyi gnas tshul ni/ rdo rje lus kyi grub tshul sogs bla med kyi rgyud dang rgyud 'grel phal cher mthun par 'byung bas de yang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ ye shes de lus la gnad du bsnun nas rtogs pa'i phyir rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs bstan pa la thog mar lus 'jig pa'i tshul ni/ de nyid lus la brten nas rtogs pa'i phyir/ /lus kyi rang bzhin nges bya 'chi ba'i tshe/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' snang mched thob/ /rim gyis thim ste 'od gsal zhes bya ba/ /skye 'gag med pa'i dbyings su zhi ba la/ /'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku zhes brjod/ /skye tshul la 'chi srid las bar srid ldang tshul ni/ slar yang de las ldang 'dod dang 'grogs pa'i/ /srog 'dzin me mnyam khyab byed ma rig pas/ /mngon par bcings pa'i rta la sems zhon te/ /bar dor brdzus te skye ba'i lus blangs nas/ /skye gnas 'tshol la mngon du phyogs par 'gyur/ /bar srid las skye srid len tshul la lus ngag yid gsum phan tshun rten dang brten pa yin tshul ni/ skye tshe sems nyid g.yos pas rlung 'byung zhing / /rlung gis bskyod pas drod 'byung de las rlangs/ /rlangs pa'i brlan gsher brtas pas sa grub ste/ /de las lus dang ngag 'byung gnas pa'i tshe/ /sems ni rlung dang rlung ni rtsa la brten/ /brgal lan gyi sgo nas sems las lus ngag skye tshul ni/ gal te 'byung ba bzhi las lus skye na/ /phyi don yod 'gyur zhe na sa chu me/ /rlung las skye zhing rlung yang sems nyid las/ /skye bar phyag chen thig le sogs las bshad/ /brgal lan gyi sgo nas 'od gsal las sems nyid skye tshul ni/ ci ste sems nyid gang las skye zhe na/

/sems ni 'od gsal zhes bya chos kyi dbyings/ /skye 'gag med pa nyid las tha snyad du/ /snga ma'i kun gzhi 'gags pa'i nyer len gyis/ /skye bar snang la 'od gsal las skye zer/ /dpe brgyad stong pa gsum gyi rten 'brel las ji ltar skye tshul la rten 'brel skye ba dpes bstan pa ni/ de ltar snga ma'i shes pa phyi ma ru/ /'phos pa med phyir rtag par mi 'gyur la/ /shes pa snga ma'i rgyud la ma brten par/ /phyi ma 'byung ba min phyir chad pa'ang min/ /de phyir las dang rgyun gyis skye ba la/ /rten 'brel dbang gis skye zhes dpe yis bstan/ /de nyid stong pa gsum gyi rim pas skye tshul ni/ mdor na snga ma'i kun gzhi 'od gsal la/ /thim nas snga ma'i las kyi bag chags dang / /kun gzhi'i rgyun la brten nas 'od gsal las/ /kun gzhi phyi ma ma bsgribs lung ma bstan/ /skye la stong chen zhes bya de nyid las/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa nyon mongs can gyi yid/ /shin tu stong pa skye ste de las kyang / /sngon gyi bag chags kyis bskyed yul rkyen gyis/ /rnam shes tshogs drug stong pa'i bdag nyid skye/ /de gsum rim bzhin thob mched snang ba yin/ /de yang rten 'brel bcu gnyis las skye tshul ni/ rmongs pas rgyu byas las kyis rkyen byas te/ /rnam shes de ltar skyes nas ming gzugs sogs/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'byung ste de yang ni/ /rnam shes g.yos las rlung sogs 'byung ba bzhi/ /de las phung khams skye mched skye bar snang / /de yang skye gnas bzhi'i grub pa'i tshul la spyir bstan pa ni/ skye gnas rdzus skyes sgo nga las skyes dang / /drod gsher skyes dang mngal nas skyes pa bzhi/ /mngal skyes bye brag tu bshad pa'i lus gang las skye ba'i rgyu dngos ni/ de las phyi ma skabs 'dir bshad bya ste/ pha ma'i rtsa sgo la brten khu khrag dang / /bar do'i rnam shes rlung gis der bskyod dang /

/gsum ka'i sngon las mnyam par bsags pa las/ /khu khrag sems gsum bde bar ro mnyam zhing / /pho mor skye 'gyur las dang pha ma la/ /chags sdang rkyen gyis so so'i lus len 'gyur/ /rgyu'i rnam grangs gzhan bshad pa mi 'gal bar bstan pa ni/ de la dngos dang dngos med sems gsum dang / /lus ngag yid gsum khu khrag dang ni rlung / /rdul mun snying stobs sogs las skye zhes pa/ /phal cher snga ma'i phyogs re tsam la dgongs/ /rgyu des lus grub tshul la phra ba grub tshul ni/ de lta'i khu khrag rlung sems 'dres pa las/ /rnam shes brgyal thabs lta bur gnas pa'i tshe/ /mer mer sogs 'byung zla ba dang po la/ /gnas 'jug ldang ba'i rlung gis rtsa gsum grub/ /rags pa grub tshul ni/ de tshe nya dang gnyis pa rus sbal mtshungs/ /gsum par phag rgod lta bur mgo mtho zhing / /bzhi par gdong pa dgra sta'i dbyibs 'dra dod/ /lnga par dga' byed lta bur tshigs rnams gsal/ /drug par nag pa zhes bya skra spu nag /bdun par seng ge lta bu mgo bo che/ /brgyad par mi 'u thung ltar lus dod 'gyur/ /dgu par ngang pa zhes bya phyir 'byung 'dod/ /bcu par sangs rgyas sa bcu rdzogs pa ltar/ /mngal gyi gnas skabs rdzogs te btsa' bar 'gyur/ /skyes nas gnas pa'i tshul rten dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lus rtsa'i gnas tshul ni/ de ltar rtsa gsum de bzhin sum cu gnyis/ /brgyad dang nyi shu stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /ba spu'i bu ga'i grangs snyed rim gyis grub/ /rtsa yi ge'i dkyil 'khor gnas tshul ni/ yi ge a dang de bzhin e waṃ gnyis/ /sde tshan thog ma khams kyi bcu drug dang / /yi ge nyer bzhi hūm̐ brgyad bh+rūm̐ aṃ sogs/ /'pho ba'i yi ge la sogs bsam mi khyab/ /sems bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gnas tshul ni/ byang chub sems ni dbu ma'i yas mar du/ /pha dang ma las thob pa'i khu khrag gnyis/

/ro rkyang lte ba man chad bzhir gyes pa'i/ /rkyang ma'i mdun rgyab dri chu khu ba 'phen/ /ro ma'i rgyab mdun dri chen rak+ta 'phen/ /sha chen dwangs ma kun gyi stobs kyis 'dzin/ /de dag la brten khrag sogs bcu drug dang / /so dang sen mo sogs bskyed sum cu gnyis/ /de dag la dbang byed pa'i snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor gnas tshul la rlung gi ngo bo ni/ de la dbang byed rlung ni 'byung chen gyi/ /khongs su gtogs pa sna tshogs byed pa'i gzhi/ /dbye ba la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' shes pa'i rlung / / rgyu tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ ye shes rlung ni gnas shing rnam rtog 'gog /las rlung 'gro 'ong byed cing rnam rtog skyed/ /gnas sam byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba la rtsa ba'i rlung lnga ni/ mnyam gnas srog 'dzin gyen rgyu thur sel dang / /khyab byed sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i rim/ /lte snying mgrin pa 'doms dang spyi bor gnas/ /yan lag gi rlung ni/ rgyu ba mig dang mnyam rgyu rna ba gnyis/ /yang dag rgyu sna rab tu rgyu ba lce/ /nges par rgyu zhes bya tshigs la ste/ /rim bzhin sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams/ /klu dang rus sbal rtsangs pa lhas byin dang / /gzhu rgyal ming gis zhag dang mchin pa dang / /glo snying mkhal mar gnas zhes 'ga' las bshad/ /de ltar bcu char 'byung lnga'i bdag nyid de/ /rlung spyi'i byed las ni/ lus len rim gyis rgyas dang 'dzin pa dang / /sna tshogs rnam rtog bskyed cing 'chi bar byed/ /rlung so so'i byed las la rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i byed las ni srog gis lus sems gnas dang sna sgor rgyu/ /thur sel gyis ni bshang gci 'phen dang sdom/ /mnyam gnas kha zas 'ju dang dwangs ma 'grem/ /gyen rgyu smra dgod skyug dang kha zas 'phul/ /khyab byed 'degs 'jog 'gro 'ong la sogs byed/

/yan lag gi rlung lnga'i byed las ni/ yan lag rlung rnams mig sogs lam rgyus nas/ /gzugs sogs yul rnams rig pa'i grogs byed do/ /rlung de rgyu tshul spyir rgyu ba zhes bya gang yin pa ni/ de ltar srog 'dzin ma gtogs gzhan dgu po/ /rang rang las byed de la rgyu bar btags/ /tshul ji ltar rgyu ba ni/ srog 'dzin dang por a wa dhu ti la/ /gnas pa ye shes rlung yin ngar 'dzin pa'i/ /dbang gis snying ngar srog 'dzin du gyur nas/ /ro rkyang nus pas srog rtsol zhes bya ba/ /ldang 'jug gnas par sna yi lam nas rgyu/ /ye shes rlung zhes bya ba dus 'khor las/ /drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga zhag re la/ /rgyu bar bshad cing 'phreng bar thun mtshams sam/ /kun la khyab pa'i tshul gyis rgyu bar gsungs/ /nam mkha'i rlung yang kun la khyab pa 'am/ /'khor gyi tshul gyis rgyu zhing 'chi ba'i tshe/ /gzhan rnams 'di yis dbang byas rgyu zhes bshad/ /rnam pa ji ltar rgyu ba ni/ de rnams 'byung ba so so'i kha dog can/ /mgon po re re'ang lha mo bzhi bzhir ldan/ /me rlung g.yas nas steng du sor bzhi dang / /rlung gi rlung ni g.yon nas sor drug ngos/ /sa rlung thad kar bcu drug gnyis ka nas/ /de bzhin chu rlung 'og tu sor bcu gnyis/ /re re'ang nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga rgyu/ /gnas dang lam gang nas rgyu ba ni/ srog 'dzin srog dang rtsol ba nas byung ste/ /snying kha'i 'dab bzhir 'byung ba bzhir byas nas/ /'khor lo bzhi dang yul chen nyer bzhi sogs/ /kun tu rgyus nas 'byung bzhi'i bdag nyid du/ /mgrin par 'byung ba gsung gi sgo bzhi dang / /sna sgo nas 'byung thugs kyi sgo gnyis dang / /yan lag rlung sogs bu ga dgu po nas/ /so sor rgyu ba sku yi sgo dgu yin/ /grangs du zhig rgyu ba ni/ de ltar sna sgo gnyis nas rgyu ba'i rlung / /ldang 'jug gnas gsum sdom pa zhag re la/

/nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rtag par rgyu/ /grangs de ltar 'ong ba'i 'thad pa ni/ de ltar 'ong ba'ang snga ma'i bag chags ni/ /sems la gnas pa lus la smin pa ste/ /de yi dbang gis phyi nang dus sogs snang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyad par rlung rgyu ba'i tshul la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dgongs pa/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dgongs pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa/ kye rdo rje'i dgongs pa dang bzhi las/ phyi ma la lte ba'i rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbang gis phyi rol tu dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis dbang gis chu tshod so gnyis/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug gi dbang gis pho ba bcu drug snying ga'i phyi bskor gyi rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbang gis thun byed pa brgyad/ nang bskor gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi'i dbang gis thun tshod bzhi 'byung la/ de dag nang rlung dang sbyar na/ dbyu gu re la rlung sum brgya dang sum cu so phyed dang brgyad/ dbyug gu gnyis la chu tshod gcig de la rlung drug brgya bdun bcu rtsa lnga/ chu tshod gnyis la pho ba gcig de la rlung stong dang sum brgya dang lnga bcu dang / pho ba gnyis la thun phyed pa gcig de la rlung nyis stong bdun brgya/ thun phyed pa gnyis la thun tshod gcig de la rlung lnga stong bzhi brgya/ thun tshod bzhi la rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya re skyes bu nad med kyi dbang du byas na nyin zhag phrug re'i nang du rgyu ba yin zhing / de yang 'jug gnas 'byung gsum gcig tu sdom pa la bya ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ zla ba dang nyi ma dang ā li dang kā li dang pho ba bcu drug dang dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi dang chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis dang thun tshod bzhi ste/ de ltar thams cad bzhi'o/ /zhes dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de yang mkha' phreng gnyis kyi dgongs pa ni/ mkha' phreng dgongs pas zhag re la/ /yul chen nyer bzhi'i dbang gis dgu brgya phrag

/nyi shu rtsa bzhi mgon po'i rlung rgyu zhing / /mgon po re re'ang lha mo bzhi bzhi'i rlung / /nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga rtsa lngar ldan/ /de lta'i dgu brgya phrag re 'pho ba phyed/ /de bzhin stong dang brgyad brgya 'pho ba gcig /'pho ba bcu gnyis nyin zhag phrug gcig ste/ /de nyid nang gi lo yin 'pho ba ni/ /nang gi zla gcig 'pho byed bgrod pa'o/ /dges pa rdo rje'i dgongs pa ni/ dges rdor ltar na lte ba'i 'khor lo yi/ /dbang gis zhag rer dbyu gu drug cu bzhi/ /dbyu gu re la rlung sbyor sum brgya dang / /phyed bcas sum cu rtsa brgyad legs par rgyu/ /spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab dbang gis chu tshod de/ /chu tshod re la drug brgya bdun cu lnga/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab dbang gis 'pho ba ste/ /re re'ang stong dang sum brgya lnga bcu'i tshad/ /snying kha'i rtsa 'dab dbang gis thun phyed brgyad/ /thun phyed re la nyis stong bdun brgya re/ /snying kha'i nang skor dbang gis thun bzhi ste/ /thun re la yang lnga stong bzhi brgya re/ /dbyu gu la sogs rang rang grangs bshad pa/ /gang yin de de rdzogs pa zhag re ste/ /rlung sbyor nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rlung de dag lam du byas pa'i phan yon ni/ sems kyi rta rlung yin pa'i phyir na rlung bzung bas sems zin/ de las zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin skye/ srog rtsol bgrang na bzlas par 'gyur bas sdig sgrib 'dag khyad par chu rlung dkar po rgyu ba'i dus su nad gdon sogs zhi bar bsam pa tsam gyis de 'grub/ sa rlung ser po rgyu ba'i dus su tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam pa tsam gyis de 'grub/ mthar las rlung thams cad ye shes kyi rlung du gyur nas sangs rgyas pa yin te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ rlung de dag lam du gyur tshul ni/ de ltar shes nas man ngag ldan pa yis/ /nang du bzung na zhi gnas ting 'dzin skye/

/srog rtsol bgrangs pas sgrib pa 'dag par 'gyur/ /rlung bzhi rgyu dus las bzhi'i 'phrin las 'grub/ /las rlung ye shes rlung 'gyur 'tshang rgya 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar lta ba'i rnam gzhag 'phros don dang bcas pa bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa bskyed rim dang gsum pa rdzogs rim la bskyed rdzogs thun mong gi chos dang / so so'i mngon rtogs gnyis/ dang po la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ ming don/ grangs nges/ grol ba'i rgyu mtshan/ rten brten pa 'brel pa can du sgom pa'i 'thad pa drug ni yongs su grags pa ltar shes par bya ste/ rje btsun gyis/ bskyed rdzogs thun mong chos drug dran bya zhing / /zhes dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ de ltar de nyid lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /de ltar lta ba sngon du song nas lam gyi dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi spyi don la de gnyis kyi ngo bo ni/ nyams blang gtso bo sgrub pa po yi yid/ /mtshan rtog las skyob thabs kyi khyad par gang / /grol byed lam ste dbye ba ni/ bskyed dang rdzogs pa gnyis/ /bskyed rim gyi ming don ni/ lus bskyed lhar bskyed mchog la brod pa bskyed/ /de lta'i rim pas rgyud gsum bskyed pa'i rim/ /rdzogs rim gyi ming don ni/ lus rdzogs rdzogs pa gsal 'debs mchog rdzogs byed/ /de lta'i rim pas rgyud gsum rdzogs pa'i rim/ /rim pa gnyis su grangs pa'i mdor bstan ni/ spang bya tha mal rnam rtog lhar zhen spong / /thob bya gzugs dang chos kyi sku thob byed/ /ngo bo rten dang brten pa yin pa'i phyir/ /lam gyi gtso bo rim pa gnyis su nges/ /rgyas bshad la spang bya tha mal rnam rtog gi rgyu las nyon sbyong tshul ni/ 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu ni las nyon te/ /mi dge'i las kyi gnyen po bsod nams tshogs/ /nyon mongs rtsa ba lhan skyes ma rig pa/ /de yi gnyen po stong nyid ye shes tshogs/

/'bras bu bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa sbyong tshul la sbyang gzhi ngos bzung ba ni/ spang bya'i nyon mongs rnam rtog las byung zhing / /rnam rtog de yang thog med 'khor ba nas/ /bag chags bsags pa sad byed dang phrad pas/ /med bzhin snang ba bdag dang bdag gi ba/ /kun tu rtog pa'i dug yin de las gzhan/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal zhes bya yod ma yin/ /de la rtsod pa spang ba la rgol ba dgod pa ni/ gal te rnam rtog kho na bskyed rim gyi/ /lha dang dkyil 'khor sbyang gzhir rigs min te/ /sems las gzhan pa'i gzugs sogs la brten nas/ /'khor ba'i rgyur 'gyur du ma yod ce na/ /rgol ba'i lan gdab pa ni/ gzugs sogs snang ba sems nyid bag chags kyis/ /dkrugs pa'i dbang gis du mar snang ba las/ /gzhan pa'i gzung 'dzin snang ba yod min te/ /bdag sgrub pa yi rab tu byed pa las/ /rnam rtog las gzhan 'khor ba zhes bya ba/ /'ga' yang yod min de phyir rnam rtogs nyid/ /bral bar gyur la mya ngan 'das zhes brjod/ /zhes gsungs phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ /gang gi phyir na ye shes sku spangs nas/ /phyi rol don zhes bya ba ci phyir gnas/ /phyi yi snang ba thams cad skad cig ma/ /dga' mo sems kyi cho 'phrul yin zhes gsungs/ /spang bya tha mal rnam rtog bskyed rim gyi sbyong tshul la snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong tshul ni/ de lta'i tha mal snod du rung ba kun/ /sbyong byed gzhal yas khang dang lha yi gdan/ /bcud kyi sems can sbyong tshul la bskyed chog gi skye gnas bzhi sbyong tshul ni/ bcud kyi skye gnas sbyong byed bskyed chog ste/ /mngon byang las skyed mngal dang drod gsher skyes/ /'khor rnams mngal nas 'byin pas mngal skyes dang / /cho ga gsum dang thig les sgong skyes sbyong / /skad cig sa bon las skyed rdzus skyes sogs/ /sgrub thabs yongs rdzogs kyi sbyong tshul ni/ gzhan yang ye shes tshogs kyi 'chi srid dang /

/bar srid mtshon byed rnams kyi bar do sbyong / /rten dang brten pa bskyed pas skye ba dang / /ye shes gzhug sogs skyes nas gnas pa sbyong / /de dag rim bzhin chos longs sprul pa dang / /bde ba chen po'i sku rnams las byed do/ /lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong tshul ni/ lha sku khro chags can bsgom zhe sdang dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor 'dod chags dang / /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i skur bsgom gti mug sbyong / /rdzogs rim gyi gya nom lhar zhen sbyong tshul ni/ spang bya gnyis pa gya nom lhar zhen gyi/ /gnyen por gyur pa rdzogs rim ye shes te/ /gang des spros bcas kun dang snod bcud dang / /rten dang brten pa 'jig sogs thams cad sbyong / /thob byed 'bras bu gnyis su nges pa'i gzugs sku thob byed bskyed rim ni/ 'bras bu gzugs sku thob byed bskyed rim ste/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pas thar pa cha mthun sgrub/ /srung 'khor bdud btul pho brang zhing sbyong ba/ /lhar bskyed sangs rgyas dbang sogs der dbang thob/ /spro bsdus don mdzad bzlas pas chos 'khor bskor/ /dkyil 'khor bsdu bas mya ngan 'das tshul ston/ /spyod lam la sogs mdzad pa 'phrin las so/ /chos sku thob byed rdzogs rim ni/ de bzhin chos sku thob byed rdzogs rim ste/ /thabs gnyis las byung zung 'jug ngo bo nyid/ /chos skur mos shing bsres nas bsgom pa las/ /'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur phyir/ /rim pa gnyis po de rang gi ngo bo rten dang brten pa yin pa la rgol ba dang lan gdab pa ni/ gal te rdzogs rim bsgoms pas bskyed rim yang / /sbyong zhing chos sku mngon du byed nus na/ /bskyed rim don med ce na rdzogs rim gyi/ /nyams len de ltar bzang yang de yi rten/ /bskyed rim med na brten pa rdzogs rim med/ /de phyir lha sku med pa bde mi 'byung /

/rim pa gnyis kyis grol ba'i rgyu mtshan la rigs sam rgyu yin pas rgyu lam 'bras bus phan tshun rigs dang rigs bdag tu 'gyur tshul ni/ 'khor ba'i chos rnams de bzhin gshegs rigs te/ /lam gyis sbyangs pas de 'bras 'byung phyir ro/ /de bzhin lam dang 'bras bu'ang rgyu rigs dang / /rgyu dang 'bras bu'ang lam gyi rigs su brjod/ /lam gyi gnas skabs su rigs bdag tu 'jog tshul/ 'on kyang lam gyi skabs su rgyu lam rigs/ /'bras bu rigs kyi bdag po zhes bya ste/ /de gsum 'brel ba can du grub pa'i phyir/ /des na rim pa gnyis kyis grol bar 'thad pa ni/ des na rim gnyis bsgoms pas grol 'gyur te/ /zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel bas mi bslu'i phyir/ /de bzhin lha dang phyag mtshan dkyil 'khor dang / /bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor rgyur bcas rdzogs rim gyi/ /las rgya la sogs 'bras bu'i rigs yin no/ /thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa la/ grol tshul dper bstan pa'i rigs 'dra gnyen por che ba ni/ brtan pa'i dug gis g.yo ba'i dug 'joms ltar/ /tha mal rnam rtog lam gyi rtogs pas 'joms/ /ldog pa gnyen por che ba ni/ rlung nad chung ngu mon sran gyis bzlog ltar/ /snod bcud gnyen por bskyed rim bsgoms pas bzlog /sbam pa gnyen por che ba ni/ chung ngu mang po'i grogs kyis 'gugs pa ltar/ /bzhin lag gcig zhen gnyen por du ma bsgom/ /bsnan pa gnyen por che ba ni/ tshig pa bsreg dpyod sogs kyis 'chos pa ltar/ /'dod chags gnyen por lha mo'i 'khor bsgoms sogs/ /dpe de dag gis bstan pa'i grol byed kyi thabs dngos ni/ mdor na rnam dag lta ba dang ldan pas/ /dngos po'i mtshan mas mi 'ching grol bar 'gyur/ /bskyed rim bsgoms pas 'dod yon lam du byed/ /rdzogs rim thabs kyis nyon mongs byang chub 'gyur/

/dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa la dri mas rang bzhin gyis dag pas kyang sbyang du rung ba rgyu rgyud kyi dag pa gsum ni/ dngos rnams rang bzhin skye med de bzhin nyid/ /kun rdzob lus su snang ba lha so so/ /sems nyid du mar snang ba rang rig pa/ /rang gzhan rnam dag rgyu ba'i dag pa gsum/ /glo bur gyi dri ma sbyong byed thabs rgyud kyi dag pa gsum ni/ spros bral lam byed lta ba de bzhin nyid/ /dngos kun lha skur sgom pa lha so so/ /bde chen ye shes rtogs byed rang rig pa/ /dri ma sbyong byed thabs kyi dag pa gsum/ /dri ma dang bral ba 'bras rgyud kyi dag pa gsum ni/ bral 'bras ngo bo nyid sku de bzhin nyid/ /gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don mdzad lha so so/ /chos sku ye shes mthar phyin rang rig pa/ /mngon gyur 'bras bu'i dag pa rnam pa gsum/ /yang na ngo bo nyid sku rang rig dang / /chos sku de bzhin nyid ces gsungs pa'ang yod/ /rim gnyis sgom pa'i go rim nges pa ni/ rim gnyis bskyed rim brtan nas rdzogs rim ni/ /sgom par bzhed pa 'phags pa yab sras sogs/ /yang na bcu gnyis bar du bskyed rim dang / /de nas rdzogs rim sgom pa sems 'grel lugs/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs bskyed rim la/ /rdzogs rim rgya yis btab nas sgom par gsungs/ /gā ya dha ra la sogs gong ma rnams/ /bskyed rdzogs stan thog gcig tu sgom par bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis so so'i mngon rtogs la/ dang po la lha'i rnam pa dang / mngon rtogs kyi chings gnyis/ dang po la mchog sgrub pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor dang / las rgyas pa'i lha'i grangs gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ sku gsung thugs kyi he ru ka gsum/ snying bo kye rdo rje/ bdag med ma/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang dang drug gsungs/ gur las/

rigs rkyang rgyas pa la/ rigs rkyang pa lnga la 'khor lha mo brgyad brgyad kyis bskor ba'i lha dgu ma lnga/ rigs bsdus rgyas pa la/ dkyil 'khor gcig gi nang du gtso bo rigs lnga so so la 'khor lha mo brgyad brgyad kyis bskor ba'i lha zhe lnga ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig de la dbus kyi gtso bo rigs lnga so sor go 'pho ba'i gnad kyis rigs bsdus rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor yang dkyil 'khor gcig gi nang du rigs lnga so so la 'khor lha mo bzhi bzhis bskor ba'i lha zhe lnga ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig de la sngar bzhin dbus kyi gtso bo go 'pho ba'i gnad kyis rigs bsdus bsdus pa lha nyer lnga ma'i dkyil 'khor lnga/ de rnams kyi steng du sku gsung thugs kyi he ru ka gsum/ bdag med lha mo bcu gsum ma dang bco lnga ma gnyis te dngos bstan nyi shu yod de/ gur las/ dkyil 'khor re re bsgom pa 'am/ /yang na bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /brgyad brgyad dbus su gnas pa'am/ /yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyi shu po de'i nang nas snga ma bco lnga la bla ma'i man ngag gi sku gsung thugs snying po kye rdo rje bzhi bzhir gtso bo go 'pho tshul gyi sgo nas drug cu/ bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bsnan pas drug cu rtsa gnyis 'byung ba ni ljon shing gi dgongs pa yin la/ gur rgyan las de'i steng du rigs bsdus la rgyas bsdus gnyis yod pa ltar/ rigs rkyang la yang rgyas bsdus gnyis su phye nas rigs rkyang bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga la sngar bzhin sku gsung thugs snying po kyai rdo rje dang bzhir gtso bo go 'pho tshul gyi sgo nas nyi shu 'byung ba bsnan pas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis yong bar bshad cing / sam+pu ṭi las/ sku gsung thugs kyi he ru ka gsum snying po kyai rdo rje/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma lha bcu gsum/ bdag med ma/ rdo rje dbyings/

drag po gdan can te brgyad/ rdo rje dbyings la gtso bo go 'pho ba'i gnad kyis lngar 'gyur bas bcu gnyis/ rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor drug dang bsdoms pas mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor brgya tham pa 'byung ba 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi bzhed pa yin te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ rim gnyis so sor bshad pa la rdzogs rim gyi rten bskyed rim bsgom pa'i gang zag ni/ dbang thob dam tshig ldan zhing man ngag gi /bka' lung thob pa'i sgrub pos gnas ni dben pa dang / /rang khyim dur khrod rigs mthun gnas sogs su/ /dus ni/ mtshan mo'i dus sam thun gsum thun bzhi dang / /mnyam rjes kun tu bsam pa ni/ gzhan don bsam pa yis/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom bya lha'i rnal 'byor la bskyed bya lha'i rnam grangs gtso bor mchog bsgrub pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyi ngo bo ni/ de'i ngo bo/ /rnal 'byor gang la rnam dag khyad par can/ /yod pas tha mal snang zhen sbyong nus pa'i/ /lha yi rnal 'byor nyid yin de'i dbye ba la rtsa bshad so so las bshad tshul ni rtsa rgyud nas bshad tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ /sku gsung thugs dang snying po kyai rdo rje/ /yum dang rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang ste drug /gur las bshad tshul ni rdo rje gur las rigs rkyang rgyas pa lnga/ /rigs bsdus rgyas pa lnga dang bsdus pa lnga/ /mi bskyod he ru ka gsum yum gyi gnyis/ /dngos bstan nyi shu yod kyang man ngag gis/ /rigs gzhan bzhi la'ang sku gsung thugs sbyar bas/ /rigs lnga re re'ang bzhi bzhi nyi shu ste/ /rigs rkyang rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor nyi shu dang / /rigs bsdus rgyas bsdus nyi shu nyi shu la/ /yum gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis bsnan drug cu gnyis/ /yang na rigs bsdus rgyas bsdus gnyis yod ltar/ /rigs rkyang la yang rgyas bsdus gnyis sbyar bas/ /brgyad cu rtsa gnyis 'byung ba gur rgyan lugs/

/sam+pu ṭi las bshad tshul ni kha sbyor rgyud las dges pa rdo rje bzhi/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro rdo rje bdag med ma/ /rdo rje dbyings dang drag po gdan can te/ /dngos su bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad 'byung la/ /rdo rje dbyings la gtso bo 'pho ba yi/ /gnad kyis rigs bsdus lnga ste bcu gnyis so/ /rdo rje 'chang la dgos pa dpyad pa ni gal te rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rdo rje 'chang / /logs su bgrang na kha sbyor nas bshad pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang yang bgrang bar rigs she na/ /rtsa rgyud gsung ba'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang / /yin phyir de yi dkyil 'khor bgrang pa ste/ /kha sbyor rdo rje dbyings kyis gsungs pas na/ /gang de nyid las logs su bgrang mi dgos/ /spyi'i grangs/ de ltar man ngag lugs kyi gsung sgros ni/ /gtsor byas dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum nas/ /bshad pa'i mchog bsgrub dkyil 'khor brgya phrag gcig /'byung ba 'di ni 'khrul zad gong ma'i lugs/ /gzhung 'grel ltar na rtsa bshad gsum ka nas/ /'byung ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /dang po'i las pas bsgom bya'i rnal 'byor te/ /thun mong sgrub pa tsam du bzhed pa'ang yod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rdo rje ma nas rig byed ma'i bar brgyad/ gur las/ 'byung po 'dul byed nas nag po chen po'i bar nyer brgyad/ kha sbyor las/ sgrol ma nas rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bar sum cu ste drug cu rtsa drug yod de/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ gtso bo thun mong bsgrub pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyi ngo bo dang de nyid rgyud gsum nas gsung tshul ni/ las rgyas sgrub pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor ni/ /rnal 'byor gang la rnam dag ma gsungs pas/ /tha mal snang zhen rtog pa mi sbyong yang / /zhi rgyas la sogs sgrub pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor/ /nyid yin rtsa ba'i rgyud las rdo rje ma/

/dkar mo chu ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /bdag med ma dang mkha' spyod sa spyod ma/ /rig byed ma ste rnam pa brgyad yod do/ /gur las 'byung po 'dul ba stobs po che/ /khro bcu so so rdo rje sgrol ma dang / /shes phyin dkar mo dang ni khro bcu spyi/ /rdo rje lus med ku ru kul+le dang / /'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gshin rje gshed/ /hūm̐ mdzad sgrol ma 'od zer can tsan+da/ /nor rgyun ma dang rmug 'dzin so 'brang dang / /nag po chen po dang bcas nyi shu brgyad/ /kha sbyor rgyud na sgrol ma rig byed ma/ /shes phyin dkar mo rigs bzhi yum bzhi dang / /mchog sgrub sgrol ma 'jigs byed 'od zer can/ /ri khrod lo ma can dang bde mchog dang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshin rje'i gshed rta mgrin/ /mi g.yo ba dang stobs chen rnam snang dang / /mkha' lding dbang gi sgrol ma dpal mchog dang / /ku ru kul+le nyi zla bzung ba dang / /sde gzhig pa dang lha dgas char dbab bcad/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor nam mkha' ste/ /thun mong sgrub pa gtsor gyur sum cu 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mngon rtogs kyi chings ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ dang po sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rnal 'byor pas ni snyoms 'jug bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /de nas yang ni las rgyal po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa yin/ sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa nas/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog phra thig sogs bsgom pa las rgyal mchog ste ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis 'ching ba dang / gur las/ sangs rgyas gnas ni rdzogs pa dang / /kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin dang / /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar bsgrub dang / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang la sogs/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yan lag drug gis 'ching ba dang /

rtsa rgyud las/ yang ni stong nyid byang chub ste/ /gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru 'god/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis 'ching ba ste gsum gsungs la/ dang po ni/ sku gsum lam du bya ba dang / gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba rigs drug dang / gsum pa ni/ sku bzhi lam du byed pa'i sgrub thabs yin te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ skyed byed mngon rtogs kyi rnam gzhag la sngon 'gro rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ni/ sgrub thabs sngon 'gro bsod nams tshogs bsags ni/ /tshad med bzhi tsam bya dang de'i sngon du/ /tshogs zhing mchod dang de steng rgyun bshags dang / /de bzhin sdom bzung bsnan pas rgyas bsdus bzhi/ /de rjes ye shes tshogs bsags srung 'khor bsgom/ /'bring du byed na khro bcu'i srung 'khor spangs/ /shin tu bsdu na tshad med bzhi tsam dang / /ye shes tshogs dang thun mong srung 'khor tsam/ /bsgoms nas rnal 'byor dngos la 'jug pa'ang rung / /dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la mngon rtogs kyi chings gsum so sor bshad pa'i sku gsum lam du byed pa ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi 'ching ni/ gtso bo bskyed pa dang po sbyor ba dang / /mchod bstod yan chad dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ste/ /phra thig la sogs lhag ma las rgyal mchog /sku gsum lam byed ting 'dzin gsum gyis 'ching / /rgyal ba rigs drug lam du thod pa yan lag drug gis 'ching pa ni/ gzhal yas khang bskyed rnam par snang mdzad sku/ /rjes chags rdor sems ngo bo sgrub thabs gtso/ /sems nyid dag byed dbang bskur mi bskyod thugs/ /bdud rtsi mgrin par myang phyir dpag med gsung / /mchod pa sangs rgyas 'phrin las don yod grub/ /bstod pa yon tan ngo bo rin chen 'byung / /rgyal ba rigs drug sgrub thabs yan lag drug /rdo rje bzhi lam du byed pa yan lag bzhi'i chings ni/ lha bskyed bsnyen pa'i yan lag sku rdo rje/

/byin rlabs nyer sgrub yan lag gsung rdo rje/ /dgug gzhug sgrub pa'i yan lag thugs rdo rje/ /rgyas 'debs sgrub chen ye shes rdo rje ste/ /sku bzhi'i sgrub thabs bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ /'di ni sgrub thabs kun la khyab byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sgrub thabs gang la chings gang 'jug ni/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ lha gang la mngon rtogs gang sbyor ba la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las rgyas pa ni/ rigs bsdus rnams la chings gsum gang rung dang / /kha sbyor rdo rje dbyings la thog mtha' sbyar/ /rigs rkyang rnams dang yum la phyi ma gnyis/ /lhag ma kun la 'jug pa bsnyen sgrub bzhi/ /'bring po ni/ 'di las mchod bstod spangs pas 'bring du 'gyur/ /'og ma rnams la ltos te rgyas par bshad/ /bsdus pa ni dbang bskur gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes gzhug /rnam gsum rim gyis phri la 'bring po dang / /bsdus dang bsdus pa phyi mar rim bzhin bzhed/ /bskyed chog ni bskyed chog mnyam sbyor gur dang sam+pu ṭa'i/ /rigs bsdus rdo rje 'chang la nges par 'jug /rigs rkyang rdo rje 'chang la 'jug pa'ang yod/ /rigs rkyang rnams dang yum la mi mnyam sbyor/ /sku gsung thugs gsum sa bon las bskyed dang / /cho ga gsum dang mngon byang las bskyed sbyar/ /drag po gdan can snying po tshig tsam dang / /ye shes mkha' 'gro dbugs kyi spro bsdu las/ /'khor rnams phal cher mngal 'byin tshul gyis bskyed/ /'ga' zhig thugs ka'i gnas nas spro ba'ang yod/ /skye mched lha rnams snying po tshig tsam ste/ /lhag ma cho ga gsum sogs las bskyed do/ /rjes rdzogs par byed pa ni/ rjes ni bzlas dang spyod lam kha zas dang / /khrus dang gtor ma thun mtshams bya ba dang / /nyal ldang mchog dman kun la thun mong ba/ /mchog la dag pa dran pa khyad par ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim la/

ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ rdzogs rim la de'i mtshan nyid ni/ gang la gnad du bsnun pas lus sems la/ /bde chen ye shes bskyed cing lhar zhen gyi/ /rnam rtog gnyen por gyur pa rdzogs rim yin/ /rdzogs pa gnyis kyi spyi 'gro la lam la som nyi spang ba'i phyir/ phyi'i spros pa nang du spyad pa la sdom pa'i dbye ba'i sgo nas lus dang rtsa bstan pa ni de yi rtsa ba nang gi sdom pa yi/ /gnas ni lte ba'i aṃ dang rtsa 'khor rnams/ /ji snyed chos kun ji bzhin nang du sdom/ /mtshan rtog thams cad sdom zhing spong sems ldan/ /thabs ni phyag rgya'i lam dang gtum mo yi/ /bde bar gyur pa sdom pa'i ngo bo 'o/ /rtsa dang byang sems bstan pas sa lam nang du bsdu ba la bsgrub bya'i gzhi ni/ sa dang lam kun nang du bsdu ba'i gzhi/ /phung khams skye mched so gnyis nyon mongs lnga/ /sgrub byed kyi lam ni/ thun mong la grags byang phyogs so bdun dang / /bskyed rim ltar na gzhal yas khang gi cha/ /lha dang sbyar na gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mngon byang rnam pa lnga/ /rdzogs rim rten la sbyar tshe rtsa so bdun/ /de bzhin yi ge khams dang rlung so bdun/ /brten pa de rnams las byung ye shes che/ /grub pa'i 'bras bu ni/ mthar phyin 'bras bu sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /'phrin las rnam grol ye shes tshad med bzhi/ /mngon shes drug dang zag med yul drug dang / /stobs bcu ye shes lnga ste so bdun no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdzogs rim la sgra don/ rdzogs rim gnyis kyi spyi 'gro'i chos/ de nyams su blang ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ lus ngag yid gsum bde chen gyi ye shes su byin gyis rlob pa byed pas na rdzogs rim zhes bya ba yin la/ gnyis pa la phyi'i spros pa thams cad nang du gcod pa/ nang byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ de mi spong zhing bskyed par bstan pa dang gsum las/

dang po ni/ phyi'i spros pa thams cad nang du 'du zhing bsdom pa yin te/ sde pa bzhi sogs bzhi tshan gyi chos thams cad 'khor lo bzhir bsdom/ sku gsum sogs gsum mtshan gyi chos thams cad ro rkyang dbu gsum du bsdom/ thabs shes gnyis sogs gnyis tshan gyi chos thams cad ro rkyang gnyis su bsdom pa'i phyir te/ rtsa rgyud las/ rnal 'byor ma lus dbus gnas su/ /a yi rnam pa sdom pa'i gnas/ /ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / /sdom pa'i de nyid rab tu dbye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rtsa ni gnyis gnyis rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes pa nas/ rnal 'byor ma rnams de yi cha/ /zhes rkang pa'i mthe bong nas spyi gtsug kun 'dar gyi bar te gnas bcu drug gsungs pa ltar sbyang gzhi bcu drug la tshan pa bdun 'byung ba ni/ yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu drug pa gnyis lug glang 'khrig pa karka sogs nas nyi zla 'dzin pa/ thig le 'gog pa/ nam mkha' 'gog pa ste 'pho ba bcu drug rtsa so gnyis las nyis bsdebs pa bcu bzhi/ rtsa gtso mo gsum gcig tu byas/ bdud bral ma dang bcu drug so dang sen mo sogs bskyed pa'i nang gi khams bcu drug yi ge ā li'i rnam pa bcu drug rang bzhin gyi dga' ba'i dga' ba sogs bcu drug las/ snga ma bco lnga pa tshan pa bdun thabs spros pa'i rang bzhin gtso che bas sbyong byed lha mos sbyong / phyi ma bcu drug pa tshan pa bdun shes rab stong pa'i rang bzhin gtso che bas sbyong byed he ru kas sbyangs pas thabs shes zung 'jug tu 'gyur te/ bdag med bstod pa las/ des na rdo rje theg pa'i zab don kun/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa la/ /kho bo'i sems ni mchog tu dang ba yis/ /rdo rje theg la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ sbyong tshul spyir bstan pa la sbyong gzhi gang yin pa ni/ dkar nag tshes dang bco lnga'i mtshan char bcas/

/lug glang 'khrig pa kar seng bu mo srang / /sdig gzhu chu srin bum nya nyi zla 'dzin/ /thig le 'gog dang nam mkha' 'gog dang 'pho/ /so gnyis rtsa las nyis sdebs bcu bzhi dang / /gtso gsum gcig tu byas dang bdud bral ma/ /dbyangs yig byang sems dga' ba kun bcu drug /de dag gnas ni mthe bong byin pa brla/ /gsang cha lte cha snying cha nu ma'i cha/ /lkog ma lag mthil mchu dang mkhur tshos dang / /mig dang rna ba klad pa g.yas cha dang / /ro ma kun 'dar de bzhin g.yon la'ang ste/ /sbyong byed ni kun gyi snga ma bco lnga lha mo dang / /bcu drug pa rnams he ru ka dpal gyis/ /sbyangs pas thabs shes zung 'jug tu 'gyur tshul ni sbyangs pas thabs shes zung du 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang yar ngo'i tshes gcig la skyes pa'i rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas dang / bud med kyi g.yon pa'i mthe bong nas brtsams te/ tshes bco lnga'i bar la rim gyis 'phos nas bco lnga'i nyin skyes pa'i khams spyi bo'i nang gi ro ma'i steng dang / bud med kyi khams spyi bo'i nang gi rkyang ma'i steng du gnas/ bco lnga'i mtshan mo a tsheg drag can gyi rnam pas dbu ma'i steng du thim/ mar ngo la de las go ldog ste bud med kyi rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas dang / skyes pa'i mthe bong g.yon nas brtsams te gnam gang gi bar la gnas so sor rim gyis 'phos nas gnam gang gi nyin bud med kyi spyi bo'i ro ma'i steng dang / skyes pa'i spyi bo'i rkyang ma'i steng du gnas/ de'i mtshan mo a tsheg drag gi rnam pas dbu ma'i steng du thim pas de gnyis 'dres te he ru ka'i sa bon hūm̐ gi rnam par grub pa yin te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ 'pho tshul bye brag bshad pa la ji ltar 'pho ba'i tshul ni/ pho mo'i dbye bas yar ngo mar ngo la/ /rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas g.yon nas brtsams te/ /rim gyis 'phos nas dkar nag bco lnga'i nyin/

/pho mo'i g.yas g.yon ro rkyang steng du gnas/ /bco lnga'i mtshan mo gnyis ka'i spyi gtsug tu/ /aḥyig rnam pas thim 'gyur mar ngo bzlog /de rnams ngo bo byang sems shes pa'i rten/ /rnam pa ā li kā li'i gzugs kyis gnas/ /rang bzhin dga' ba'i dga' ba sogs bcu drug /rtsa gsum gtso mo gnyis gnyis 'khor gyi lha/ /bdud bral ma ni yab ste lug sogs so/ /de yang 'pho ba'i 'thad pa la phyi rol na ji ltar gnas pa nang la sbyar ba ni/ phyi rol rgyu skar nang gi rtsa/ /nyi zla khu khrag bgrod pa g.yas g.yon 'pho/ /de ltas zhag gis 'pho ba ma thub pas/ /tshes kyi lhag chad dag dang bshol 'byung zhing / /khu khrag 'dres las nyi zla gzas 'dzin dang / /khams kyi 'phel 'grib dbang gis dus 'byung ngo / /des na chos thams cad sems su bstan pa ni/ de ltar snang ba thog med 'khor ba yi/ /bag chags sems la gnas pa lus nyid la/ /rtsa yig sogs kyi rnam par smin pa'i mthus/ /med bzhin phyi rol don gyi snang ba shar/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ rgyu mtshan des na byang chub kyi sems mi spong zhing bskyed par bstan pa ni/ de lta'i byang chub sems las yon tan kun/ /'byung phyir mi spong thabs gnyis kyis bskyed bya/ /zhes dang / rtsa rgyud las/ 'grib med btung mchog nam mkha' nyid/ /ga bur ci nas nges mi spong / /zhes pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam dang ni/ /rang byin rlabs pa'i rim pas kyang / /kun rdzob don dam gzugs can gyi/ /byang chub sems ni rab tu bskyed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ yon tan kun gyi rten du gyur pa'i kun dha byang chub kyi sems mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya ba yin no/ /gsum pa de nyams su blang ba la/ rang byin rlabs dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gnyis/

dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rkyang ma mi bskyod 'bab ma ste/ /zhes sogs ltar/ rtsa'i rnal 'byor gcig a yi rnam pa sdom pa'i gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yi ge bha ga'i rnal 'byor gcig ste gnyis gsungs/ gur las thig le'i rnal 'byor gcig kha sbyor las thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ rlung gi rnal 'byor mang du bshad/ yang rtsa rgyud las/ gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi ldan gyi rnal 'byor gcig gur las/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i zhar la gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gcig sam+bu ṭi las gtum mo'i rnal 'byor nyi shu rtsa lnga/ gur las mi zab pa'i rdzogs rim/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor gcig bshad pa rnams la bslab par bya ba yin te/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ nyams su blang ba'i thabs dang byin rlabs la zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa so sor bsgom pa ni/ de ltar sgro 'dogs bcad nas bsgom pa'i thabs/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las rtsa yig re re dang / /gur las thig le'i rnal 'byor gcig 'byung zhing / /yang dag sbyor bar thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ /de bzhin rlung gi rnal 'byor mang du bshad/ /ldan par bsgom pa ni/ rtsa rgyud dang por gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi/ /gur las dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i zhar byung gcig /kha sbyor rgyud las gtum mo nyer lnga dang / /mi zab pa'i rdzogs rim ni/ gur las phra mo'i rnal 'byor gcig bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam la dngos kyi phyag rgya dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya gnyis/ dang po la/ dbang dus dang / lam dus dang / 'bras dus kyi phyag rgya gsum las/ dang po la lang tsho gtso che/ gnyis pa la rigs gtso che/ gsum pa la yon tan gtso che ste/ rim pa bzhin rtsa rgyud las/ bcu gnyis brgyad gnyis lon pa yi/ /zhas sogs dang / gar ma tshos ma rdo rje ma/ /zhes sogs dang / mchog thob pa yi bud med gang / /zhes sogs dang / ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/

dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la gang la brten nas skye ba'i rten dngos kyi phyag rgya la gnas skabs la dgongs nas gsum du dbye ba ni/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dmigs bcas skye ba'i rten/ /dbang lam 'bras bur lang tsho rigs yon tan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang de la ngo bos sgo nas dbye na sgra ji bzhin pa dang / sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa dang / dbang dang 'brel ba dang / yon tan dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyag rgya bzhi las/ dang po la/ 'jig rten gyi ma dang sring mo sogs brgyad/ bram ze mo sogs brgyad de bcu drug tu yod pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ ma dang sring mo nyid dang yang / /zhes sogs kyis brgyad tshan dang po bstan cing / rtsa rgyud brtag pa dang po las/ gar ma tshos ma rdo rje ma/ /zhes sogs kyi dngos shugs las brgyad tshan gnyis pa bstan pa'i phyir/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ ngo bo la dgongs nas bzhir dbye ba'i sgra ji bzhin pa ni/ ma sring bu mo sring mo'i bu mo dang / /zhang po'i chung ma ma spun sgyug mo dang / /pha yi sring mo zhes bya rnam pa brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi ma sogs sgra ji bzhin ma yin par bram ze mo sogs brgyad la ma sogs brgyad kyi tha snyad gsungs pa yin te/ kha sbyor las/ ma ni skye gnyis de bzhin gshegs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir dang / mdzes rgyan las/ sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa ni/ de bzhin bram ze rgyal rigs rje 'u mo/ /dmangs mo gar ma tshos ma g.yung mo dang / /gdol ma zhes bya brgyad yin phan tshun sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ phyag rgya gcig nyid la yon tan gyi ldog cha brgyad tshang ba ni ma sogs brgyad du 'gyur ba yin te/ phyag rgya gcig nyid rang gi gsang dbang gi rten du gyur pa la ma dang / sher dbang gi rten du gyur pa la sring mo sogs kyi tha snyad byed pa'i phyir te mdzes rgyan las/

dbang dang 'brel ba ni/ de bzhin dbang gi sgo nas ma sogs brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ phyag rgya gcig nyid la yon tan gyi ldog cha bcu drug tshang ba ni ma sogs bcu drug tu 'gyur te/ rtsa rgyud las/ gang phyir skye 'gro bskyed pa yi/ /shes rab ma zhes brjod par bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir dang / mdzes rgyan las/ yon tan dang rjes su mthun pa ni/ ye shes sgo nas bcu drug dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni/ rlung la brtan pa ma thob pa dang / thob kyang bslab pas bcings pa dang / bstan pa la smod pa'i nyes pa 'gog pa'i phyir phyag rgya yid kyis bsam nas snyoms 'jug gi bde ba bsgom pa ste/ sam+bu ṭi las bshad cing mdzes rgyan las/ dgag bya'i dbang gis ye shes phyag rgya'ang bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ ji ltar bstan pa'i thabs ni/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan las/ bsten thabs 'du shes gsum ldan dbab bzung gnyis/ /de bzhin bzlog khyab gnyis yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de ltar bsten pa las byung ba'i ye shes la gnyis/ gzhan lugs dgag pa dang / rang lugs brjod pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ gnas la dang / rang gi ngo bo la dang / go rim la log rtog dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mdzes rgyan nyid las/ byang sems gnas/ /nor bu'i dkyil du 'dzin 'dod mu stegs lugs/ /pad+mar phab pa tha mal pa dang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gnyis pa rang gi ngo bo la log rtog dgag pa ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ ye shes don du 'dod la gnod byed yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gsum pa go rim la log rtog dgag pa ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ lhan skyes gsum par 'dod la lung 'gal dang / /skad cig dga' ba 'khor lo yas babs dang / /dbang dang dri ma khams gsum 'dod pa dang / /bsam gtan sa lam mas brtan phyag rgya dang / /'bras bu'i go rim 'khrug pa'i gnod pa 'bab/

/ces gsungs pa ltar/ gnyis pa rang lugs brjod pa la gsum/ gnas dang / rang gi ngo bo dang / go rim yang dag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ de phyir gnas mchog mkha' gsang 'dzom pa'i rtse/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gnyis pa rang gi ngo bo ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ ngo bo mthong lam mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gsum pa go rim ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ go rim mtshan bral bzhi pa'i gnas skabs su/ /lhan skyes skye la klan ka'i go skabs ci/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de lta bu'i gnyis ka'i dmigs pa la brten nas skyes pa'i ye shes skyong tshul dang / rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs med bye brag tu skyong tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ de lta'i thabs gnyis gang yang rung ba las/ /ye shes cung zad skyes pa la brten nas/ /rgyud dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams kun/ /brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin bsgom par bya/ /gal te rjod byed rang bzhin nyid yin na/ /sna tshogs snang ba 'di dag ci zhe na/ /kun rdzob tsam du sna tshogs su snang yang / /ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su/ /nges par byas la bsgom bya sgom byed sogs/ /blang dor dgag sgrub re dogs med par gzhag /de ltar mnyam gzhag dmigs med goms pa las/ /rjes thob dmigs dang bcas pa'i sems can la/ /smyo ba'i bu la ma rnams brtse ba ltar/ /bcos min snying rje ngang gis skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gnyis pa rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs med bye brag tu skyong tshul ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ dmigs med nam mkha' bsgom pa'i sbyor ba dang / /mi g.yo bzhi ldan rnal 'byor la brten te/ /rtog med ting 'dzin bsgrubs nas yul kun la/ /bsre zhing spos te 'dzin med lta ba bskyang / /gal te chos kun ngo bos ma grub na/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub phyir bzlas bsgom la sogs pa/ /thabs kyi ngal ba byed pa don med de/

/lha sngags don la med pa'i phyir zhe na/ /dam pa'i don du bsgrub bya sgrub byed sogs/ /yod pa min yang spros bral ngang nyid nas/ /lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po yi/ /lha dang sngags sogs 'byung la skyon yod min/ /de phyir de ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bzlas bsgom la sogs grol ba'i grogs su 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de ltar bsgoms pas chos nyid rtogs pa'i mtshan 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rnal 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin las 'byung ba'i tshul ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ gal te de ltar bsgoms kyang chos rnams kyi/ /chos nyid nam yang shes par mi 'gyur te/ /yul dang chos nyid tha dad phyir zhe na/ /tha dad yod na de ltar 'gyur na yang / /snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes rang / /chos nyid kyang ni rang las gzhan min phyir/ /thabs de chos nyid rtogs pa'i grogs su 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de nyid bskyed cing bogs dbyung ba la gnyis/ thabs kyi bsten tshul dang / de goms na rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ de ltar shes nas za 'chag la sogs kyi/ /spyod lam kun tu ting 'dzin dran byas pas/ /rmi lam sogs su'ang dran pa'i thabs su 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gnyis pa de goms na rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur tshul ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ de lta'i sbyor bas gnas na yul rkyen gyis/ /mi gnod grol ba'i grogs byed dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de'i mi mthun pa'i bar chad bsal ba ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ 'byung gdon ting nge 'dzin gyi bar chad gsum/ /ting 'dzin nyid kyis sel bar byed pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de ltar goms pa las byung ba'i drod rtags ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ du ba la sogs rtags rnams myur du 'char/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ bzhi pa spyod pa ni drod thob nas spyod pa bya zhing /

drod kyi ngo bo ni/ rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa las byung ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi nus mthu khyad par can zhig yin la/ de la drod chung 'bring che gsum las/ dang po ni/ mnyam gzhag tu 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa snyam pa sogs/ drod chung ngu thob nas kun 'dar gsang ste spyod/ tshar bcad rjes bzung gang rung nus pa drod 'bring thob nas kun 'dar 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod/ kun 'dar mngon spyod kyis drod chen po ma thob na/ lha gnad la bor ba zhes bya ba drag shul gyi sgrub pa zla ba bco brgyad bya/ rnam shes dang ye shes cha mnyam pas tshar bcad dang rjes bzung gnyis ka nus pa drod chen po thob nas kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bya/ 'grub sla ba kha cig la kun bzang gi spyod pa zla ba gcig gis sa brgyad pa thob nas/ nye rgyu'i spyod pa zhag bdun gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob pa'ang yod/ yang kha cig gis/ kun bzang gi spyod pa zla ba du ma dang lo la sogs pas sa bcu gnyis pa thob nas nye rgyu'i spyod pa zhag gcig gis 'bras bu mchog rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob pa'ang yod de/ rdo rje gur las/ nyi ma gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyi ma gnyis kyi cho ga dang / /nyi ma gsum gyi sbyor ba dang / /zhes pa nas/ sbyor ba 'di ni yang dag brtsams/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i dus su ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces dang / mdzes rgyan las/ drod kyi ngo bo ni/ rim gnyis bsgoms pa las byung rab dbye ni/ drod gsum ste/ /mtshan nyid ni/ chos brgyad snyoms dang tshar bcad rjes bzung nus/ /thob byed ni/ de ma thob na brtson pas rim gnyis kyi/ /rnal 'byor bsgom dang kun 'dar gsang ste spyod/ /drag shul bsgrubs te brtan byed ni/ slar yang zla phyed du/ /bsgoms nas drod dang spyod pa mtshams sbyar ba ni/ drod dang spyod pa rim bzhin sbyar/

/spyod pa dang dngos la ngo bo ni/ de la 'jug tshe yo byad kun btang nas/ /blang dor med par bcad bya de la dbye ba na/ gnyis/ /gzung 'dzin rnam rtog spong ba kun 'dar dang / /rtogs pa ye shes skyong ba kun tu bzang / /dus ni/ gsang spyod sngon du song nas zla rer spyod/ /'on kyang kun bzang lo zlar spyod pa'ang yod/ /gang zag ni/ khyad chos gnyis ldan sgrub pos dgos pa ni/ de spyad na/ /rang gi sems kyi brtan g.yo nges sogs nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa nye rgyu ni/ thabs sgrub pa pos/ rang byin rlabs kyi zhu bde gnyis/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i zhu bde gnyis te bzhi/ yum la'ang de ltar bzhi ste brgyad dam/ yang na yum gyis rang byin rlabs ma bsgoms kyang chog pas/ drug gi bdag nyid de dbang gi gnas mchog gi ze bar 'dzom pas thig le zla ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ rak+ta nyi ma mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rlung sems ma 'dres pa so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ thams cad ro gcig pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de nas rlung 'dren pa zhes bya ba thabs la mkhas pas g.yas g.yon dbus gsum nas drangs te/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyud so sor dag par byas nas spyi gtsug tu thim pas gtsug tor mchog 'grub/ skad cig de la chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo lus zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku dang / sems rtog med ye shes su gnas gyur nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob ste 'khor ba ji srid par 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par 'gyur te/ mdzes rgyan las/ dgos pa ni/ dngos grub thob phyir gnas skabs gsum char ram/ /gzhan du med kyang tha mar phyag rgya bsten/ /nyams su blangs tshul la ngo bo ni/ ngo bo ā li kā li'i byang chub sems/ /khyad chos brgyad dam drug gi bdag nyid do/

/rtsod pa spang ba ni/ gal te sems la rtogs pa 'char ba ni/ /lus la ltos pa mi rigs zhes smra na/ /lus sems lhan cig gnas pa de srid du/ /tshogs pa gcig pa'i 'brel pa yod phyir 'thad/ /bsgoms pa'i dus ni/ kun bzang spyad nas sa lam lhag ma rnams/ /bgrod phyir nye rgyu'i spyod pa spyad bya ste/ /'grub pa'i dus ni/ gang de zhag bdun gyis 'grub drug pa yi/ /srod la bar chad med pas bdud btul nas/ /bdun par song ba'i tho rangs rnam grol brnyes/ /phyi'i gnas ni/ de yi gnas ni thun mong thun mong min/ /nges pa'i don du rang nyid grol ba'i gnas/ /nang gi gnas ni/ nang gi gnas ni e wam̐ 'dzoms pa'i rtse/ /rten ni/ phyag rgya ring nas goms dang grub pa thob/ /lung bstan nus mthus bkug pa'i mi nyid bsngags/ /de la thabs ni/ thabs gnyis la brten byang sems kyi/ /dwangs ma mngon du byas pa las byung ba'i/ /thig le zla ba me long ye shes dang / /rak+ta nyi ma mnyam pa nyid ye shes/ /rlung sems ma 'dres so sor yongs su rtogs/ /thams cad ro gcig bya ba nan tan che/ /g.yas g.yon dbus nas 'dren pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /thabs dang shes rab so sor dag byas te/ /dbu mar thim pas gtsug tor mchog grub pa'i/ /skad cig gcig la zag med 'ja' lus dang / /rtog med ye shes brnyes pa chos kyi dbyings/ /de lta'i rim pas rdo rje'i sa thob nas/ /'khor pa srid du 'gro ba'i don mdzad 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs bskul ba bzlas pa/ 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byed pa gtor ma/ dngos grub myur du 'grub pa sbyin sreg byin gyis brlabs pas kyang dngos grub 'grub pa rab gnas/ gdul bya smin pa dngos grub sna tshogs la mos pa rjes su bzung ba'i phyir las kyi tshogs rab 'byams dang lnga las/

dang po ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ mtshams sbyar ba ni/ gnas skabs rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /dngos grub mtha' dag sgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ /bzlas pa ni/ sngags kyi ngo bo mtshan rtog kun las skyob/ /don gyi sngags ni rang sems lhan cig skyes/ /nang ltar bshad pa'i sngags ni lte ba'i aṃ/ /phyi ma dag par bya phyir btu ba dang / /dngos dang bzlas pa'i yul dang kha zas dang / /bzlas pa'i man ngag dag dang dgos pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ gtor ma dus dang yo byad cho ga dang / /de yi dgos pa gnas skabs 'bras bu ste/ /cho ga rdzas dang mgron dang 'bul sogs dang / /mjug gi cho ga rnam pa bzhi yin la/ /re re'ang bzhi bzhir dbye bas bcu drug go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ sbyin sreg thab dang bud shing sbar ba me/ /mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas sham thabs dus phyogs bcas/ /sgrub po'i khyad par rnam drug sbyor ba'i chos/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor me btsal yo byad bsang / /thab khung 'dus byas 'jig rten me lha mchod/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod rnams dngos gzhi'i chos/ /me lha lhag mas mchod dang gtor ma btang / /tsa ru'i zas la longs spyad gshegs su gsol/ /smon lam gdab dang las rjes bsdu ba rnams/ /mjug gi chos rnams drug gsum bco brgyad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ mdzes rgyan las/ rab gnas rten dang slob dpon dus dang gnas/ /yo byad cho ga bzang po rnam drug las/ /cho ga sta gon dngos gzhi mjug gsum ste/ /re re'ang bdun bdun nyi shu rtsa gcig go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ las tshogs rab 'byams dman 'bring 'bring gi mchog /dman pa rdzas sbyor 'khrul 'khor bzlas pa dang / /sbyin sreg bsam gtan skyong ba'ang tshogs pas sgrub/ /'bring ni bzlas bsgom rdzas sbyor la sogs pas/ /'bring gi rab rnams bzlas bsgom tsam gyis so/

/de nas zhi rgyas dbang drag yan lag bcas/ /mig sman rkang byug ral gri sa 'og sgrub/ /ril bu mi snang bcud len bu mo dgug /de dag spyi dang bye brag dbye bsdur bcas/ /mkha' spyod rig 'dzin 'khor los bsgyur rnams 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i las sna tshogs pas bstan pa dang sems can la phan gdags par bya ba nyid do/ /bcu gcig pa gnyis ka'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa ni/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing / /zhes sogs dang / ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /zhes sogs ltar/ las dang po pa'i dam tshig dang / phyag rgya bcings pa rnams spangs shing / /zhes sogs ltar/ brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig dang / rtag par rgyun du sngags bzla zhing / /zhes sogs ltar brtan pa cung zad thob pa'i dam tshig rnams rang gi rgyud tshod dang sbyar te rim pas bslab par bya ba yin la/ dam tshig de dag bsdu na/ rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig gnyis sam sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum du 'du ste/ sam+bu ṭi las/ bud med dang ni skyes pa'i lus/ /zhes sogs dang / mdzes rgyan las/ dam tshig gi rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs ni dam tshig ste/ /de yang dbang gis phye na rnam pa bzhi/ /rten gyi sgo nas sgo gsum dam tshig gsum/ /gang zag sgo nas bzhi 'am gsum du 'gyur/ /las dang po pa'i bsrung ba'i dam tshig ni/ dang po'i las pas rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang / /de yi yan lag brgyad de nyi shu gnyis/ /bsgrub pa'i dam tshig bcu bdun dang bcas bsrung / /bsdus te bsrung tshul ni/ bsrung tshul bsdu na sgo gsum dam tshig nyid/ /dus rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig ni/ bza' ba'i dam tshig rgyun du bsten bya ni/ /tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu ste/ /de nyid shes pas bsten na mkha' 'gro mnyes/ /tshe dang lus kyi bcud len mchog tu 'gyur/
